Objective: We test whether baseline CodeHealth predicts the token cost of agentic review and fix beyond pull request (PR) footprint. Method: In a pre-registered observational study, we sampled 465 agent-authored PRs from 246 repositories in AIDev, jointly stratified by CodeHealth and footprint under repository caps. A frozen five-agent review-and-fix pipeline processed every PR with three different LLMs. Per LLM, we fitted a mixed model of log tokens on CodeHealth and log PR footprint, with a repository random intercept. Results: For all three LLMs the CodeH | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21914 | https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22127920
title: CodeHealth 可预测智能体代码审查的 Token 成本

content: Anvil：通过知识再循环扩展具身空间智能 | Anvil 以数据飞轮、场景对齐评测和多教师蒸馏统一具身空间能力训练，其9B学生模型在七项公开基准上平均显著优于同规模基线。 | 子主题：具身基础模型 | arXiv | Anvil 面向实体定位、空间关系推理和动作表达三个阶段，构建覆盖11种 Ground–Relation–Act 形式的统一框架。Anvil-Gen 结合特定形式生成、跨阶段一致性验证及失败驱动的数据回收，形成包含16万张图像、580万条来源可追溯记录的数据飞轮。Anvil-Ben 提供场景对齐的训练监督与评测，可区分单阶段能力不足和跨阶段错误传播。9B参数的 Anvil-MOPD 通过专家教师蒸馏、语义首错路由和阶段损失归一化整合异构空间知识，在七项公开基准上平均超过 Qwen3.5-9B 9.29个百分点，并在 VABench-Point 上达到80.67%。 | 为具身系统提供贯通感知定位、关系推理与动作表达的数据和训练范式。 利用语义首错路由将教师监督集中到最早的关键失误，有助于降低后续阶段的错误传播。 场景对齐、分阶段评测可用于诊断能力短板，而不只依赖单一端到端得分。 失败驱动的数据回收说明，定向覆盖、选择性知识迁移与反馈修复可以共同提升空间智能。 | 标题：Anvil: Scaling Embodied Spatial Intelligence through Knowledge Recirculation 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21882 摘要：Embodied spatial intelligence requires more than visual recognition: models must localize entities, reason about their relations, and express this knowledge in action-relevant forms. Yet joint training can conflate the knowledge needed at different stages because supervision is fragmented across incompatible geometric and semantic outputs. We introduce Anvil, a unified framework for data generation, training, and benchmarking for embodied spatial intelligence. (1) Anvil-Gen is a heterogeneous data flywheel that combines form-specific generation, cross-stage consistency verification, and failure-driven recollection across 11 Ground--Relation--Act forms. (2) Anvil-Ben provides scene-aligned supervision for learning diverse embodied spatial capabilities and scene-linked assessments that disti | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21882
title: Anvil：通过知识再循环扩展具身空间智能

content: 面向 GPU 高效证明候选评估的 Lean 反馈学习 | 研究通过学习 Lean 4 验证结果与编译器反馈，在 GPU 上快速评估证明候选，并以混合奖励将 GRPO 训练步骤耗时缩短约 31%。 | 子主题：形式化证明 | arXiv | 研究使用 484 万个带标签程序训练神经评估器，以预测 Lean 4 的接受判定、目标状态和错误信息。两阶段评估器先用分类器筛选候选，再由反馈模型为正预测打分，在包含 68,932 个程序的基准上取得 87.8% 的接受判定准确率。该系统在单张 H100 上每秒处理 3.5 个候选，吞吐量达到采用环境复用的 64 工作进程 Lean 基线的 4.2 倍。将神经评估器与 Lean 判定组成混合奖励后，GRPO 训练步骤耗时缩短约 31%，miniF2F 上的证明性能与纯 Lean 奖励基本持平。 | 用神经评估器预筛证明候选，可减少昂贵的 Lean 验证器调用和超时造成的 GPU 空闲。 预测目标状态与错误消息比单纯二分类提供更丰富的训练反馈，适合构建形式化证明的稠密奖励信号。 神经反馈与可信符号验证器结合，可在维持证明质量的同时提高强化学习训练吞吐量。 两阶段筛选与精评架构可推广到代码编译、程序验证等验证成本较高的任务。 | 标题：Learning Lean Feedback for Efficient Proof-Candidate Evaluation on GPUs 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21881 摘要：Training language models for formal theorem proving requires large numbers of verifier calls. Slow checks and timeouts often leave GPUs waiting and withhold rewards from potentially correct proofs. We train neural evaluators to predict Lean 4 verdicts and compiler feedback on GPUs using 4.84M labelled programs. We compare two validity classifiers with a feedback model that annotates proof attempts with predicted goal states and error messages. A two-stage evaluator that screens candidates with a classifier and scores its positive predictions with the feedback model reaches 87.8% accuracy in predicting whether Lean accepts a candidate proof, evaluated on a 68,932-program benchmark collected from public provers. The combined evaluator processes 3.5 candidates per second on one H100, 4.2x the | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21881
title: 面向 GPU 高效证明候选评估的 Lean 反馈学习

content: Co2In：知识编码、巩固与整合的双层记忆增量学习框架 | Co2In通过工作记忆与长期记忆协作完成知识编码、巩固和整合，在无样本回放的增量学习中兼顾可塑性、稳定性与内存效率。 | 子主题：持续学习 | arXiv | Co2In是一种受人类记忆机制启发的双层记忆增量学习框架，由负责自适应知识获取的工作记忆和负责持久保存信息的长期记忆组成。工作记忆首先从新数据中学习，并将知识编码到网络参数中；随后，知识巩固过程从参数中识别潜在模式，将其重新表达为紧凑的知识表示。框架进一步把知识表示及其模式转换为独立网络层，并整合至长期记忆，以平衡持续学习中的可塑性与稳定性。该方法在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet的无样本回放Class-IL与Task-IL设置下取得了先进性能，同时保持较高的内存效率。 | 为缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘提供工作记忆与长期记忆协同的新架构。 通过参数模式提取和紧凑知识表示降低历史知识的存储成本，适合无样本回放场景。 将巩固后的知识转换为独立网络层，为模块化知识积累和长期能力扩展提供参考。 可作为评估增量学习方法可塑性—稳定性权衡及内存效率的基线。 | 标题：Co2In: a Bi-level Memory Incremental Learning Framework with Knowledge Encoding, Consolidation, and Integration 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21804 摘要：Incremental learning (IL) aims to continually acquire new knowledge (plasticity) while retaining previously learned information (stability). However, striking a balance between plasticity and stability remains a significant challenge for intelligent systems. The human brain achieves exceptional balance, owing to various memory units that collaboratively encode and store information. Inspired by human memory mechanisms, this paper introduces an IL framework with knowledge enCoding, Consolidation, and Integration (Co2In). Co2In is designed as a bi-level memory architecture: a working memory for adaptive knowledge acquisition and a long-term memory dedicated to the persistent retention of information. The two memory modules work cooperatively during IL. The working memory first learns from ne | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21804
title: Co2In：知识编码、巩固与整合的双层记忆增量学习框架

content: RIKA：面向持续学习智能体的可靠知识获取 | RIKA通过分层知识抽取与基于证据的准入机制，降低有害经验被智能体复用的风险，并在多种任务流和模型骨干上提升持续学习表现。 | 子主题：持续学习 | arXiv | 论文发现，代表性记忆与经验学习系统生成的条目中约有12%～33%会在复用时损害后续任务表现。RIKA分层抽取事实性、概念性、程序性和元认知知识，以构建更全面的经验表示。其基于证据的知识准入机制结合来源证据与后续经验，决定哪些主张可以进入任务智能体的上下文，且无需额外设计验证任务。在Continual Learning Bench的六个任务流和四种模型骨干上，RIKA均取得最高综合得分。 | 为固定参数智能体提供可靠的上下文式持续学习与经验复用机制。 表明记忆条目不能仅按相关性保存，还需通过来源证据和后续经验进行可靠性治理。 可用于降低错误知识、错误程序和不可靠元认知经验对长程任务的累积影响。 为智能体记忆系统的知识准入、证据溯源和持续更新提供设计参考。 | 标题：Reliable Knowledge Acquisition for Continual Learning Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21739 摘要：As agents powered by foundation models move into open-ended environments, continual learning from experience becomes essential. For agents built on models with fixed parameters, this learning requires reusing prior task experience in context to improve performance and efficiency on future tasks. Existing memory and experience-learning systems typically focus on either retained facts or procedures, and lack a mechanism for establishing the reliability of claims extracted from the ongoing task stream. Indeed, we find that approximately 12--33\% of entries produced by representative systems harm future task performance when reused. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{RIKA} (Reliable Knowledge Acquisition), which combines hierarchical extraction of factual, conceptual, procedural, | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21739
title: RIKA：面向持续学习智能体的可靠知识获取

content: 将人类干预作为标签：定位与修正 LLM 智能体故障 | 研究将人类干预视为智能体内部计算故障的监督标签，通过因果定位、探针门控干预和局部 LoRA 编辑，分析并修正 LLM 智能体在明确请求上过度追问的问题。 | 子主题：机制发现 | arXiv | 研究在受控智能体环境中分析“请求已经明确却仍追问澄清”的故障，并以经盲测人工判断验证的规则监督器生成干预标签；13 个模型中有 5 个满足实验条件。由干预标签学习的残差流方向可在特定网络深度因果性地翻转 72%–100% 的留出过度追问案例，而随机方向几乎无效。机制分析发现，四个模型家族通常已经表征出请求无歧义，但该信念与最终追问决策正交且缺乏因果作用；另一个家族的少量故障则对应不同的世界表征。基于探针读出的门控 steering 能显著降低模拟人工监督负担并保留合理追问，而提示指令反而恶化表现；将修复写入权重的效果因模型而异，局部 LoRA 与行为克隆不存在统一优胜关系。 | 展示如何把部署过程中的人工接管记录从普通训练样本转化为定位智能体内部故障计算的监督信号。 提供“因果定位—探针门控—运行时干预—权重编辑”的智能体故障修复流程。 表明可解码的正确内部信念不一定会影响行为，诊断时需区分表征存在、因果效力与决策方向。 提醒权重编辑方案具有明显的模型家族和随机种子依赖性，应进行保留能力测试与跨模型验证，而非假设统一几何规律。 | 标题：Human Interventions as Labels: Localizing, Steering, and (Sometimes) Editing the Computations Behind LLM Agent Failures 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21708 摘要：When an LLM agent misbehaves, a human steps in, and that intervention is usually discarded or replayed as training data. We treat it instead as a measurement: a label pointing at the internal computation that failed. We study it in a controlled agent environment, on one failure (asking a clarifying question when the request was already unambiguous), with labels from a rule-based overseer validated against blind human judgment. Claims cover eligible models, which both over-ask and sometimes act on matched unambiguous requests: five of thirteen qualified (Qwen2.5-3B, gemma-2-2b, OLMo-3-7B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, Phi-4). Four findings. First, the ask-vs-act decision is causally localizable in every eligible family: a direction learned from intervention labels flips 72-100% of held-out over-asks at | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21708
title: 将人类干预作为标签：定位与修正 LLM 智能体故障

content: Router Drift Control：缓解 MoE 强化学习的离策略退化 | Router Drift Control 以训练与 rollout 路由分歧衡量策略陈旧度，通过过滤高漂移响应缓解 MoE 强化学习中的离策略退化和路由漂移。 | 子主题：模型路由 | arXiv | MoE 强化学习中的训练—推理不匹配、小批量更新和异步训练会造成离策略问题，使 rollout 与训练阶段选择不同专家并引发路由漂移。 既有 Rollout Routing Replay（R3）复用 rollout 阶段的专家选择，但会丢失训练路由器新增专家的梯度贡献，从而产生梯度偏差。 Router Drift Control（RDC）将 rollout 路由器与训练路由器的选择分歧作为策略陈旧度信号，在序列级别拒绝高漂移响应，同时保留原生专家选择及其学习信号。 在异步训练中，RDC 与 Truncated Importance Sampling（TIS）结合后，在 AIME 2024 和 AIME 2025 上的平均峰值验证准确率分别较 TIS 和 R3 提高 5.5 和 4.5 个百分点。 | 为异步或高陈旧度的 MoE 强化学习提供无需强制路由重放的离策略控制机制。 可将路由分歧用作样本质量与策略陈旧度指标，指导训练响应的选择性过滤。 提示路由重放可能引入隐藏的梯度偏差，设计 MoE 策略优化算法时需同时评估路由一致性与梯度完整性。 RDC 可与截断重要性采样等离策略校正技术组合，以提升训练稳定性和数学推理表现。 | 标题：Router Drift Control: Mitigating Off-Policy Degradation in Mixture-of-Experts Reinforcement Learning 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21682 摘要：Reinforcement learning (RL) can become off-policy due to training-inference mismatch, mini-batch updates, and asynchronous training.The resulting mismatch is especially harmful in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, where rollout--training discrepancies can change routing decisions and lead to router drift. Rollout Routing Replay (R3) mitigates this mismatch by reusing expert selections from the rollout stage during training. Our analysis shows that routing replay introduces gradient bias by losing contributions from experts selected by the training router but not the rollout router. To address this, we propose Router Drift Control (RDC), which uses routing disagreement between rollout and training as a signal of off-policy staleness and selectively rejects high-drift responses. The sequence- | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21682
title: Router Drift Control：缓解 MoE 强化学习的离策略退化

content: 大语言模型数据策略：训练全生命周期统一视角 | 该综述将预训练与后训练中的数据选择、加权和调度统一表述为训练预算分配策略，并系统分析其决策粒度、模型依赖性、时间适应性及计算成本。 | 子主题：数据策展 | arXiv | 论文认为数据质量并非文本的固有属性，而是取决于训练目标、具体模型及其当前训练状态的动态效用。 作者将数据策略统一建模为在候选样本之间分配训练预算的策略，覆盖预训练和后训练全生命周期。 现有方法按照决策粒度、模型依赖性和时间适应性组织，并比较其计算需求与实证支持。 细粒度或状态依赖策略具备更强控制能力，但会引入额外的样本评分、搜索或 rollout 成本；跨模型规模迁移和端到端成本比较的证据仍然有限。 配套仓库持续维护相关论文及其公开实现。 | 为统一理解数据选择、加权、混合与调度方法提供分类框架。 可用于设计与训练状态联动的动态数据策略，在固定数据预算下提升能力获取效率。 提醒评估数据策略时纳入样本评分、搜索和 rollout 等端到端计算成本。 指出跨模型规模迁移、统一评测协议和成本可比性是后续研究重点。 | 标题：Data Strategies for Large Language Models: A Unified Perspective on the Training Lifecycle 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21681 摘要：Data strategy plays a central role in training large language models (LLMs). It governs the selection, weighting, and scheduling of training data, thereby determining the capabilities a model can acquire from a fixed data budget. We treat high-quality data as having high training-dependent utility, which depends on the target objective, the model, and its training state rather than on the text alone. Research in this area now spans pretraining and post-training, but related ideas use inconsistent terminology and evaluation protocols. This work reviews data strategies across the training lifecycle and formulates them as policies that allocate a training budget over candidate examples. We organise methods by their decision granularity, model dependence, and temporal adaptivity, then compare | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21681 | https://github.com/xuyj233/data_strategy_survey
title: 大语言模型数据策略：训练全生命周期统一视角

content: 收益电话会 NLP 基准的可用性契约与事件内时序错配 | 论文提出“可用性契约”，通过明确输入完成时间与预测结果起点，揭示收益电话会 NLP 基准中事件内时序错配会显著改变标签和损失。 | 子主题：评测审计 | arXiv | 论文指出，收益电话会的公告、预备发言与讨论分布在多个高频收益区间，若预测窗口在文本或音频完整可用前启动，就会产生事件内部的时序错配，而按时间划分训练集与测试集无法解决该问题。作者提出“可用性契约”，要求基准明确输入边界、输入可用性的证据、结果窗口起点，以及这些证据能够支持的结论。对24家公司的552场收益电话会分析发现，将结果起点从电话会开始代理时间移至音频完成并预留处理时间后，9.4%的样本收益符号翻转，28.3%的样本收益分位发生变化。在独立的公开波动率基准中，将盘前预测窗口后移一个交易时段，使四组冻结预测流的三日均方误差上升18.1%至21.4%，但模型排名保持不变，说明稳定排名可能掩盖标签与损失的实质变化。 | 为金融 NLP 基准建立输入可用时间与预测目标时间之间的显式约束，避免未来信息或未完成输入被隐式使用。 提醒评测者不能仅依赖按样本日期进行的时间切分，还需审计每个事件内部的输入边界和结果窗口。 建议报告不同时间边界下的标签翻转率、分位变化和损失敏感性，而不只比较模型排名。 可将“可用性契约”推广至新闻、会议直播、监管披露等持续生成输入的时序预测任务。 | 标题：When Does "Post-Call" Begin? An Availability Contract for Earnings-Call NLP Benchmarks 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21659 摘要：Corporate financial disclosures often unfold over time, with announcements, prepared remarks, and discussion spanning multiple high-frequency return intervals. Financial NLP benchmarks can therefore suffer from a within-event timing mismatch when the prediction target begins before the textual or audio input used by a model could be complete. Chronological train--test splits do not prevent this mismatch, because it occurs inside individual events rather than across samples. We introduce an Availability Contract, which requires a benchmark to state the input boundary, evidence for input availability, the outcome start, and the claims supported by that evidence. We apply this framework to 552 earnings calls from 24 firms. For each call, we hold the return endpoint fixed and compare the previ | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21659
title: 收益电话会 NLP 基准的可用性契约与事件内时序错配

content: ReFlow：基于经验回放解耦的高效 RL 后训练框架 | ReFlow 通过近期轨迹回放、弹性资源池与自适应调度解耦生成和策略优化，在保持模型性能的同时将 LLM 强化学习后训练吞吐量最高提升 2.06 倍。 | 子主题：系统优化 | arXiv | ReFlow 是一个面向 LLM 强化学习后训练的系统—算法协同设计框架，旨在缓解轨迹生成成本高和异步训练策略陈旧的问题。其双重回放数据循环复用近期轨迹，在提升样本利用率的同时平衡训练吞吐量与优化稳定性。框架还引入弹性资源池和自适应调度器，根据动态工作负载调整资源放置与生成策略。单轮推理和多轮智能体任务实验表明，ReFlow 相较先进同步及异步 RL 系统可实现最高 2.06 倍吞吐量提升，并保持相当或更好的模型性能。 | 以近期轨迹回放摊薄高成本 rollout 生成开销，提升强化学习后训练的样本效率。 在同步训练效率不足与激进异步导致策略陈旧之间提供新的系统设计折中。 通过弹性资源池适配单轮推理和多轮智能体训练中不断变化的计算需求。 为强化学习算法、生成策略与底层资源调度的协同优化提供参考架构。 | 标题：ReFlow: Replay-Driven Decoupling for Efficient RL Post-Training 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21640 摘要：Reinforcement learning (RL) has been a critical paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) reasoning and agentic capabilities, but its efficiency remains a major bottleneck. Existing RL systems commonly rely on asynchronous execution to overlap rollout generation with policy optimization for enhanced efficiency. However, this approach faces inherent limitations: mild policy staleness offers only limited training efficiency gains, whereas aggressive asynchrony can degrade model quality and yields diminishing efficiency gains. The dynamic nature of LLM RL and multi-turn agentic workloads further challenges RL system design, as resource demands shift over time, making static resource allocation and generation strategy inefficient. This paper presents ReFlow, a system-algorithm co-desig | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21640
title: ReFlow：基于经验回放解耦的高效 RL 后训练框架

content: AgentPerturb：受控交互扰动下的 LLM 智能体鲁棒性评测 | AgentPerturb 通过扰动目标与扰动类型的二维框架，系统评估前沿 LLM 智能体在复杂噪声交互中的鲁棒性、失效机制与额外计算成本。 | 子主题：智能体评测 | arXiv | AgentPerturb 从扰动目标和扰动类型两个维度构建受控评测框架，并在 APEX-Agents 与 Toolathlon 上测试当前前沿智能体。实验显示，各类扰动都会稳定降低任务表现，但不同任务环境中的主导脆弱点并不相同。轨迹分析发现，智能体很少主动识别输入变化，且常在缺少验证的情况下持续传播受污染信息。成本分析进一步表明，即使扰动后的任务成功完成，也可能消耗显著更多计算资源，因此作者主张在训练中强化噪声覆盖、信息验证、不确定性感知与错误恢复能力。 | 为工具型智能体提供可控、可复现的交互扰动鲁棒性评测流程。 支持从执行轨迹定位错误信息未被识别、验证或恢复的具体环节。 提示鲁棒性训练不能只优化任务成功率，还应奖励主动验证、不确定性感知和故障恢复。 将扰动后的计算开销纳入评估，有助于同时衡量智能体的可靠性与成本效率。 | 标题：AgentPerturb: Evaluating LLM Agent Robustness under Controlled Interaction Perturbations 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21624 摘要：Real-world tasks are often complex and noisy, posing substantial challenges for LLM agents. Yet existing evaluations lack a systematic framework for jointly characterizing potential perturbation targets and types. We use this two-dimensional view to conduct a unified study that quantifies the robustness of current frontier models, traces the mechanisms behind perturbation-induced failures, and draws implications for robustness-oriented training. Through controlled evaluations on APEX-Agents and Toolathlon, we find that perturbations consistently degrade performance, while the dominant vulnerabilities vary across task environments. Trajectory-level analysis reveals that agents rarely recognize altered inputs and often propagate corrupted information without verification. A focused cost anal | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21624 | https://github.com/xuyj233/AgentPerturb | https://github.com/xuyj233/AgentPerturb
title: AgentPerturb：受控交互扰动下的 LLM 智能体鲁棒性评测

content: AVALON：基于人类播种拓扑记忆的零样本室内导航 | AVALON利用人类提供的分层拓扑记忆、节点验证和证据门控的协同更新，使机器人无需现场建图或专项训练即可在陌生室内环境中完成导航。 | 子主题：具身规划 | arXiv | AVALON面向“人类熟悉、机器人未见”的室内环境，以楼层平面图、地点线索和初始拓扑—里程计对齐构建人类播种的分层空间记忆。框架通过节点到达验证与平移重锚定执行拓扑导航，无需机器人预先遍历、场地专项训练或构建全局SLAM地图。其任务触发、证据门控的记忆协同更新机制，将人类提供的权限与环境变化信息同机器人现场验证的可通行性证据明确分离。在Unitree Go2实机实验中，搭载X-NavDP的AVALON以5/5成功率完成12.81米任务，平均耗时46.4秒，较DimOS-Go2减少40.9%的机器人执行时间。 | 为服务机器人快速部署到未建图建筑提供低前置成本的室内导航方案。 展示人类先验空间知识与机器人现场感知证据可以通过门控机制安全地协同更新。 节点验证和重锚定可降低导航对全局SLAM地图的依赖，提升陌生环境中的执行可靠性。 权限信息与可通行性证据的显式分离，有助于设计更可审计的人机协同空间记忆。 | 标题：AVALON: Zero-Shot Indoor Navigation with Human-Seeded Topological Memory 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21586 摘要：Indoor service robots often enter unmapped buildings whose layouts and task constraints are already familiar to users. We address this human-familiar, robot-unseen setting with AVALON, a topological navigation framework organized around human-seeded layered spatial memory, node-verified topological execution, and task-triggered, evidence-gated human--robot memory co-updating. The robot has no prior on-site traversal or site-specific training. Deployment requires only a floor plan, place clues, and an initial topology-odometry alignment. Visual depth point-goal navigation leverages verified node arrivals to perform translational re-anchoring, without requiring a robot-constructed global SLAM map. Human--robot memory co-updating fuses complementary sources of information. Human operators spe | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21586
title: AVALON：基于人类播种拓扑记忆的零样本室内导航

content: ClaimScope：标签盲见证验证的数学主张审计基准 | ClaimScope通过标签盲见证检查器审计数学主张，表明验证器反馈主要改善反例结构和安全完成率，但未显著提升主张分类或整体推理能力。 | 子主题：答案验证 | arXiv | ClaimScope包含72项任务，要求智能体围绕数学主张给出判定、适用范围、反例和修复方案，覆盖优化器状态传输、有限时域仿射递推及精确的二维线性代数。研究以Qwen3-8B比较直接生成与四种从相同草稿出发的两阶段条件，见证检查器仅检查模型提交的状态，不读取参考标签，也不提供替代见证。验证器反馈将无效主张上的可接受反例由15/39提高到23/39，并将安全完成数由20/72提高到25/72，但严格完成数仍为17/72，判定准确率也未改善。结果显示收益集中于根据诊断信息修正见证结构，而非更广泛的数学推理能力提升；事后仅做格式模式修正也能达到相同的25项安全完成。 | 为数学智能体提供超越答案准确率和证明接受率的细粒度主张审计基准。 展示不接触参考标签的执行式见证验证仍可提供有效反馈，尤其适合反例检查与结构修复。 提醒评测者区分“主张分类正确”与“可执行证据有效”，避免将格式或见证修复收益误判为推理能力提升。 可用于设计结合判定、反例、范围限定和错误修复的可信数学推理流程。 | 标题：ClaimScope: Label-Blind Witness Verification for Mathematical Claim Auditing 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21581 摘要：Mathematical agents are commonly evaluated by answer accuracy or proof acceptance. We introduce ClaimScope, a 72-task benchmark for auditing proposed claims through a verdict, scope, counterexample, and repair. Tasks cover optimizer-state transport, finite-horizon affine recurrences, and exact $2\times2$ linear algebra. We evaluate Qwen3-8B with direct generation and four matched two-pass conditions, each starting from the same draft. A witness checker evaluates only the model's submitted state, without consulting reference verdicts or supplying a replacement witness. Its feedback still conveys information about validity: a verified refutation establishes that the claim is false, and rejection reasons can suggest structural fixes. In this evaluation, verifier feedback yields $23/39$ accept | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21581
title: ClaimScope：标签盲见证验证的数学主张审计基准

content: 重新审视多轮工具使用中的工具图记忆 | 对九个模型和两个基准的评测表明，工具图记忆的有限收益主要来自额外计算，文本化经验能以更低调用成本提供更有效且更可泛化的指导。 | 子主题：工具调用 | arXiv | 论文系统评估了工具图记忆在多轮工具调用中的实际作用，覆盖九个模型和两个基准。结果显示，该机制很少显著优于基线，偶尔取得的增益通常需要两倍以上的 LLM 调用次数。工具图给出的下一工具建议经常出错，而随机指导或不提供指导仍能保留大部分收益，说明额外测试时计算可能才是性能提升的主要来源。即使直接提示正确的下一工具，智能体仍可能放弃调用；相比之下，将相同经验存为文本洞见可在几乎不增加调用成本的情况下获得更好表现。 | 提醒智能体系统设计者区分记忆机制本身的贡献与额外测试时计算带来的收益。 工具使用经验更适合作为柔性的文本先验，而非强制指定下一工具的图结构规则。 评估记忆组件时应同时报告任务成功率、LLM 调用次数以及错误指导率。 多轮工具调用失败不能仅靠正确的工具推荐解决，还需分析放弃调用等执行层失效模式。 | 标题：Rethinking the Role of Tool Graph Memory in Multi-Turn Tool Use 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21571 摘要：Large language model (LLM) agents solve complex tasks by calling external tools over multiple turns. Recent work has proposed tool graph memory, which stores past experience as tool transitions to guide subsequent selection. However, it remains unclear whether this component consistently improves agents' tool use or undermines it. We evaluate tool graph memory on nine models and two benchmarks, finding that it seldom improves significantly over baselines, and that its gains, where present, cost over twice the LLM calls. The memory's guidance is often incorrect, and random or no guidance retains most of the gain, implying that the benefit stems from extra computation rather than the memory itself. Moreover, even with the correct next tool suggested, many failures remain, such as giving up w | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21571
title: 重新审视多轮工具使用中的工具图记忆

content: P³IBench：真实场景主动视频助手评测 | P³IBench面向真实流式视频场景，综合评测助手的日常感知、风险预测和适时干预能力，揭示当前视频语言模型在响应时机与决策校准方面仍存在明显不足。 | 子主题：评测基准 | arXiv | P³IBench将视频助手评测从已观察内容理解扩展到需求预判与主动干预，覆盖日常感知、风险预测和干预三项互补能力。研究评测了12个开源及闭源视频语言模型，包括原生流式系统和经适配的非流式系统。实验表明，现有模型难以准确判断是否以及何时提供帮助，容易出现响应决策校准不足的问题。作者还构建了主动式训练数据并训练P³I-Assistant-4B，在多项任务上取得提升，但不同能力维度的收益并不均衡。 | 为主动视频助手提供覆盖感知、预测和干预的综合评测框架。 提示实际部署不能只关注视频理解准确率，还需评估响应时机、克制性与风险判断能力。 可用于比较流式与非流式视频语言系统，并指导主动式训练数据和干预策略设计。 | 标题：From Perception to Prediction and Intervention: Benchmarking Proactive Video Assistants in Real-Life Scenarios 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21568 摘要：Recent multimodal large language models have advanced video understanding, but existing benchmarks mainly evaluate whether models can interpret observed visual content. In real-world scenarios, assistants must additionally anticipate what assistance is needed and decide when to provide it. To address this gap, we introduce \textsc{P$^3$IBench}, a benchmark for proactive video understanding in real-life streaming scenarios. It evaluates three complementary capabilities: daily perception, risk prediction and intervention. We benchmark 12 representative open-source and proprietary video-language models, including streaming and adapted non-streaming systems. Our evaluation shows that current models struggle to make well-calibrated response decisions. Finally, we construct additional proactive | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21568
title: P³IBench：真实场景主动视频助手评测

content: DialFork：对话智能体程序性幻觉评测基准 | DialFork 通过受控分叉对话并注入程序性偏离，评估对话智能体在内容合理时是否仍遵循预期会话流程。 | 子主题：幻觉检测 | arXiv | DialFork 面向“程序性幻觉”，即对话内容单独看流畅且事实合理，但整体执行过程偏离预定会话逻辑。基准在受控轮次对合规对话进行分叉并注入四类幻觉，包含 12 个领域、24 项任务和 36,278 段对话，并由 30 名人工标注员验证。其三类评测分别衡量对话集合偏离程度、单段对话偏离程度，以及首次偏离流程的具体轮次。作者提出对话流感知指标 FlowKL 和 FlowScore，其中 FlowScore 在七种编码器上的对话级评测中显著优于基线，表明语义相似度不能替代程序相似度。 | 为对话智能体提供超越事实正确性的流程遵循能力评测。 可用于监控已部署智能体、检索程序性异常对话，并构建实时偏航防护机制。 提示评测者应同时检查对话内容与执行流程，避免仅依赖语义相似度判断可靠性。 FlowKL 与 FlowScore 可作为分析会话轨迹和定位首次流程偏离的参考指标。 | 标题：DialFork: Going Beyond Factuality to Evaluate Procedural Hallucination in Conversational Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21561 摘要：Large language models (LLMs) deployed as conversational agents are increasingly expected to follow procedural logic. While factual hallucination has received extensive attention, a different failure mode has been overlooked: procedural hallucination, in which an agent produces individually fluent and factually plausible utterances while deviating from the intended conversational process. We introduce DialFork, the first benchmark to measure this failure mode on raw dialogue text. DialFork is built by forking conformant dialogues at controlled turn positions and injecting one of four hallucination types, yielding 36,278 dialogues across 24 tasks in 12 domains; 30 human annotators validate the construction. We define three evaluation tasks that characterize procedural deviation at three gran | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21561 | https://github.com/idiap/dialfork | https://github.com/idiap/dialfork
title: DialFork：对话智能体程序性幻觉评测基准

content: OPRD：面向长程编程智能体的在策略提醒蒸馏 | OPRD通过多范围提醒监督和基于任务结果的路由机制蒸馏长程编程智能体，在无需推理时提醒的情况下显著提升仓库级代码任务成功率并减少执行错误。 | 子主题：在策略蒸馏 | arXiv | OPRD针对编程智能体在长交互中忽略上下文约束、无法有效利用工具反馈，以及最终成败信号过于稀疏的问题，引入多范围提醒监督。对于成功的无提醒学生轨迹，方法采用自回归自模仿目标；对于失败轨迹，则由教师重新评估相同的学生前缀，并提供提醒条件下的反向 KL 监督。全局提醒将最终测试诊断转化为轨迹级指导，局部提醒仅作用于相关环境观测之后的下一次决策，而学生在推理阶段不依赖任何提醒。基于 Qwen3.5-4B 的实验显示，OPRD在三个 SWE-bench 基准上的平均任务解决率提升11.3个百分点，并将错误事件总数从446降至222。 | 将稀疏的任务成败反馈转化为针对具体执行轨迹和决策步骤的训练信号。 通过仅在训练阶段使用提醒，避免为部署时的编程智能体引入额外提示依赖。 为仓库级长程任务中的约束保持、工具反馈利用和失败纠正提供可复用的蒸馏方案。 结果表明，结合成功轨迹自模仿与失败轨迹教师监督，可同时改善任务完成率和过程可靠性。 | 标题：OPRD: On-Policy Reminder Distillation for Long-Horizon Coding Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21496 摘要：Reliable repository-level coding requires agents not only to generate correct code but also to preserve constraints and respond to tool feedback across long interactions. However, our diagnostic analysis shows that agents often fail to act on relevant information already available in context, while final Pass/Fail outcomes provide only sparse process supervision. We introduce On-Policy Reminder Distillation (OPRD), which combines Multi-Scope Reminder supervision with outcome-based routing on reminder-free student rollouts. Successful rollouts provide autoregressive self-imitation targets, whereas failed rollouts receive Reminder-conditioned reverse-KL supervision from a teacher that re-evaluates the same student-generated prefixes. A Global Reminder converts final-test diagnostics into tra | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21496
title: OPRD：面向长程编程智能体的在策略提醒蒸馏

content: SpecAgent：面向工具智能体的轨迹级推测与语义验证 | SpecAgent 让弱模型生成并执行有真实观测支撑的工具调用轨迹，再由强模型批量验证和修复，在接近强模型任务质量的同时显著降低延迟、显存流量与生成开销。 | 子主题：推理效率 | arXiv | SpecAgent 将强模型从逐步动作生成者转变为轨迹审查者，由弱模型先起草一段工具调用轨迹。弱模型可执行只读工具调用以获取真实观测，但会暂缓首个可能修改环境的动作，从而控制执行风险。强模型通过单次 prefill 并行验证整段轨迹，提交语义有效的最长前缀，并修复首个被拒绝的步骤。在 τ²-Bench 上，该协议以不到一个百分点的成功率损失，将内存流量和墙钟时间大致减半；在其他基准及边云部署中也能恢复弱强模型间的大部分质量差距。 | 通过“弱模型起草、强模型审查”替代强模型全程自回归生成，可降低长工具调用轨迹的推理成本。 轨迹级批量验证比逐步推测验证更充分利用并行 prefill，适合延迟和内存带宽受限的智能体系统。 暂缓具有环境写入效应的动作，为工具智能体提供了兼顾推理加速与执行安全的部署模式。 可用于边云协同场景，以端侧弱模型承担常规步骤、云端强模型负责语义验证和关键修复。 | 标题：Trajectory-Level Speculation with Semantic Verification for Tool-Using Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21463 摘要：Large language model agents solve tasks through long sequences of tool calls, and the prevailing design has a single strong model generate every step, although many steps are routine enough for a much smaller model. Existing ways of sharing this work keep the strong model as the generator: routers and collaborative agents decide which model handles each query or step, and speculative methods check a small model's drafts one step at a time, usually against the strong model's own action. We introduce SpecAgent, a collaboration protocol that turns the strong model from the author of each step into a reviewer of steps drafted by a weak model. The weak model executes read-only tool calls as it drafts, so that every step is grounded in real observations, and holds the first action that would mod | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21463
title: SpecAgent：面向工具智能体的轨迹级推测与语义验证

content: MRTPO：多奖励强化学习的奖励特定词元级信用分配 | MRTPO利用验证器信息定位每项奖励对应的相关词元，实现无需辅助模型或词元级标注的多奖励细粒度信用分配。 | 子主题：信用分配 | arXiv | MRTPO面向同时使用多个可验证奖励训练语言模型的场景，解决现有GDPO将每项奖励优势均匀分配给整段响应的问题。对于每项奖励，策略分别在包含和移除相应验证器信息的条件下重放自身响应，并计算两个下一词元分布之间的Jensen-Shannon距离。该距离用于衡量各词元与特定奖励的相关性，进而将奖励优势重新分配到真正相关的位置，且不需要辅助模型或词元级人工标注。在Text-to-SQL、多约束指令遵循和工具调用任务上，MRTPO相比对照方法收敛更快并取得更好性能。 | 为多奖励RL提供细粒度信用分配机制，减少无关词元受到错误奖励信号影响。 可用于工具调用中分别优化调用正确性、参数格式等由不同验证器检查的目标。 通过复用验证器已有信息避免额外标注或训练辅助归因模型，降低训练系统复杂度。 表明奖励作用范围与词元相关性建模可能是提升多约束任务训练效率的重要方向。 | 标题：Each Reward to Its Relevant Tokens: Reward-Specific Token-Level Credit Assignment for Multi-Reward RL 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21439 摘要：Language models are increasingly trained against several verifiable rewards at once, such as the correctness and the format of a tool call, or the individual constraints of a complex instruction. Reward-decoupled normalization (GDPO) normalizes each reward separately so that different reward combinations keep distinct advantages, but it still spreads every reward's advantage evenly over the whole response, although each verifier checks only a few positions. We propose MRTPO, which assigns the advantage of each reward to the tokens relevant to it, using the information its verifier checks, without auxiliary models or token-level annotations. For each reward, the policy replays its own response with and without that reward's verifier information, and the per-token Jensen-Shannon distance bet | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21439
title: MRTPO：多奖励强化学习的奖励特定词元级信用分配

content: SPRA：面向科研智能体的结构化论文表示 | SPRA将百万篇AI论文解析为带类型关系和证据位置的研究对象，通过Schema-RAG提升科研问答与跨论文推理效率，并显著降低上下文令牌开销。 | 子主题：科学数据 | arXiv | SPRA以论文为单位，将问题、贡献、组件、实验设置、度量和发现组织为可查询、遍历和复用的持久研究对象，并记录依赖、组件使用及工作比较等关系。作者在超过100万篇AI论文上构建了包含1,995万研究单元和2,407万内部关系的资源，同时保留原文位置以支持证据验证。基于Schema-RAG的评测显示，SPRA在七个子领域的来源约束科学问答和定向跨论文推理中优于段落检索。相较段落检索，其跨论文任务的输入与输出令牌总量减少28.5%；在创意生成中，相较Full Compact减少93.7%的令牌，仅付出较小质量损失。 | 为科研智能体提供比原始叙事文本更易检索、组合和验证的论文级知识表示。 支持跨论文依赖分析、组件复用、实验比较和证据定位等科研工作流。 说明结构化研究对象可在维持任务质量的同时大幅压缩上下文，降低科研智能体的推理成本。 可作为科学问答、研究综述、创意生成及文献证据审查系统的数据基础设施。 | 标题：Do Agents Need a New Kind of Paper? SPRA: Structured Paper Representation for Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21424 摘要：Scientific agents must connect research problems, methods, and findings dispersed through narrative articles. We introduce SPRA (Structured Paper Representation for Agents), a paper-level representation of persistent research objects and typed relations. Its empirical-AI profile organizes Problems, Contributions, Components, ExperimentSetups, Measures, and Findings for querying, traversal, and reuse. Selected paper-level citation relations record dependencies, component use, and comparisons with prior work; source locations support verification. We instantiate SPRA across more than one million AI papers, with 19.95 million research units and 24.07 million internal relations. Evaluations access SPRA through Schema-RAG with task evidence fixed before inference. Across seven subfields, SPRA i | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21424
title: SPRA：面向科研智能体的结构化论文表示

content: 提示演化中的压力与情绪预测有效策略 | 研究比较六种提示演化方法，发现 GEPA 与 GEPA+merge 可在部分压力和情绪预测设置中提升表现，并归纳出五类有效提示策略及其评估局限。 | 子主题：提示优化 | arXiv | 研究在社交媒体压力与情绪数据上，跨两种模型规模比较了六种提示演化方法，并强调仅看准确率可能掩盖假阳性风险。GEPA 及融合两个提示指令的扩展方法 GEPA+merge，在多个实验设置中优于初始提示。与开发集性能提升相关的五类策略包括关注情绪证据、区分当前与过去的痛苦、展示间接线索、要求结合情绪语境以及指导标签选择。实验也揭示了错误或冲突指令、小样本增益无法扩展到完整开发集，以及开发集和测试集提示排名变化等局限。 | 为社交媒体压力检测与多标签情绪预测选择提示演化方法提供实验依据。 提示评估时应同时关注假阳性、完整开发集表现和测试集排名稳定性，而非仅依赖准确率或小样本结果。 可将五类有效策略作为自动提示搜索的候选组件，并通过 GEPA+merge 探索策略组合收益。 | 标题：Identifying Effective Strategies in Prompt Evolution for Stress and Emotion Prediction 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21407 摘要：Early stress detection and risk prediction are crucial for timely mental health assessment and support. While large language models have recently shown promise for social media stress prediction, relying on accuracy can obscure false positives. Also, prompt revisions yield inconsistent gains across models and tasks, with unclear links to strategy combinations and instruction changes. By comparing six methods on social media stress and emotion data across two model sizes, we found that GEPA and its extension combining instructions from two prompts (GEPA+merge) improved prediction over initial prompts in several settings. We also identified five prompting strategies associated with development gains. These strategies included directing attention to emotional evidence, distinguishing current | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21407
title: 提示演化中的压力与情绪预测有效策略

content: MemCut：LLM 智能体长期记忆中的秘密遗忘评测 | MemCut 通过带完整证据轨迹的长程对话秘密，系统评估 LLM 智能体在用户要求删除敏感信息后仍可恢复信息的风险。 | 子主题：机器遗忘 | arXiv | MemCut 包含长程对话中的 456 个手工设计秘密，并完整标注直接披露与间接证据形成的信息轨迹。基准提出原生恢复与残留恢复两项指标，分别衡量通过系统检索和直接读取删除后残存对象恢复秘密的成功率。作者在五种记忆设计和四个 LLM 上测试了三类参考删除基线，发现移除直接披露内容虽能显著降低原生恢复，却难以消除残留恢复。即使由 LLM 从 20 个检索候选中额外删除 10 轮对话，残留恢复率仍达 39%–76%，实验表明候选证据覆盖不足是现有遗忘方案的主要瓶颈。 | 为长期记忆智能体提供用户请求遗忘与敏感信息删除的系统化评测基准。 揭示仅删除直接披露或常规检索候选无法清除秘密的间接证据轨迹。 指导记忆系统采用证据溯源、扩大候选覆盖和删除后恢复测试，以降低隐私泄露风险。 可用于审计智能体记忆治理机制是否真正实现可验证遗忘。 | 标题：MemCut: Every Secret Leaves a Trail in the Long-Term Memory of LLM Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21405 摘要：Long-term memory has become a crucial component of large language model (LLM) agents, with most research focusing on retrieving relevant information accurately and efficiently. However, a dependable memory system must also forget sensitive user data upon request. To evaluate this capability, we introduce MemCut, a systematic benchmark for user-requested forgetting. Its 456 hand-designed secrets in long-horizon conversations have fully annotated evidence trails to test recovery after deletion, including from messages that never state the secrets directly. We propose two recovery metrics. Native recovery measures reader success through the system's retrieval, whereas residual recovery measures the same reader's success when directly given surviving objects traced to annotated disclosures or | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21405
title: MemCut：LLM 智能体长期记忆中的秘密遗忘评测

content: 自引导 LLM 推理诊断车辆路径问题中的错误 | 该研究让 LLM 自主生成诊断代码并提取结构化线索，显著提升车辆路径问题实例中的错误检测与纠正能力。 | 子主题：可信推理 | arXiv | 研究系统考察了 LLM 检测与纠正车辆路径问题（VRP）输入错误的能力，弥补现有求解方法通常假设实例无误的不足。实验发现，当实例复杂或错误显著增加推理负担时，LLM 的诊断能力会明显下降。为此，作者提出自引导推理框架，使 LLM 自主生成代码，并利用代码输出的结构化信息辅助定位错误。跨多种问题设置和 LLM 的实验表明，该框架显著提高了错误检测性能，准确率接近完美。 | 为现实物流与路径规划数据提供自动化错误检测和纠正方案。 展示代码生成可作为 LLM 的推理工具，将复杂组合优化实例转化为结构化诊断线索。 为提升 LLM 在高推理负担场景下的可靠性和自我验证能力提供框架参考。 | 标题：Self-Guided LLM Reasoning for Error Diagnosis in Vehicle Routing Problems 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21393 摘要：Vehicle Routing Problems (VRPs) are fundamental to many real-world applications. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have spurred progress in solving these NP-hard problems. However, most existing approaches assume that input instances are error-free, neglecting the presence of faults commonly encountered in real-world data. In this work, we systematically investigate the capability of LLMs to detect (and correct) errors in VRP instances, and identify key limitations, particularly in handling complex instances or errors that substantially increase the LLM's reasoning burden. To overcome these challenges, we propose a self-guided reasoning framework in which LLMs autonomously generate code that provides structured insights to aid in error diagnosis. Experiments across diverse pr | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21393
title: 自引导 LLM 推理诊断车辆路径问题中的错误

content: Memorilla：面向 LLM 的潜在语义记忆 | Memorilla 将整个文档集合压缩为固定数量的查询相关记忆 token，使冻结 LLM 能以更短上下文高效利用长期知识，并改善智能体的持续学习表现。 | 子主题：长期记忆 | arXiv | Memorilla 首先将用户对话、书籍章节等文档编码为可复用嵌入，再根据查询检索信息并映射至冻结 LLM 的输入嵌入空间。系统仅使用 16 个查询相关记忆 token，在涵盖个性化、长文档和知识密集型问答的 8 项基准中，有 5 项优于 Mem0、MemoRAG 等基线。在 FactKG 上，Memorilla 以少 108 倍的文档表示 token 达到 84.33% 准确率，高于完整上下文推理的 80.43%。在 TextWorld 环境中，该记忆机制减少了智能体重复探索已访问房间的行为，并将平均成功率从完整历史上下文学习的 18.6% 提升至 24.2%。 | 为冻结 LLM 提供参数外长期记忆，无需反复将完整历史或全部文档放入上下文。 通过固定数量的潜在记忆 token 降低长文档问答和长程交互的上下文成本。 可用于持续增长的智能体轨迹，缓解重复探索并提高长程任务成功率。 展示了在压缩信息表示的同时超越完整上下文推理的可能性。 | 标题：Memorilla: Latent Semantic Memory for LLMs 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21375 摘要：Memory enables large language models (LLMs) to use information beyond their parameters, such as past user conversations, long documents, or an agent's earlier actions. For a frozen LLM, access to this accumulated knowledge is limited to what a memory system places in its context window. However, gathering and combining relevant information needed for each query while keeping the model's context short remains challenging for existing systems. Here we introduce Memorilla, a memory system that gathers information from an entire document collection into a fixed number of query-dependent 'memory tokens' for a frozen LLM. Memorilla encodes documents (such as user chats, book chapters) once into reusable embeddings, then learns to retrieve and place query-specific information in the LLM's input e | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21375
title: Memorilla：面向 LLM 的潜在语义记忆

content: 测试时 LLM 集成的双样本规模：缓冲 ERM 与极小极大理论 | 论文从标注问题数 Q 与每模型每问题生成数 N 两种样本规模出发，刻画加权 LLM 集成的缓冲经验风险最小化上界及其分阶段极小极大风险。 | 子主题：测试时优化 | arXiv | 论文研究测试时加权集成中标注问题数 Q 和单模型、单问题生成数 N 如何共同影响无限生成投票规则的总体误差。在边际条件指数为 β 时，带校准边际缓冲的经验风险最小化可取得约为 Q^{-1/2}+N^{-β/2} 的超额风险上界。针对双模型、双候选答案的简化情形，作者利用二项混合实验的 Hellinger 模、​​多项式逼近和谱分析刻画了三个极小极大风险区间。问题较少时 Q^{-1/2} 主导且缓冲 ERM 最优；中间区间可通过跨问题汇总生成计数获得改进，而问题足够多时风险仍受 N^{-β} 的可识别性下限约束。 | 为测试时集成预算分配提供理论依据，说明增加标注问题与增加单题采样次数具有不同的收益曲线。 表明校准边际缓冲能够提升集成权重学习的稳健性，并在问题样本稀缺时达到近极小极大最优。 揭示单纯增加问题数量无法突破由有限生成次数造成的可识别性下限。 提示通用多模型集成可设计跨问题汇总统计量，以改善中间样本区间的估计效率。 | 标题：Two Sample Sizes in Test-Time LLM Ensembling: Buffered ERM and Minimax Theory 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21363 摘要：Test-time scaling can improve the performance of large language models by generating multiple answers to a question and aggregating them. Weighted ensembles extend this idea by drawing answers from several models, with the weights determining how often each model is used. Learning these weights from a training dataset involves two sample sizes: $Q$ labeled questions and $N$ generations per model and question. We study their interplay through the clean risk, the population error of the ensemble's infinite-generation voting rule. Under a margin condition with exponent $β$, we show that empirical risk minimization (ERM) with a calibrated margin buffer achieves excess risk of order $Q^{-1/2}+N^{-β/2}$, up to logarithmic factors, for fixed numbers of models and candidate answers. To investigate | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21363
title: 测试时 LLM 集成的双样本规模：缓冲 ERM 与极小极大理论

content: LTM：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的潜在转移上下文记忆 | LTM将连续观测间的潜在转移压缩为上下文记忆，以较低存储与推理开销增强视觉-语言-动作模型对历史交互和复杂时序信息的利用能力。 | 子主题：长期记忆 | arXiv | LTM以连续观测之间的紧凑潜在转移保存历史，无需记忆专用语义标注或调用外部推理模型。其在π₀.₅上实例化为LTM-π，结合冻结的潜在动作编码器、轻量适配器和因果KV缓存实现增量推理。在RoboMME与LIBERO-Mem上，LTM-π分别取得58.54%和80.5%的成功率；将RoboMME示范扩展十倍后，成功率由57.67%升至87.50%。在200-token记忆预算下仍保持84.00%的成功率，并将真实机器人计数任务的成功率从11.25%提升至82.50%，显示出良好的可扩展性与现实控制能力。 | 为具身智能体提供无需显式文本摘要的紧凑长期记忆表示。 利用潜在状态转移保留交互过程信息，支持计数、物体交换等依赖历史的时序任务。 通过延迟记忆准入、KV缓存与压缩记忆降低长程控制的上下文和推理成本。 结果表明，过程监督和高质量时序示范是提升潜在记忆组合能力的重要因素。 | 标题：LTM: Latent Transition Based In-Context Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21362 摘要：Robotic manipulation often requires remembering interactions that are no longer visible. We introduce Latent Transition Memory (LTM), which stores history as compact latent transitions between consecutive observations. Instantiated on $π_{0.5}$ as LTM-$π$, our method uses a frozen latent action encoder, a lightweight adapter, and causal KV caching for incremental inference without memory-specific semantic annotations or external reasoning-model calls. With DreamDojo transitions, LTM-$π$ achieves 58.54% success on RoboMME and 80.5% on LIBERO-Mem, performing best among baselines without external reasoning models or memory-specific annotations. Ablations support the contribution of transition content beyond temporal cues and the efficiency of delayed memory admission. Scaling RoboMME demonstr | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21362
title: LTM：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的潜在转移上下文记忆

content: ARGUS：议程驱动的可靠用户模拟框架 | ARGUS通过动态议程栈将用户目标状态追踪与自然语言生成解耦，并结合监督微调和在线强化学习提升用户模拟的行为可靠性与部署效率。 | 子主题：状态追踪 | arXiv | ARGUS是一种面向交互式智能体训练与评估的神经符号用户模拟框架，重点解决目标遗漏和策略不合规问题。框架使用符号操作维护动态议程栈，将用户目标状态追踪与自然语言生成严格解耦，以保证目标有序推进和约束一致性。作者进一步采用评估器引导的监督微调与带有稠密步骤级奖励的在线强化学习，将框架蒸馏至紧凑模型。论文提出基于规则量表的综合行为分数（CBS），并在τ³-Bench和MultiWOZ上验证了架构及训练流程的有效性。 | 为交互式智能体提供目标一致、策略合规的高保真模拟用户，可用于训练和自动化评估。 动态议程栈展示了神经符号状态管理在长程对话目标追踪中的应用价值。 状态追踪与语言生成解耦有助于降低目标遗漏，并提升模拟行为的可审计性和可控性。 评估器引导SFT与步骤级在线强化学习可作为低成本用户模拟器蒸馏的通用训练方案。 | 标题：ARGUS: An Agenda-Driven Framework for Reliable User Simulation 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21346 摘要：High-fidelity user simulators are essential for evaluating and training agents in interactive environments. However, current LLM-based simulators struggle with reliability issues, such as goal omission and policy non-compliance. We propose ARGUS (Agenda-dRiven Goal-oriented User Simulator), a neuro-symbolic framework that maintains the user's goal state using a dynamic agenda stack manipulated via symbolic operations. By rigorously decoupling state tracking from natural language generation, ARGUS facilitates strict goal progression and constraint-aligned interactions. For cost-efficient deployment, we distill ARGUS into compact models using a unified pipeline: evaluator-guided SFT followed by online RL with dense step-level rewards. To rigorously evaluate behavioral fidelity, we introduce | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21346
title: ARGUS：议程驱动的可靠用户模拟框架

content: OpCredit：面向智能体知识图谱问答的操作感知策略学习 | OpCredit通过分支结果信用与前沿转移信用对知识图谱问答轨迹中的单步操作进行细粒度归因，从而提升智能体策略学习效果。 | 子主题：信用分配 | arXiv | Agentic KGQA需要连续执行知识图谱操作，但轨迹级奖励无法准确反映每个操作的实际贡献。OpCredit结合分支结果信用（BOC）与前沿转移信用（FTC）：前者在匹配的导航上下文中比较不同操作之后的终局奖励，后者衡量操作引起的答案条件化前沿潜力变化。两类信号共同监督训练轨迹中相应的决策片段，推理阶段则只需学习后的策略和标准知识图谱接口。该框架在ComplexWebQuestions、WebQSP和GrailQA上使用三种骨干模型均取得稳定提升。 | 为长轨迹智能体提供操作级信用分配，避免将终局奖励笼统归因于全部步骤。 可利用已有普通 rollout 构造细粒度监督，无需在推理阶段引入额外评估组件。 为知识图谱导航、工具调用等包含离散操作序列的智能体训练提供可迁移的策略优化思路。 | 标题：OpCredit: Operation-Aware Policy Learning for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21345 摘要：Agentic knowledge graph question answering(KGQA) relies on sequences of executable operations, but trajectory-level rewards obscure their individual contributions. Successful trajectories may contain ineffective operations, while failed trajectories may contain useful ones. To assess individual operations, we propose OpCredit, an operationaware policy-learning framework that combines downstream outcome credit with immediate transition credit: Branch Outcome Credit (BOC) reuses ordinary rollouts to compare terminal task rewards observed after different operations under matched navigation contexts; Frontier Transition Credit (FTC) measures operation-induced changes in answer-conditioned frontier potential. The two complementary signals jointly supervise the corresponding decision spans durin | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21345
title: OpCredit：面向智能体知识图谱问答的操作感知策略学习

content: 注意力头排序与分区实现稀疏持续强化学习微调 | 通过梯度范数排序并按任务分配注意力头，以少量参数更新实现高效强化学习微调，同时降低任务间干扰并保持旧能力。 | 子主题：持续学习 | arXiv | 论文研究语言模型的稀疏与持续强化学习微调，核心是对注意力头进行排序和任务间分区。稀疏学习阶段依据梯度范数识别最具训练价值的少量注意力头，高排名头的微调效果持续优于低排名头，并常能匹配更稠密的微调基线。持续学习阶段将不同注意力头分配给不同任务，从而减少跨任务参数更新的相互干扰。数学、指令遵循和代码任务实验表明，该策略在适应新任务的同时改善了既有能力的保留。 | 为强化学习微调提供基于梯度范数的参数选择依据，减少需要更新的注意力头数量。 通过按任务隔离注意力头缓解灾难性遗忘，提升持续学习中的能力保持率。 启示参数高效微调可从统一的低秩更新扩展到结构化、任务专属的注意力头更新。 | 标题：Ranking and Partitioning of Attention Heads for Sparse and Continual Reinforcement Learning Fine-tuning 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21336 摘要：We study sparse and continual reinforcement learning fine-tuning of language models through attention-head ranking and partitioning. For sparse learning, we rank attention heads by gradient norm to identify a small subset of heads that can be trained effectively. For continual learning, we partition heads across tasks to reduce cross-task interference and preserve previously learned capabilities. Theoretically, we relate gradient norm to training effectiveness, and further characterize why sparse, separated head updates can remain stable. Empirically, across math, instruction-following, and coding tasks, tuning higher-ranked heads consistently outperforms tuning lower-ranked ones while often matching denser baselines, and head partitioning improves retention while preserving adaptation to | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21336
title: 注意力头排序与分区实现稀疏持续强化学习微调

content: ZoomCap：证据路由视觉缩放实现可恢复视觉信息迁移 | ZoomCap通过证据路由、OCR感知读取与自适应视觉缩放生成高事实密度的细粒度图像描述，并显著提升视觉语言模型的持续预训练和医疗预训练效果。 | 子主题：数据合成 | arXiv | ZoomCap将细粒度图像描述建模为有限观察预算下的可恢复视觉信息迁移，由教师模型主动获取缺失证据并转化为可复用监督。系统根据描述草稿路由知识检索、OCR感知读取、覆盖缺口恢复和自适应视觉缩放，仅对最复杂的合格区域分配深层裁剪，并基于接地几何推导空间关系。配套的FactCycle从源图像真实性与重建可实现性两个盲锚点评估原子事实，以区分描述虚构和生成器重建损失。ZoomCap平均每张图像迁移52.4条事实，在持续预训练、生产文档/OCR监控及医疗VQA任务上均优于竞争描述语料。 | 为视觉语言模型构建比单次长描述更高覆盖、更少幻觉的细粒度监督数据。 通过按证据缺口分配视觉缩放预算，提高小物体、文字和空间关系的恢复效率。 FactCycle可用于事实级描述质量审计，分别衡量真实性与信息可重建性。 实验表明，高事实密度描述数据能够迁移至通用视觉语言预训练、文档OCR和医疗视觉问答场景。 | 标题：ZoomCap: Evidence-Routed Visual Zooming for Recoverable Visual Information Transfer 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21320 摘要：Detailed captions transfer visual information into vision-language model supervision, but quality is easily conflated with length: long single-pass outputs still miss small objects, text, and spatial relations or promote uncertain observations into confident claims. We formulate fine-grained captioning as recoverable visual information transfer, in which a teacher acquires missing evidence under a finite observation budget and converts it into reusable supervision. ZoomCap uses a draft caption to route conditional knowledge retrieval, OCR-sensitive reading, coverage-gap recovery, and adaptive visual zooming, allocating deeper crops only to the most complex eligible region, deriving spatial relations from grounded geometry, and fusing non-duplicate evidence. We also introduce FactCycle, whi | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21320
title: ZoomCap：证据路由视觉缩放实现可恢复视觉信息迁移

content: 多智能体聚合中的偏差控制与注入 | 研究通过控制回答风格偏差并主动注入少数派压力，将智能体决策的不稳定性转化为可靠性信号，实现无需验证数据和模型强度先验的测试时聚合。 | 子主题：多智能体系统 | arXiv | 研究分析了多数压力和回答风格偏好等非语义偏差如何干扰多智能体分歧决策。框架首先对推理轨迹进行风格归一化，并为每个不同答案仅展示一条轨迹，以控制初始答案选择中的偏差。随后将聚合智能体最初选择的答案置于少数派位置，通过偏差注入诱发决策变化，并以决策不稳定性衡量答案可靠性。该方法在三个数学推理基准和四种异构 LLM 组合上提升了平均准确率与词元效率，也能在不改变交互流程的情况下改进多智能体辩论和 Mixture-of-Agents 的最终答案。 | 为缺少验证集或模型能力先验的多智能体系统提供测试时答案聚合方案。 将通常需要消除的群体偏差转化为可靠性探测工具，用于识别不稳定决策。 可作为多智能体辩论和 Mixture-of-Agents 的外接聚合层，无需修改原有交互与综合流程。 风格归一化与按不同答案筛选轨迹有助于降低冗余上下文和推理词元成本。 | 标题：Bias Control and Injection for Multi-Agent Aggregation 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21290 摘要：Multi-agent reasoning with large language models (LLMs) raises a central question for collective decision-making: when agents disagree, whose decision should be trusted? Resolving such disagreements is difficult because agents' decisions are susceptible to non-semantic biases such as majority pressure and response-style preferences, which can obscure the quality of the underlying reasoning. Our analysis shows how bias can be both mitigated and exploited: bias control improves initial answer selection, while bias injection elicits decision instability that serves as a reliability signal. Building on these findings, we introduce a test-time aggregation framework that requires neither validation data nor prior knowledge of relative model strength. The framework implements bias control by pres | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21290
title: 多智能体聚合中的偏差控制与注入

content: 思维密度：预测与引导大模型推理 | 研究发现思维链信息密度与答案正确性的关系受训练范式显著影响，并提出基于熵门控的自监督密度路由方法，在无外部指导下将准确率提升10个百分点。 | 子主题：思维链 | arXiv | 研究使用平均逐词负对数似然的方差（LP variance）和 Caveman 压缩率，衡量思维链各推理步骤的信息密度，并在六种模型规模、两类训练范式及60道 GSM8K 问题上开展实验。较低的 LP 方差可预测 SFT 模型的正确性，但该关系随规模增大而减弱，并在 RL 蒸馏模型中反转，说明训练范式比模型规模更能决定密度行为。直接在生成过程中强制改变密度会使准确率从60.0%降至8.3%，表明自然形成的密度模式对推理具有功能性作用。结合提示注入与对比式 KV-cache 引导的生成前干预可提升13.3个百分点；进一步提出的熵门控密度路由（EGDR）利用词元级 Shannon 熵动态调节 KV-cache，在无需外部指导时提升10.0个百分点。 | 可将思维链信息密度作为推理正确性的诊断信号，但应针对 SFT、RL 蒸馏等不同训练范式分别校准。 直接把相关统计量作为硬性优化目标可能破坏模型自然推理结构，提示“可预测”不等于“可直接操控”。 EGDR 展示了利用词元熵和 KV-cache 实施自监督测试时干预的可行路径，可用于低成本推理优化。 后续应在更大规模题集、更多推理任务及不同模型家族上验证密度指标的泛化性。 | 标题：The Density of Thought: Predicting and Steering Reasoning in Large Language Models 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21286 摘要：We investigate whether variation in information density across chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning steps predicts answer correctness and can serve as a controllable inference-time target. We prompt frozen pretrained models to solve problems via CoT and measure the density of each reasoning step with two independent metrics: LP variance (how unevenly information is distributed across steps, computed as the variance in mean per-token negative log-likelihood) and the Caveman compression ratio. We then test whether density correlates with, and can be steered to improve, answer correctness. Experiments across six model scales, two training paradigms, and 60 GSM8K problems yield four main findings. First, lower LP variance predicts correctness in supervised fine-tuned (SFT) models, but this relatio | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21286
title: 思维密度：预测与引导大模型推理

content: Mallea：用编程智能体构建、操控与记忆世界 | Mallea 通过编程智能体统一规划对象结构、交互规则与视觉记忆，实现可由文本构建、持续编辑并保持状态一致性的代码世界模型。 | 子主题：世界模型 | arXiv | Mallea 将世界动力学表示为显式状态与可执行规则，并由编程智能体从文本提示中推断对象交互需求。系统联合规划对象结构、属性和行为规则，以紧凑表示支持世界持续演化及用户动作干预。文本请求可以修改属性或扩展能力，同时保留未受影响的既有状态。对象纹理记忆为白盒定义的对象复用并更新外观，生成式渲染器则结合当前结构与记忆外观生成一致的后续观察。 | 为可编辑、可执行的代码世界模型提供对象中心的统一系统设计。 支持在能力扩展或规则修改过程中保留未受影响状态，提升交互式世界的连续性。 将结构化状态、行为规则与视觉记忆解耦后再协同，可为游戏生成、交互仿真和智能体环境设计提供参考。 | 标题：Mallea: Building, Steering, and Memorizing Worlds with Coding Agent 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21283 摘要：Code world models represent world dynamics through explicit state and executable rules. We investigate how to coordinate object representations, behavioral revisions, and visual memory within this formulation. We present Mallea, a system for building, steering, and memorizing worlds from text. A coding agent infers object interaction requirements from the prompt and jointly plans object structure, properties, and rules, favoring compact representations that support those requirements. The world evolves under the planned rules; optional user actions steer it, while text requests can edit properties or extend capabilities with unaffected state preserved. Object texture memory retains reusable appearance only for whitebox-defined objects and adapts it as those objects change. The program adva | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21283
title: Mallea：用编程智能体构建、操控与记忆世界

content: TimeCap：可扩展的可穿戴健康时序数据标注流水线 | TimeCap以无需语言模型参与的确定性流水线生成可复现的可穿戴健康时序描述，并基于其构建大规模MHCap语料以提升健康结局预测性能。 | 子主题：数据合成 | arXiv | TimeCap是一套直接基于信号运行的开源确定性描述生成流水线，包含三个可复用的特征提取层级和一个跨通道综合层。该方案无需调用语言模型，只需编写通道定义即可适配新的数据模式，因此生成结果可重新推导、扩展和审计。作者将其应用于MyHeart Counts可穿戴设备数据集OpenMHC，构建了MHCap，覆盖19个Apple HealthKit通道、908,944个人日和7,005,763条描述。基于MHCap训练的OpenTSLM-Cap在8项健康任务的32组逐用户二分类评估中，有29组优于仅使用标签训练的基线。 | 为时序语言模型提供可复现、可审计且易扩展的信号—文本配对数据生成方案。 降低使用闭源语言模型标注时产生的不可再现性与数据溯源风险。 证明描述增强训练能够改善可穿戴数据上的健康结局预测，为医疗时序基础模型的数据构建提供参考。 | 标题：TimeCap: A Scalable Open-Source Pipeline for Captioning Wearable Health Time-Series Data 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21274 摘要：Time-series data generated continuously across industrial, environmental, and especially health domains produce multimodal signals whose scale and heterogeneity make their processing and interpretation particularly challenging. Time-Series Language Models (TSLMs) promise scalable interpretation of these signals, yet remain bottlenecked by a fundamental lack of text-annotated time series pairs that are signal-grounded, reproducible, and extensible across modalities and schemas. Existing paired corpora are either closed or limited in scale and modality coverage. Annotation with large language models could scale them up, but its outputs cannot be regenerated exactly, which prevents others from re-deriving, extending, or auditing the resulting corpus. To address this, we release TimeCap, an op | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21274
title: TimeCap：可扩展的可穿戴健康时序数据标注流水线

content: 医疗 LLM 智能体升级处置可靠性审计基准 | 该研究通过400个受控扰动的合成医疗工作流回合评估LLM智能体的升级处置能力，发现静态决策准确率较高并不代表其能可靠识别证据缺失、过期或冲突等高风险状态。 | 子主题：医疗人工智能评测 | arXiv | 研究构建了400个合成医疗工作流回合，覆盖4类任务、40个语义种子、2种表面参数化和5种受控变体，并评估回答、澄清、拒答和升级处置四类动作。在5个1.7B至9.7B开放权重配置中，干净场景决策准确率最高达0.97，但面对不确定性时仍漏掉32%至97%的必要升级；9.7B配置在冲突条件下准确率由0.97降至0.78。模型口头置信度对失败的指示能力有限，单纯基于置信度的策略未带来效用提升，而显式感知工作流状态的控制器可将漏升级率降至0.12至0.24。该控制器对未见释义的规则检测召回率从1.00降至0.00，且参考动作仅由单一作者按研究策略标注、未经临床专家裁决，因此结论仍受基准构造与泛化能力限制。 | 将医疗智能体评估从静态问答准确率扩展到证据缺失、过期、冲突和延迟条件下的工作流动作可靠性。 提醒部署方分别衡量漏升级与不必要升级，并依据实际风险设定非对称成本函数。 表明口头置信度不足以充当可靠路由信号，显式工作流状态控制可能更有效。 对规则控制器本身进行释义压力测试，避免因触发词匹配而高估其真实泛化能力。 后续基准应引入临床专家多方裁决和真实医疗流程数据，以增强标签效度与外部有效性。 | 标题：Auditing Escalation Reliability in Healthcare LLM Agents: A Perturbation-Controlled Benchmark of Workflow-State Failures 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21270 摘要：Trustworthy biomedical AI requires reliable action selection when evidence is missing, stale, conflicting, or late, not only accurate answers on static inputs. We instantiate an episode-level evaluation protocol as 400 synthetic healthcare workflow episodes: 40 hand-authored semantic seeds across four task classes, two surface parameterizations, and five controlled variants, scored on ANSWER/ASK CLARIFICATION/ABSTAIN/ESCALATE under a pre-declared 5:1 missed-versus-unnecessary escalation cost. Reference actions are single-author study-policy labels, not clinician-adjudicated ground truth. Across five open-weight configurations (1.7B--9.7B), clean decision accuracy reaches 0.97, yet uncertainty-prompted models miss 32--97% of required escalations. The stronger 9.7B configuration narrows but | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21270
title: 医疗 LLM 智能体升级处置可靠性审计基准

content: TRACER：面向智能体轨迹的工具检索 | TRACER利用工具调用轨迹构建Trie索引并融合经验与上下文先验，在仅暴露少量候选工具的情况下提升选择准确率并显著降低输入词元成本。 | 子主题：工具调用 | arXiv | TRACER是一个面向LLM智能体的工具检索前端，将历史工具调用序列组织为Trie，并对可能的后续调用进行排序。其排序机制学习融合经验先验与上下文先验，从大型工具注册表中仅向模型暴露少量候选工具。在零售与电信混合的τ²环境中，系统仅暴露128个工具中的5个，使GPT-5.4的工具选择准确率提高4.7个百分点，同时将单步输入词元减少80%。在自主完整轮次执行中，它以单步输入词元减少61%的成本达到完整工具注册表方案的任务成功率；跨六个环境和四个模型的24组实验中，有21组取得准确率提升。 | 为大型工具注册表提供轨迹感知的候选裁剪机制，缓解工具数量增长导致的上下文成本与选择干扰。 表明历史执行轨迹可作为工具路由先验，在减少输入词元的同时改善工具选择准确率。 可用于企业级智能体、客服智能体等工具密集场景，以兼顾任务成功率、推理成本和系统扩展性。 Trie索引与上下文排序的组合可为后续工具检索、技能检索及执行轨迹复用研究提供设计参考。 | 标题：TRACER: Trajectory-Aware Tool Retrieval for LLM Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21267 摘要：Modern agents select tools from registries, but exposing entire registries incurs high token costs and can impair selection as they grow. We present TRACER, a retrieval front-end that indexes observed tool-call sequences in a trie and ranks continuations using a learned blend of empirical and contextual priors. On a mixed retail-and-telecom $τ^2$ environment, TRACER improves GPT-5.4's tool-selection accuracy by 4.7 points while reducing input tokens per step by 80%, exposing just 5 of 128 tools. In autonomous full-turn execution, it matches GPT-5.4's full-registry task success with 61% fewer input tokens per step. Across six environments and four models, TRACER improves tool-selection accuracy over full-registry selection in 21 of 24 model-environment pairs, with average gains of 6 to 10 p | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21267
title: TRACER：面向智能体轨迹的工具检索

content: LLM 弱标注用于网络安全推文分类：教师-学生框架 | 该研究以 LLM 为教师生成网络安全推文弱标签，并用其训练领域专用学生模型，在减少专家标注需求的同时取得接近全人工监督的分类性能。 | 子主题：数据合成 | arXiv | 研究面向网络威胁情报场景，解决社交媒体安全内容快速增长所造成的专家标注瓶颈。作者提出教师-学生弱监督框架，由选定的 LLM 为未标注网络安全推文生成弱标签，再据此训练网络安全领域的预训练语言模型。实验中，仅使用 LLM 标签训练的学生模型在所有受测架构上均取得超过 0.92 的 F1 分数。其性能与完全依赖人工标签的监督模型相比差距不超过 3 个百分点，表明弱标注可作为低成本训练数据构建方案。 | 降低网络安全推文分类对稀缺领域专家标注的依赖。 为网络威胁情报系统快速扩充领域训练数据提供可落地方案。 说明 LLM 弱标签能够有效监督较小的领域专用学生模型，并保持接近人工监督的性能。 可用于构建面向新漏洞与攻击活动的持续更新分类流水线。 | 标题：LLM-Based Weak Annotation for Cybersecurity Tweet Classification: A Teacher-Student Framework 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21254 摘要：Cyber threat intelligence (CTI) relies on the timely identification of emerging threats, enabling organizations and security analysts to support situational awareness and decision-making. Social media platforms such as X (formerly Twitter) have become valuable CTI sources because vulnerabilities and attack activities are often discussed there before appearing in formal reports. However, the rapid growth of cybersecurity discussions on social media has created more content than domain experts can realistically review and annotate, making labeled data a major bottleneck for developing supervised learning approaches. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise as weak annotators in other domains, their effectiveness for cybersecurity tweet classification and downstream training of d | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21254
title: LLM 弱标注用于网络安全推文分类：教师-学生框架

content: FGSS-BO：面向 LLM 贝叶斯优化的反馈引导假设管理 | FGSS-BO通过显式维护、验证和更新搜索假设，将语言指导转化为可执行参数干预，并在部分任务上提升贝叶斯优化的搜索效果与可审查性。 | 子主题：贝叶斯优化 | arXiv | FGSS提出结构化的反馈引导搜索状态，将语言形式的假设与观测证据、参数干预及支持度更新关联起来。系统由负责提出和修订假设的 LLM reflector，以及验证假设、维护身份和测试记录的确定性 curator 组成。FGSS-BO基于 LLAMBO 实现，保留原有代理模型和默认期望改进准则，并加入有界假设测试策略。在两个回溯性任务上，其最终最优值和搜索 AUC 优于对照方法；六个直接训练的超参数优化任务则呈现任务相关的迁移效果。 | 将优化过程中的隐式搜索方向转化为可追踪、可验证的显式假设，便于审计跨轮次修订。 为 LLM 与传统贝叶斯优化组件的结合提供结构化接口，降低自然语言建议难以执行和复现的问题。 实验显示收益具有任务依赖性，实际应用时应针对响应预言机、测试预算和目标任务验证各组件贡献。 | 标题：FGSS-BO: Feedback-Guided Hypothesis Management for LLM-Based Bayesian Optimization 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21246 摘要：Large language model (LLM)-guided Bayesian optimization (BO) uses past observations to guide search, but proposed directions and their revision can remain implicit. We propose Feedback-Guided Search State (FGSS), a structured hypothesis-management interface connecting language-based guidance to observed evidence, executable parameter interventions, and comparative support updates. An LLM reflector proposes and revises hypotheses; a deterministic curator validates them and maintains identities and test records. The evolving state guides candidate construction and priorities. Instantiated on LLAMBO, FGSS-BO retains its surrogate and default expected improvement selection, with a bounded testing policy. On two retrospective protocol/media tasks with nearest-neighbor response oracles, it attai | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21246
title: FGSS-BO：面向 LLM 贝叶斯优化的反馈引导假设管理

content: 面向去中心化多智能体系统的责任中心协调机制 RCM | RCM 通过承诺机制将任务委派与各方责任显式绑定，在无中心控制的情况下维持委派链问责，并提升任务表现及故障与危害检测能力。 | 子主题：多智能体协作框架 | arXiv | RCM 以承诺为核心，将任务委派与委派双方的明确责任绑定，解决去中心化多智能体系统中依赖关系和故障恢复责任不清的问题。智能体在递归委派时保留上游责任，同时在本地组织下游承诺，从而形成可追责的局部协调网络。该机制通过责任约束决策和责任导向通信协议 RCP，使智能体能够自主建立、管理和终止承诺，并借助持续演化的承诺图实现全局协调。推理、编程和可执行智能体环境中的实验显示，RCM 相比强基线最高提升 18.7 个任务表现点和 10.2 个责任性指标点，且无需任务特定训练即可改善故障与危害检测。 | 为去中心化多智能体系统提供兼顾可扩展性、适应性与责任追踪的协调机制。 可利用承诺图审计递归委派链，定位依赖失效、责任归属及恢复主体。 责任约束决策与 RCP 协议可作为现有多智能体执行框架的通信和治理层。 实验结果表明，显式责任建模可能同时改善协作性能、故障检测和安全性。 | 标题：A Responsibility-Centered Coordination Mechanism for Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21243 摘要：Centralized orchestration provides comprehensive multi-agent coordination but creates bottlenecks in scalability, adaptability, and collective performance. Decentralized approaches alleviate these bottlenecks by distributing coordination across agents, yet often leave responsibility for delegated dependencies and failure recovery unclear. To address this gap, we propose RCM, a responsibility-centered coordination mechanism that leverages commitments to couple task delegation with explicit responsibilities of the involved parties. Through recursive delegation, agents retain their upstream responsibilities while locally orchestrating downstream commitments, thereby preserving accountability across delegation chains, creating a network of local orchestration. We operationalize this mechanism | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21243
title: 面向去中心化多智能体系统的责任中心协调机制 RCM

content: 兼容性很重要：在策略蒸馏中的词元级教师选择框架 | 该工作从师生推理兼容性、教师能力与学生输出多样性出发，提出在策略蒸馏中的词元级教师动态路由框架，并在数学、编程、内核生成和视觉推理任务上取得最高逾 10 个百分点的 pass@k 提升。 | 子主题：在策略蒸馏 | arXiv | 论文突破每次提示 rollout 固定使用单一教师的传统做法，利用在策略蒸馏的灵活性，在生成过程中按词元动态选择教师。框架将师生推理模式兼容性、教师能力以及教师对学生多样性的影响纳入统一分析。作者对多类教师路由方案进行了理论分类，并证明不同条件下适宜的路由策略会对优化效率和输出多样性产生不同影响。数学、代码、内核生成和视觉推理实验显示，该方法在部分任务上的 pass@k 相比标准 OPD及教师专家提升超过 10 个百分点。 | 为多教师在策略蒸馏提供细粒度路由依据，避免将整条生成轨迹绑定到单一教师。 表明教师选择不应只依据能力强弱，还需评估其与学生推理模式的兼容性。 可用于在持续学习中同时提升学生能力与高质量响应的多样性。 为后续研究自适应教师路由、多教师蒸馏和词元级信用分配提供理论框架。 | 标题：Compatibility Matters: A Framework for Token-Level Teacher Selection in On-Policy Distillation 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21234 摘要：On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently been introduced as a promising paradigm for continual learning, where a student policy can be supervised at the token-level. Typically, OPD is performed using a single teacher per prompt rollout (or even per training run). However, this ignores a whole other axis of flexibility that is available due to the on-policy nature - token-level teacher selection during rollouts. Building on this insight, we theoretically explore what makes a teacher and a student compatible for OPD, and leverage our findings to derive several empirical heuristics for teacher selection. In particular, our framework captures several desiderata for OPD: compatible teacher-student reasoning patterns, teacher competence, and induced student diversity. Theoretically, we categori | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21234
title: 兼容性很重要：在策略蒸馏中的词元级教师选择框架

content: URW：基于保形校准的不确定性感知 Rubric 评判加权 | 提出免训练的 URW 框架，以保形校准量化各项 Rubric 评判的不确定性并进行差异化加权，从而提升偏好判断准确率和下游强化学习对齐效果。 | 子主题：置信度评估 | arXiv | Rubric 评估通常将多个标准的二元判断统一聚合，但不同标准的判断确定性存在显著差异，等权处理可能产生误导性的奖励信号。URW 从固定的改写评判模板池中提取软不确定性信号，无需额外训练。该框架通过 split-conformal p-values 将不确定性转换为逐标准权重，并提供可证明的覆盖率保证。实验表明，URW 能持续提高成对偏好判断准确率，并改善下游强化学习的对齐表现。 | 为基于 Rubric 的 LLM 评估加入标准粒度的不确定性建模，避免低置信判断与高置信判断被等权聚合。 可用于改进奖励估计质量，为强化学习和偏好对齐提供更可靠的训练信号。 展示了保形校准在 LLM 评判系统中的免训练应用路径，并兼具统计覆盖保证。 | 标题：Rubric Judgments Lack Uncertainty: Conformal Weighting for LLM Evaluation 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21214 摘要：Rubric-based evaluation is widely used to assess large language model (LLM) outputs by decomposing quality into multiple criteria and assigning each a binary judgment from an LLM verifier. However, judgment certainty varies substantially across criteria. Existing methods uniformly aggregate these judgments into a final score, implicitly treating every criterion as equally certain and overlooking this heterogeneity. As a result, uncertain judgments remain incorporated into reward estimation without distinction, potentially yielding misleading training signals for downstream reinforcement learning (RL). To address this limitation, we propose Uncertainty-aware Rubric Weighting (URW), a training-free framework that quantifies criterion-level judgment uncertainty via conformal calibration. Spec | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21214
title: URW：基于保形校准的不确定性感知 Rubric 评判加权

content: 先采纳，再取消：思考如何让推理模型字面理解 some 与 or | 增加思考量会使多数受测推理模型及 GPT-5 后期取消 some 和 or 的会话含义而转向字面逻辑解读，但有助于改善依赖上下文的间接回答推断。 | 子主题：推理评测 | arXiv | 研究在固定模型权重的条件下仅改变思考量，观察推理模型如何解释 some 和 or 等逻辑词。结果显示，随着思考推进，多数开放推理模型及 GPT-5 会取消“some 意味着 not all”和“or 意味着 not both”等会话含义，转向字面逻辑解读。通过在连续节点截断推理轨迹并要求作答，作者发现模型通常先采纳语用增强解读，随后再将其取消。探索性干预表明，从较早阶段的解读作答可以恢复这些含义，同时不损害字面理解准确率。 | 揭示增加推理预算并不必然改善语言理解，反而可能系统性削弱标量含义等日常语用推断。 提示推理模型评估除答案准确率外，还应测量模型对问题与逻辑词的解释方式。 可利用推理轨迹截断或早期答案选择，在推理时保留语用含义并兼顾字面准确性。 为研究测试时计算对语言推理行为的阶段性影响提供可操作的诊断方法。 | 标题：Entertain, then Cancel: How Thinking Makes Reasoning Models Read Some and Or Literally 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21204 摘要：When a speaker says ``some students passed'', listeners infer that not all of them did. Reasoning models now let users decide how long a model thinks before it answers, but we do not know what extra thinking does to such everyday inferences. We study this directly: we keep a model's weights fixed, change only how much it thinks, and record which reading it chooses. A second tool cuts the model's own reasoning at successive points and asks for an answer, showing where the reading changes. Thinking makes models read logical words as logic: it cancels the implicatures of \emph{some} (\emph{not all}) and \emph{or} (\emph{not both}) in most tested open reasoning models and in GPT-5, while context-driven inferences such as indirect answers improve. The trace shows why: models first entertain the | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21204
title: 先采纳，再取消：思考如何让推理模型字面理解 some 与 or

content: 最难样本训练的可证明优势：仅保留 2N 个样本实现最优误差率 | 论文建立加权经验风险最小化下的数据剪枝理论，证明在高样本区间仅保留 2N 个最难训练样本，可将分类测试误差从 √(N/P) 加速至贝叶斯最优的 N/P 量级。 | 子主题：数据策展 | arXiv | 论文从高维渐近视角研究数据剪枝，将剪枝建模为沿输入空间一维子空间进行的加权经验风险最小化。作者在输入维度 N 与样本量 P 按固定比例增长时，精确刻画了测试误差的极限曲线，并统一解释了多项既有结果。理论分析揭示了剪枝策略、损失函数和标签噪声之间的相互作用。在 P 远大于 N 的高样本区间，最优策略是丢弃几乎全部数据，仅保留严格意义上最难的 2N 个训练样本，使非指数尾损失下的误差率由 √(N/P) 改进至 N/P。 | 为“训练数据越多越好”的直觉提供反例，说明高信息量困难样本可能比大量冗余样本更有价值。 为数据剪枝和训练集压缩提供可证明的样本选择原则，可用于降低训练成本。 提示实际数据策展系统应联合考虑样本难度、损失函数与标签噪声，而非仅按单一难度指标机械筛选。 可作为设计困难样本挖掘、样本重加权及主动数据选择算法的理论依据。 | 标题：Hard Way, The Only Way: Provable Merits of Training on Hardest Examples 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21201 摘要：Despite a surge of empirical interest in the ``unreasonable effectiveness'' of drastic data pruning for AI systems, a unified theoretical understanding of this phenomenon remains elusive. In this work, we provide a precise high-dimensional theory of learning under data pruning via weighted empirical risk minimization (ERM). As in previous work, we analyze a setting where pruning is performed along a one-dimensional subspace of the input space. Our analysis precisely characterizes the limiting test error curves in the regime where the input dimension N and sample size P tend to infinity with a fixed ratio N/P. The resulting theory recovers several recent results in the literature as special cases and provides a general lens to evaluate how pruning strategies interact with the loss function | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21201
title: 最难样本训练的可证明优势：仅保留 2N 个样本实现最优误差率

content: CCE-OPD：条件对比外推的在策略蒸馏 | CCE-OPD通过对比完整问题与条件遮蔽问题下的教师分布，使在策略蒸馏更关注题目条件并减少违反前提的错误推理。 | 子主题：在策略蒸馏 | arXiv | 在策略蒸馏使用学生自身生成的轨迹，并由更强教师提供监督，但教师面对学生生成的前缀时可能偏好违反题目条件的无效续写。CCE-OPD让同一个冻结教师分别评估完整问题和遮蔽选定条件后的对应问题，以识别续写对关键条件的敏感程度。该方法利用有界对数概率对比重新加权教师分布，构造辅助蒸馏目标。在200个诊断推理状态上，无效续写偏好率由27.0%降至16.0%；在六个数学基准上，将Qwen3-8B蒸馏至0.6B和1.7B学生时，avg@8相对OPD平均提升1.60和1.95个百分点，并在四个迁移基准上取得最佳结果。 | 降低教师在学生生成前缀下忽视题目约束、传播错误推理步骤的风险。 为数学推理模型蒸馏提供无需额外教师的条件敏感监督机制。 可将条件遮蔽对比用于识别前提依赖，并提升小型学生模型的迁移能力与推理可靠性。 | 标题：Condition-Contrastive Extrapolation for On-Policy Distillation of Language Models 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21195 摘要：On-policy distillation (OPD) improves a student language model by training on its own generated trajectories with supervision from a stronger teacher. However, when conditioned on student-generated prefixes, the teacher can favor invalid continuations that violate the question's premises, causing OPD to encourage erroneous reasoning steps. As a remedy, we introduce Condition-Contrastive Extrapolated On-Policy Distillation (CCE-OPD), which makes teacher supervision sensitive to question conditions. CCE-OPD incorporates (1) a fixed-prefix comparison in which the same frozen teacher evaluates the complete question and a counterpart with a selected condition masked, and (2) a bounded log-probability contrast that reweights the teacher distribution into an auxiliary distillation target. On 200 | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21195
title: CCE-OPD：条件对比外推的在策略蒸馏

content: Beyond Retrieval Failure：多跳 RAG 为何遗漏关键证据 | 研究揭示多跳 RAG 的证据遗漏常源于搜索偏离未解子问题，而在证据恢复后，系统瓶颈会进一步转向证据充分性验证。 | 子主题：多跳推理 | arXiv | 论文区分了多跳 RAG 中两类表面相似的失败：检索器无法访问所需段落，以及智能体因搜索漂移而未发出正确查询。作者提出无需训练的 ExecutionRAG，通过需求寄存器持续记录尚未解决的子问题及其支持证据，在不改变检索器、语料库和生成模型的情况下调整搜索方向。在 1,000 道 MuSiQue 问题上，该方法显著减少了错误答案中关键证据未被检索的情况，证明许多所谓的检索失败其实是搜索引导失败。但证据恢复并未带来同比例的总体错误下降，因为过早作答和拒答有所增加，剩余瓶颈由证据获取转向证据充分性验证。 | 评估多跳 RAG 时，应将证据不可达与查询生成导致的搜索漂移分开测量，避免笼统归因于检索器。 可通过显式维护开放子问题和证据覆盖状态，提升长链检索过程的可控性与可审计性。 仅提高证据召回率不足以保证答案正确，还需加入证据充分性检查、未完成子问题检测和作答时机控制。 ExecutionRAG 的受控变量设计可用于诊断更换检索器、嵌入模型或智能体策略后的真实收益来源。 | 标题：Beyond Retrieval Failure: Understanding Why LLMs Miss Evidence in Multi-Hop RAG 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21184 摘要：Multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) requires an agent to retrieve evidence for a sequence of dependent sub-questions. When a wrong answer lacks a required passage, the passage may be inaccessible to the retriever, or the agent may have failed to issue a query that would retrieve it. Standard retrieval evaluations conflate these two causes. We study how much apparent retrieval failure is instead caused by search drift: the search no longer tracks an unanswered sub-question. Holding the retriever, corpus, and generation model fixed, we introduce ExecutionRAG, a training-free requirement register that records open sub-questions and their supporting evidence. The register changes search guidance but not evidence access, so each gold passage it recovers certifies that the passage was | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21184
title: Beyond Retrieval Failure：多跳 RAG 为何遗漏关键证据

content: 潜在思维链真的在推理吗？潜在推理的统一分类体系 | 研究通过因果干预、探针与轨迹分析揭示潜在思维链的可解码内容并不必然参与答案生成，并提出区分表征内容、使用方式与状态变化的统一分类体系。 | 子主题：思维链 | arXiv | 研究覆盖三种训练方案、三类推理任务和两种骨干网络，共计 21 种模型—任务配置，并结合思维链删除、内容替换、探针和轨迹分析开展验证。在逻辑任务中，COCONUT 的答案往往在潜在链开始前就已可读，隐藏状态较早收敛，删除潜在链也几乎不改变预测。逐步监督虽能形成有序的推理状态并增强模型对链的依赖，但部分链仍可能只是占位符：删除会损害性能，而替换其内容却不影响答案；相比之下，算术任务中的各类训练方案都表现出对链内容的依赖。论文据此提出统一分类体系，分别刻画潜在链是否被模型使用、其中表征了什么，以及状态轨迹如何变化。 | 提醒研究者不能仅凭中间状态可解码或任务准确率较高，就断言潜在思维链执行了真实推理。 可将链删除与内容替换结合，以区分潜在链的因果作用、内容依赖和占位符效应。 为比较不同潜在推理工作提供统一维度，解释占位符、表征坍缩和逐步因果作用等看似冲突的发现。 表明潜在推理机制会随任务类型和训练方案变化，评估结论不宜跨设置直接外推。 | 标题：Does Latent Chain-of-Thought Actually Reason? A Single, Unifying Taxonomy for Latent Reasoning 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21182 摘要：Latent chain-of-thought replaces written reasoning steps with continuous hidden states, giving models additional steps to compute before answering. It remains unclear what computation these steps actually perform. High task accuracy and decodable intermediate answers do not establish that a model uses its latent chain to reach an answer. We study this question across twenty-one model-task configurations covering three training recipes, three reasoning tasks, and two backbones. We combine chain deletion and content replacement with probes and trajectory analysis to test whether the chain affects the answer, what it encodes, and how its states change. On logical tasks, COCONUT often carries an answer that is already readable before the chain begins. Its states settle early, and deleting the | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21182
title: 潜在思维链真的在推理吗？潜在推理的统一分类体系

content: AgentEval：面向有状态智能体的证据边界评估 | AgentEval以契约约束的可执行评估记录贯穿工具执行、状态捕获与报告维护，使有状态智能体的行为、证据和结论支持程度可被独立检查与持续审计。 | 子主题：评测审计 | arXiv | AgentEval不以任务是否完成作为唯一标准，而是分别记录智能体做了什么、现有证据能证明什么，以及结论当前是否仍有充分支持。系统将契约约束的评估记录贯穿工具执行、状态与事件捕获、报告资格判定及案例维护，并区分义务已满足、已违反和未解决三类状态。在32次工具世界执行中，独立检查对30个完整回合的判断全部一致，同时保留了2个中断回合；对48个证据视图的受控干预发现了36个仅靠哈希检查无法识别的绑定故障。另有192次留出执行的公开基准实验识别出整体任务失败中已完成的10个返回子目标，并隔离了证据缺失对评估结论的影响。 | 为有状态智能体建立超越任务完成率的义务履行评估框架。 通过契约、状态、事件和证据之间的绑定关系，提高评估结论的可审计性与可复用性。 帮助识别哈希完整性检查无法发现的证据错配、失效和作用域错误。 为长程智能体的执行回放、故障归因及报告复核提供结构化基础。 | 标题：AgentEval: Evidence-Bounded Assessment of Stateful Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21177 摘要：Task completion alone does not determine whether a stateful agent satisfied its obligations, and a recorded judgment does not guarantee that its supporting evidence remains valid. We present AgentEval, a system that carries a contract-bound assessment record through tool execution, state and event capture, report qualification, and case maintenance. It separates what the agent did, what the evidence establishes, and whether the conclusion is supported for present use. On 32 tool-world administrations, independent checks agree on all 30 complete episodes, distinguishing satisfied, violated, and unresolved obligations; two interrupted administrations are retained. Controlled interventions on 48 evidence views expose 36 binding faults missed by hash-only checks without changing agent behavior | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21177
title: AgentEval：面向有状态智能体的证据边界评估

content: 从长上下文到选择性记忆：记忆中心压缩综述 | 该综述以推理资源分配为视角，将上下文压缩、KV 缓存、检索增强与长期记忆统一为可治理的信息生命周期管理问题。 | 子主题：上下文压缩 | arXiv | 文章将长上下文压缩重新定义为推理阶段的记忆管理问题，重点不只是减少信息量，而是决定哪些信息应在何时、以何种形式参与计算。作者区分直接进入模型计算路径的计算活跃记忆与可被存储、检索、更新或遗忘的计算非活跃记忆，并讨论卸载 KV 缓存、持久化前缀缓存和预计算 KV 状态等中间形态。综述把写入、卸载、召回、检索注入、物化、驱逐、整合与遗忘建模为信息生命周期中的状态转换，并以统一的预算成本模型核算相关操作。该框架贯通短期上下文压缩和长期记忆管理，同时总结现有评测维度、基准缺口及动态、可治理的记忆管理方向。 | 为提示压缩、KV 缓存管理、检索增强和智能体记忆提供统一的分析框架。 指导系统在计算、存储、检索延迟与信息价值之间进行预算化权衡。 启发从静态、单点压缩转向支持写入、召回、整合和遗忘的动态记忆生命周期。 为构建长上下文与长期记忆评测基准提供维度设计和问题清单。 | 标题：From Long Context to Selective Memory:A Survey of Memory-Centric Compression for Large Language Models 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21165 摘要：Long-context capability has become essential for large language models (LLMs) to handle complex tasks, yet continuously expanding the context window does not remove the computational, storage, and information-selection pressures incurred at inference time. Existing work on prompt compression, KV-cache management, efficient serving, retrieval augmentation, and agent memory is usually discussed in isolation, leaving the flow of information between storage and computation insufficiently understood. This survey reframes long-context compression as a memory-management problem for allocating inference-time resources. We distinguish compute-active memory, which directly participates in model computation, from compute-inactive memory, which lies outside the computation path but can be stored, retr | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21165
title: 从长上下文到选择性记忆：记忆中心压缩综述

content: MASP：面向理性抵抗用户的心智化对抗自博弈 | MASP 将主动对话建模为系统与理性抵抗用户之间的部分可观测博弈，通过心智状态建模和交替对抗自博弈提升对话智能体的鲁棒性与任务成功率。 | 子主题：自博弈 | arXiv | MASP 针对主动对话训练中过度顺从的“软用户”模拟器偏差，将交互建模为系统与理性抵抗用户之间的部分可观测博弈。框架使用基于 BDI 的潜变量表示用户持续变化的信念、愿望与意图，并区分奖励侧教师心智化和策略侧学生心智化。训练过程交替更新系统策略与用户策略，使应对理性抵抗直接成为优化目标，而不只是评测条件。在多个主动对话基准上，MASP 相比 SFT 和仅规划器方案提高了成功率与理性约束成功率，同时减少平均对话轮数，并在困难用户场景下表现更好。 | 揭示固定或过度顺从的用户模拟器会造成虚高的任务成功率，主动对话评测应纳入理性抵抗用户。 可借助 BDI 潜在状态显式追踪用户态度与意图变化，增强多轮交互中的适应能力。 将用户策略与系统策略交替优化，可把对抗鲁棒性转化为训练目标。 奖励侧与策略侧心智化分离，为教师—学生式行为建模和策略训练提供了可复用设计。 | 标题：Stop Training Against Soft Users: Mentalized Adversarial Self-Play for Proactive Dialogue 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21156 摘要：Proactive dialogue agents must guide multi-turn interactions toward task goals while adapting to users whose intentions and attitudes evolve. Existing planners improve system side action selection through search, learned policies, or user aware planning, but are often trained and evaluated against fixed or overly compliant simulators; as a result, high simulated success can reflect soft user bias rather than robust dialogue ability. We introduce MASP, a Mentalized Adversarial Self Play framework that treats proactive dialogue as a partially observable game between a system and a rationally resisting user. MASP represents the user's evolving mental state with a BDI based latent state, separates reward side teacher mentalization from policy side student mentalization, and alternates self pla | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21156
title: MASP：面向理性抵抗用户的心智化对抗自博弈

content: ECI2D：以可执行因果干预蒸馏自生成上下文示例 | ECI2D将语言推理过程抽象为可执行程序，并通过跨逻辑相似样本的因果干预检验迁移不变性，从而筛除事后伪推理并蒸馏高质量自生成ICL示例。 | 子主题：因果推理 | arXiv | 论文指出，仅按答案正确性筛选自生成上下文示例会面临“观测等价”问题，忠实因果推理与事后拼凑的伪推理可能产生相同输出。作者提出迁移不变性准则：真正具有因果忠实性的推理过程应当在逻辑相似样本上继续有效。ECI2D将自然语言推理过程抽象为可执行程序，并利用 do-operator 对相似样本实施因果干预，仅保留满足迁移不变性的示例。在数学、逻辑与常识推理基准上，该方法以更少的示例持续优于基于观测的ICL筛选，分布偏移时性能增益超过7个百分点。 | 为自生成ICL示例提供超越答案正确性的因果质量筛选标准。 可用于识别答案正确但推理机制不忠实的事后解释，提升思维链数据质量。 通过保留更少但迁移性更强的示例，降低上下文占用并增强分布偏移下的泛化能力。 展示了将自然语言推理可执行化、再以因果干预验证其有效性的评测路径。 | 标题：From Observation to Intervention: Distilling Self-Generated In-Context Demonstrations via Executable Causal Intervention 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21149 摘要：Self-generated In-Context Learning (ICL) enables LLMs to synthesize their own few-shot demonstrations, often outperforming manual prompts. However, existing methods filter demonstrations by observation, assuming a rationale is high-quality if it leads to the correct output. We show such filtering suffers from \textit{observational equivalence}, whereby both faithful causal rationales and spurious post-hoc rationales can yield same outputs and are statistically indistinguishable from observation alone. Inspired by independent causal mechanisms, we argue that faithful rationales imply \textit{transfer invariance}, in which causal rationales should remain effective across logically similar samples. We instantiate this criterion as \textbf{E}xecutable \textbf{C}ausal \textbf{I}ntervention for | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21149
title: ECI2D：以可执行因果干预蒸馏自生成上下文示例

content: CleanRM：用少量干净反馈从噪声偏好中训练奖励模型 | CleanRM利用少量干净反馈和最优传输估计样本级噪声比例，通过噪声校正损失实现无偏奖励建模，并改善下游RLHF对齐效果。 | 子主题：奖励建模 | arXiv | 偏好数据中的噪声来自主观判断、标注错误及不完善的LLM评判器，直接训练奖励模型会导致干净风险估计出现偏差。 传统去噪方法通常假设所有样本具有统一噪声率，但真实反馈的噪声具有样本级差异。 CleanRM使用少量干净反馈，通过最优传输对齐由噪声反馈反演的偏好联合分布与干净反馈分布，从而校准样本级噪声比例。 方法采用噪声校正的代理损失训练奖励模型，理论上对干净风险给出无偏目标；实验中优于现有去噪基线，并提升下游RLHF对齐效果。 | 为包含主观偏差、误标和LLM评判误差的偏好数据提供样本级去噪方案。 表明少量高质量反馈可以作为校准集，提升大规模低质量偏好数据的利用效率。 可用于提高奖励模型训练的稳健性，并降低反馈噪声对RLHF策略优化和安全对齐的影响。 | 标题：CleanRM: Reward Modeling from Noisy Feedback with a Few Clean Feedback for RLHF 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21138 摘要：Feedback noise is pervasive in preference data, arising from subjective human judgments, annotation mistakes, and imperfect LLM judges. Standard reward modeling trained on such feedback yields a biased estimate of the clean risk. Although classical denoising methods are directly applicable to noisy feedback learning, they generally assume a uniform noise ratio across samples. However, this assumption fails for feedback data, where noise is intrinsically sample-wise. To address this challenge, we propose CleanRM, which uses a few clean feedback to calibrate sample-wise noise ratios via optimal transport. Specifically, CleanRM aligns the joint distribution of preferences reverted from noisy feedback with that of clean feedback and then trains the reward model using a noise-corrected surrogat | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21138
title: CleanRM：用少量干净反馈从噪声偏好中训练奖励模型

content: Kolab：长程工作流中的人机协作评测基准 | Kolab 基于真实职业工作流评测智能体预测专家如何采用其贡献，以及判断协作满意度与产出质量的能力。 | 子主题：智能体评测 | arXiv | Kolab 收录了来自 40 种职业、50 名专业人士与智能体协作解决长程问题的 115 小时以上屏幕录像，并包含参与者对协作体验和产出质量的评价。基准要求模型预测专家会采用、修改还是拒绝智能体贡献，同时依据持续展开的工作流判断协作满意度与输出质量。分析发现，前沿智能体与非智能体模型普遍高估其与专家的协作效果，且难以区分高质量和低质量协作。增加工作流上下文长度也未能稳定改善预测，说明自动化任务成绩不能直接代表真实世界中的人机协作能力。 | 为长程、真实职业场景中的人机协作提供区别于单次自动化任务的评测基准。 支持研究智能体贡献在聊天窗口之外如何被专家采用、修改或拒绝。 提醒开发者将持续协调、协作质量判断和专家反馈利用能力纳入智能体评估。 可用于分析长上下文是否真正改善智能体对工作流进展与协作状态的理解。 | 标题：Kolab: Benchmarking Human-Agent Collaboration in Long-Horizon Workflows 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21109 摘要：When humans collaborate with AI agents on long-horizon tasks, what happens to the agents' contributions? For solving long-horizon tasks, humans place greater importance on ongoing interaction with AI agents (e.g., revising plans) than on an agent's ability to complete the task in a single attempt. However, most agentic benchmarks have focused more on automation. Strong performance on such benchmarks does not imply effective real-world collaboration. Professional workflows offer a useful setting, as they often involve interdependent steps. To address this gap, we introduce Kolab, a new dataset of 115+ hours of screen recordings of 50 professionals from 40 occupations collaborating with agents on realistic, long-horizon problems. Kolab also contains participants' collaboration and output qua | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21109
title: Kolab：长程工作流中的人机协作评测基准

content: Probe-and-Resume：何时及如何评估智能体执行 | Probe-and-Resume 仅在智能体宣告任务完成时调用可操作状态分叉的评论器进行探测，并在拒绝后恢复执行，从而提升终端任务成功率并降低成本。 | 子主题：过程评测 | arXiv | 研究发现，在仅能观察部分环境状态的终端计算机任务中，所评估的传统 MCTS 配置并未显著提高任务成功率。中间状态通常缺乏足够的成功证据，评论器对后续轨迹的排序仅略优于随机判断，即使增加环境访问权限也改善有限。作者提出 Probe-and-Resume：仅当智能体声称任务完成时调用评论器，并允许其在当前及初始计算机状态的分叉上进行读取、写入和执行，以主动探测隐藏状态。若评论器拒绝结果，智能体便从停止位置恢复执行；该设计在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上比传统评论器 MCTS 提高 8.4 个百分点，并以不到一半成本接近相同底层模型的 Codex CLI 智能体成功率。 | 表明过程评论器不应被默认用于所有中间节点，调用时机需要与状态的可判定性相匹配。 为终端智能体提供“状态分叉—主动探测—拒绝后恢复”的执行验证机制，可安全执行潜在破坏性检查。 说明测试时搜索的效果高度依赖评论器可见信息与验证能力，而非单纯增加搜索分支。 为兼顾任务成功率与推理成本的智能体评估策略提供设计参考。 | 标题：Probe-and-Resume: When and How to Evaluate Agent Execution 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21088 摘要：Test-time search can improve agent performance by exploring alternative actions and using a critic to select promising branches. We study this approach in terminal-based computer-use environments, which expose only a partial view of a large underlying state, and find that the Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) configuration we evaluate does not significantly improve task success. We identify two sources of poor critic performance: the agent's observations omit environment state needed for evaluation, and intermediate states offer limited evidence of whether a trajectory will succeed. At intermediate states, critics rank continuations only modestly better than chance, and environment access improves this little. We study when to invoke a critic and what access to give it to evaluate a node. Our | https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21088
title: Probe-and-Resume：何时及如何评估智能体执行
