content: RSI-Router：递归演化子任务路由与模型技能，降低智能体成本 | RSI-Router通过递归自我改进联合演化子任务级大小模型路由与模型专属技能，在多个长程智能体基准上以约一半推理成本超越纯大模型方案。 | 子主题：模型路由 | arXiv | RSI-Router面向长程智能体任务，在任务内部按子任务动态分配大模型与小模型，并从累积执行经验中递归改进路由器。每轮演化包含子任务挖掘、路由策略演化、模型专属技能演化和帕累托最优路由器选择四个阶段，同时保留被支配方案作为后续经验。使用DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash与Qwen3.5-9B协作时，该方法在五个智能体基准上以大约48.3%的推理成本稳定超过纯DeepSeek基线。在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和WebShop上，成本降低74.7%至82.2%且性能同步提升；在Terminal-Bench 2.0上，性能相对提高16.7%，成本降低18.0%。 | 展示了将递归自我改进用于子任务级模型路由的可行路径，可同时优化智能体性能与推理成本。 说明小模型无需独立完成整个任务，只要承担适配的执行阶段，便可在长程任务中产生显著经济价值。 模型专属技能可通过对比混合路由轨迹与纯大模型轨迹来诊断失败并沉淀，适合构建可复用的智能体技能库。 以帕累托前沿而非单一指标选择路由器，为多目标智能体系统的成本—性能联合优化提供了参考。 | 标题：RSI-Router: Evolving Subtask-Level LLM Routing and Skills for Cost-Efficient Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34712 摘要：Practical deployment of large language model (LLM) agents requires strong task performance at affordable inference cost. For long-horizon agentic tasks, this performance-cost trade-off can be improved through within-task large-small model collaboration, as smaller models can handle some stages even when they cannot solve the full task. In this paper, we introduce RSI-router, a routing framework that constructs subtask-level model assignments and model-specific skills through recursive self-improvement over accumulated experience. Each iteration consists of four stages: Subtask Mining derives subtask definitions and identification rules from training trajectories; Routing Strategy Evolution proposes and evaluates diverse model assignments; Model-Specific Skill Evolution compares routed and | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34712
title: RSI-Router：递归演化子任务路由与模型技能，降低智能体成本

content: FromPitch2Board：长程足球管理智能体评测基准 | FromPitch2Board 通过确定性足球管理模拟器和受控变量实验，揭示基础模型、智能体脚手架、责任范围及任务时长对长程表现的独立影响。 | 子主题：智能体评测 | arXiv | FromPitch2Board 是一个确定性的长程足球管理智能体基准，在同一模拟器中控制基础模型、脚手架、责任范围、比赛控制粒度和任务时长五项因素。研究使用配对随机种子与冻结校准设置，对四种基础模型和四种智能体脚手架进行比较。实验发现，扩大管理责任会显著放大模型差异；GPT-5.6 在进入全面管理阶段后跳过决策的比例由 1.1% 升至 57.9%，表现回退可被定位到最后一道责任边界。脚手架选择可使 Manager 得分 Z-score 相对固定无状态脚手架变化最高 0.48，而三年期实验还出现模型排名随时间反转，说明单一汇总分数会掩盖长程行为变化。 | 为长程智能体评测提供因素解耦方法，避免仅用任务进度或单一总分解释性能。 可通过责任阶梯和跳过决策率定位智能体在职责扩张后出现的消极决策或能力退化。 表明基础模型与脚手架需要交叉评测，不能将系统表现简单归因于模型本身。 提示长程基准应报告分阶段表现与排名变化，以识别短期评测无法暴露的行为漂移。 | 标题：FromPitch2Board: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Long-Horizon Football Management 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34710 摘要：Long-horizon agent benchmarks typically report how far an agent progresses, but do not identify whether its performance comes from the foundation model, scaffold, responsibility scope, match-control granularity, or horizon. We introduce FromPitch2Board, a deterministic football-management benchmark that studies five configurable factors through controlled comparisons on a single simulator, using paired seeds and a frozen calibration. We evaluate four foundation models and four agent scaffolds. In the Model Track, Coach points Z-scores span 0.19, while Manager points Z-scores span 0.68, with GPT-5.6 showing a sharp rise in passivity under responsibility expansion. Its responsibility ladder rises from 46.1 to 58.1 points with recruitment, then falls to 46.8 under full management, localizing | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34710
title: FromPitch2Board：长程足球管理智能体评测基准

content: ResonAct：多智能体系统的流式运行时诊断与自愈 | ResonAct以流式运行指标持续诊断多智能体系统故障，并通过外部控制平面动态执行修复策略，最高将任务完成率提升10个百分点。 | 子主题：多智能体协作风险 | arXiv | ResonAct将执行轨迹、智能体交互和工具调用汇入流式分析层，持续计算任务进度、上下文健康度与工具可靠性指标。框架利用这些指标检测异常执行模式，并通过结构化故障模型定位工具退化、上下文传播错误和协作失效等根因。诊断完成后，系统动态选择修复策略并采取干预措施，且作为外部控制平面运行，无需修改应用智能体或编排逻辑。在企业工作流与AppWorld基准上，其检测精确率为70.59%至82.91%，召回率为63.09%至100%，恢复率为10.48%至46.67%，运行时开销为-0.25%至14.12%。 | 为长程多智能体工作流提供从事后日志分析转向运行时持续诊断与在线恢复的系统方案。 可将任务进度、上下文健康度和工具可靠性指标用作智能体编排系统的实时控制信号。 外部控制平面设计降低了接入成本，适合在不改动现有智能体与编排逻辑的情况下增强可靠性。 实验结果表明，自愈策略需要在检测准确率、恢复收益和运行时开销之间进行配置权衡。 | 标题：ResonAct: Streaming Metrics for Runtime Diagnosis and Self-Healing in Multi-Agent Systems 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34701 摘要：Multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly used to automate enterprise workflows involving multiple specialized agents, external tools, and long-running task execution. Failures may arise from tool degradation, context propagation errors, coordination breakdowns, or repeated agent interactions that prevent task completion. While existing observability frameworks provide traces and logs, diagnosis and remediation are largely performed after execution completes, limiting opportunities for recovery during runtime. We present ResonAct, a runtime self-healing framework that enables continuous monitoring, diagnosis, and remediation of multi-agent systems through streaming operational metrics. ResonAct ingests execution traces, agent interactions, and tool invocations into a streaming analytics l | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34701
title: ResonAct：多智能体系统的流式运行时诊断与自愈

content: VCN-Bench：基于既往视频经验的空间导航推理基准 | VCN-Bench 通过要求多模态大模型利用先前视频中的空间信息完成闭环导航，评估其将视觉经验转化为连续空间决策的能力。 | 子主题：具身规划 | arXiv | VCN-Bench 是一个面向多模态大模型的闭环空间推理与导航基准，智能体需要依据覆盖起点和目的地的先前视频，识别指令目标并完成导航。该基准基于 Matterport3D 构建，包含五类指令、10 万个训练回合和 1,250 个评测回合。评测以导航表现为主，同时设置目标识别诊断任务，以区分目的地解析错误和后续导航失败。论文还提出融合先前视频与当前观测的规划型基线 MV-DualVLN；实验显示模型整体导航能力有限，即使正确识别目的地也经常无法成功抵达。 | 用于评估具身智能体能否将既往视频经验转化为可执行的空间规划与连续导航决策。 通过拆分目标识别和导航执行，帮助定位空间理解、规划或动作执行环节的失效原因。 揭示离线空间推理成绩不能直接代表闭环导航能力，可推动更重视时序记忆、状态追踪和执行反馈的评测设计。 可作为研究视频上下文利用、多模态具身规划及长程导航模型的训练与比较平台。 | 标题：VCN-Bench: A Video-Contextualized Navigation Benchmark for Spatial Reasoning over Prior Visual Experience 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34687 摘要：Spatial reasoning is fundamental to embodied agents, yet it remains unclear whether spatial understanding can be carried forward to guide sequential interactions. Existing spatial-reasoning benchmarks typically terminate at offline predictions, while navigation benchmarks evaluate spatial reasoning as part of instruction following and exploration. We introduce VCN-Bench, a \textbf{V}ideo-\textbf{C}ontextualized \textbf{N}avigation benchmark for probing closed-loop spatial reasoning over prior visual experience in MLLMs. Given a prior video covering both the initial location and destination, the agent is tasked with reasoning out the instruction-specified target and navigating toward it with the inferred spatial context. Built on Matterport3D, VCN-Bench contains five instruction types, 100k | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34687
title: VCN-Bench：基于既往视频经验的空间导航推理基准

content: AgentPerfBench：智能体大模型推理性能评测套件 | AgentPerfBench利用真实智能体任务轨迹与合成负载，评测多轮、上下文持续增长场景下的大模型推理性能及GPU系统瓶颈。 | 子主题：智能体评测 | arXiv | AgentPerfBench面向编码、终端执行和工具使用等智能体应用，弥补传统单轮聊天负载与真实智能体推理之间的评测差距。套件引入SWE-Bench、TerminalBench等基准的真实轨迹，并依据输入长度、输出长度和轮次数的经验分布生成低成本合成负载。研究指出，忽略上下文长度动态增长以及未让硬件进入饱和状态，会导致现有基准无法准确反映真实推理性能。该套件还提供内核级Nsight Compute轨迹、多维Roofline模型及自动化脚本，用于分析GPU显存带宽、容量占用和潜在系统瓶颈。 | 为vLLM、SGLang等推理引擎提供更贴近真实智能体工作负载的性能基准。 帮助比较调度策略、硬件配置和系统优化在多轮长上下文任务中的实际效果。 通过真实轨迹分布生成可复现的合成负载，降低新硬件评测成本。 利用内核级Roofline分析定位显存带宽、显存容量及硬件饱和度瓶颈。 | 标题：AgentPerfBench: A Benchmarking and Evaluation Suite for Inference Performance of Agentic LLMs 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34683 摘要：The optimization of LLM serving engines, such as vLLM and SGLang, is largely benchmark-driven: optimizations, scheduling policies, hardware and system designs are all selected based on representative workloads. However, a significant mismatch has emerged in the agentic era. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on simple single-turn chatbot workloads. LLM applications are increasingly agentic: coding agents, terminal execution systems, and tool-use agents issue multi-turn requests with growing context lengths. We introduce AgentPerfBench, a benchmark suite for agentic inference. It uses real traces from agentic benchmarks, such as SWE-Bench and TerminalBench, alongside standard chat baselines. This enables benchmarking of models on multi-turn tasks involving tool calling, skill utilization, | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34683
title: AgentPerfBench：智能体大模型推理性能评测套件

content: 基于 LLM 智能体与上下文赌博机的去中心化双边匹配 | 该研究以中国婚恋市场为仿真场景，结合 LLM 智能体和 Logistic-UCB，在信息不完备条件下分别建模个体偏好与互惠接受概率，实现动态去中心化双边匹配。 | 子主题：博弈智能体 | arXiv | 研究提出一种结合 LLM 智能体与上下文赌博机的动态双边匹配框架，以刻画异步、局部信息下的序贯互动。LLM 智能体依据经济学背景信息评价局部遇到的候选人，各智能体的 Logistic-UCB 模型则从提议结果中在线学习对方接受的概率。该机制将“我喜欢谁”与“谁可能喜欢我”拆分，无需预先获得全市场偏好排序。在 50×50 婚恋市场实验中，Bandit-UCB 的平均双方福利达到 56.01，高于 Gale–Shapley 的 54.87，同时缩小性别排名差距，并在 LLM 智能体策略中产生最少的阻塞配对。 | 为不完全信息下的去中心化市场匹配提供兼顾行为建模与在线学习的新机制。 展示如何用经验数据校验 LLM 生成的个体偏好，提升社会经济仿真的可信度。 将偏好效用与互惠成功概率分离，可用于婚恋、招聘、平台交易等双边市场的策略设计。 Logistic-UCB 学到的可解释差异有助于分析群体行为、市场公平性及信息先验的实际价值。 | 标题：From Preference to Reciprocity: Decentralized Matching with Empirically Grounded LLM-agent Based Modeling 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34679 摘要：Bipartite matching is a fundamental problem in game theory and market design. Classical approaches such as Gale--Shapley assume complete preferences and centralized computation, whereas many real-world matching processes are decentralized, asynchronous, and shaped by sequential interaction under limited information. We propose a dynamic bipartite matching framework that combines large language model (LLM) agents with contextual bandits. In a simulated Chinese marriage market, economically grounded LLM agents evaluate locally encountered candidates, while agent-specific Logistic-UCB models learn reciprocal acceptance from realized proposal outcomes. The mechanism therefore separates two decisions---\emph{whom do I like?} and \emph{who is likely to like me back?}---without requiring ex ante | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34679
title: 基于 LLM 智能体与上下文赌博机的去中心化双边匹配

content: FAR：面向世界模型的自适应多线索情景记忆召回 | FAR利用未来预测效用监督训练多线索检索器，使世界模型能按查询动态选择时间、位姿、视觉和音频等线索并召回有用历史。 | 子主题：长期记忆 | arXiv | FAR面向世界模型中的长期依赖问题，学习从持续积累的情景记忆中召回对当前预测最有用的历史观测。训练阶段以给定召回上下文后真实未来的条件对数似然衡量记忆效用，并通过负扩散预测损失进行近似。检索器分别学习时间、位姿、视觉和音频等线索的相关性，再针对不同查询自适应决定应信任哪些可用线索。推理阶段检索器无需访问未来信息；在三类互补实验设置中，其表现优于使用相同线索的人工召回规则，并能随环境变化调整召回策略。 | 为世界模型提供一种由预测效用驱动的长期情景记忆访问机制，减少固定召回规则在不同环境中的失效。 展示如何将训练期可见的未来结果转化为检索监督，同时保持推理阶段的因果性与未来不可见性。 自适应多线索打分可用于需要跨时间、跨模态历史信息的具身智能体和长程任务系统。 该方法提示记忆系统应联合学习“召回什么”与“何时信任哪种线索”，而非仅依赖相似度或新近性。 | 标题：Learning What to Recall: Adaptive Multi-Cue Episodic Memory for World Models 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34677 摘要：World models predict future observations from current experience and actions, yet prediction can depend on observations seen far in the past. Episodic memory preserves past observations for later recall; however, as memory accumulates, it raises a fundamental question: which memories are useful for the current prediction, and which available retrieval cues should be trusted to find them? This is challenging because fixed criteria based on recency, pose overlap, or visual similarity can be unreliable across environments and queries. We propose Future-Aware Recall (FAR), a framework that learns episodic recall from future-aware predictive supervision and adaptive multi-cue scoring. During training, FAR measures predictive utility by the conditional log-likelihood of the realized future given | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34677
title: FAR：面向世界模型的自适应多线索情景记忆召回

content: EAD：证据对齐的多模态在策略自蒸馏 | EAD利用受控的视觉证据参考对教师修正进行对齐加权，仅保留密集OPSD约6%的监督质量便超越既有先进方法。 | 子主题：在策略蒸馏 | arXiv | 多模态在策略自蒸馏通常使用证据区域裁剪图像驱动教师，并沿学生生成的轨迹监督查看原图的学生，但滞后教师造成的模型状态差异和裁剪造成的上下文丢失会干扰教师修正。EAD保留以裁剪图像为条件的教师作为训练目标，同时构造独立的证据参考来衡量每次修正的有效性。该方法使用当前学生排除模型状态差异，并在原图中遮蔽证据区域、保留其余上下文，以获得视觉证据引起预测变化的受控方向。EAD根据教师修正与证据参考之间的余弦对齐程度进行加权，保留对齐修正并降低其余修正的权重。实验表明，其仅使用密集OPSD约6%的监督质量，就能稳定超越此前的先进方法。 | 为细粒度视觉理解提供一种更高效、干扰更少的多模态自蒸馏方案。 说明教师监督的数量并非关键，基于任务证据筛选和加权修正可能比密集蒸馏更有效。 可将“遮蔽证据区域形成受控参照”的设计推广到视觉问答、图像定位及其他依赖局部证据的多模态任务。 为分析特权教师中的模型状态偏差与上下文偏差提供了可操作的分解思路。 | 标题：Evidence-Aligned Multimodal On-Policy Self-Distillation for Fine-Grained Visual Understanding 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34672 摘要：Fine-grained visual understanding requires models to recognize small details within complex images. Multimodal on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) addresses this challenge by using a teacher conditioned on evidence-centered crops to supervise a student conditioned on original images along student-generated trajectories. Ideally, teacher corrections, the distributional changes from the student toward the privileged teacher, should be driven by task-relevant visual evidence. However, the designs that make the teacher effective also introduce other interference. Using a lagged or frozen teacher improves training stability but introduces a model-state gap from the evolving student, while cropping enhances task-relevant evidence but also loses the visual context. These two sources of interferenc | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34672
title: EAD：证据对齐的多模态在策略自蒸馏

content: Codoku：面向前沿编程智能体的可再生程序推理基准 | Codoku 通过按需合成带可控约束的“代码数独”，构建可持续更新且难以依靠执行或枚举绕过的程序推理评测基准。 | 子主题：代码评测 | arXiv | Codoku 要求智能体补全部分程序中的类型化单元格，使其同时满足指定控制流图、执行路径等全局静态与动态约束。由于不完整程序无法直接执行，且有效填充在指数级组合空间中极为稀疏，工具执行和暴力枚举难以替代真正的程序推理。题目通过语义具体化从零合成，可按需生成复杂度可控的新题，并附带保证可解的见证。作者使用可自由调用工具但预算固定的编程智能体评测了五个前沿模型；开放权重模型在小型题目上已面临明显挑战，专有模型对大型题目的解决率也仅约一半。 | 为编程智能体提供可持续更新的程序推理评测，降低固定题集的数据污染与过拟合风险。 通过不可直接执行的部分程序设计，更有效地区分真实程序推理能力与工具调用、试运行或枚举能力。 可控复杂度和可解性见证有助于开展难度分层、模型能力追踪及评测有效性研究。 其从零合成题目的机制可为动态基准测试和自动化代码评测提供设计范式。 | 标题：Codoku: Renewable Program-Reasoning Challenges for Frontier Coding Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34661 摘要：Existing program-reasoning benchmarks ask large language models to predict a program's behavior on a given input. Coding agents break two assumptions on which these benchmarks rest: an agent can recover the answer by executing the program instead of reasoning about it, and fixed task sets drawn from existing programs are increasingly exposed to contamination, yet costly to renew. We introduce Codoku (code sudoku), a renewable benchmark in which a solver fills typed cells in a partial program to satisfy global static and dynamic constraints, such as a prescribed control-flow graph and execution path. Because a partial program cannot be executed and valid fillings are sparse in an exponentially large space of interdependent choices, neither tool use nor enumeration can substitute for program | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34661 | https://github.com/connglli/Codoku
title: Codoku：面向前沿编程智能体的可再生程序推理基准

content: SPRING：SMT 求解器引导的逻辑推理过程奖励 | SPRING 利用 SMT 求解器验证中间推理步骤，以奖励有效且新颖的演绎、惩罚矛盾和无信息步骤，显著提升多个模型的结构化逻辑推理能力。 | 子主题：过程奖励模型 | arXiv | SPRING 在训练阶段使用 SMT 求解器验证大语言模型生成的中间推理步骤，提供细粒度的过程级监督。其将“新颖推理步骤”定义为逻辑有效、与当前推理状态一致，且未被此前无矛盾结论所蕴含的演绎。奖励机制鼓励带来新推断进展的步骤，同时惩罚矛盾、重复或缺乏信息量的推理。在 ZebraLogic、AR-LSAT 和 Knights and Knaves 三项基准及四种模型上的实验中，SPRING 均优于基础模型、仅结果奖励方法和 Logic-LM。 | 展示了如何将 SMT 求解器作为训练时验证器，为逻辑推理轨迹提供可验证的过程奖励。 相比只关注最终答案，奖励“有效且新颖”的中间演绎可减少矛盾、冗余和脆弱推理。 为小规模语言模型提升多步约束推理能力提供了一条神经符号训练路径。 新颖性判定可用于设计更重视推断增量而非单纯步骤正确性的过程奖励模型。 | 标题：Rewarding Novel Deductions: Solver-guided Process Rewards for Logical Reasoning 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34660 摘要：Logical reasoning remains a major challenge for large language models (LLMs), particularly on structured problems that require precise constraint tracking, consistency preservation, and multi-step deduction. This challenge is especially acute for small-scale LLMs, which are more prone to producing inconsistent, redundant, or brittle reasoning trajectories. Existing approaches for improving logical reasoning largely optimize for final-answer correctness, providing only weak supervision over the intermediate reasoning process. In this work, we propose SPRING: (Solver-guided Process Rewards for Novel LogIcal ReasoNing Step Generation). SPRING uses SMT solver as a training-time verifier of intermediate reasoning steps to provide process-level supervision. It introduces the notion of a novel re | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34660
title: SPRING：SMT 求解器引导的逻辑推理过程奖励

content: ContextEvo：面向长程智能体脚手架的自进化上下文策略 | ContextEvo通过分析长程执行轨迹中的上下文失效并定向更新管理策略，使智能体脚手架能够适应不同环境的信息需求。 | 子主题：脚手架演化 | arXiv | ContextEvo将上下文管理视为长程智能体脚手架演化的核心瓶颈，指出冗余或过时信息会掩盖关键证据。该框架在关键决策点重建模型实际可见的上下文，识别由上下文组织与保留策略引发的失败，并据此实施定向策略更新。基于开源Pi-agent脚手架的实验显示，ContextEvo在三个长程任务基准上取得显著改进，表现达到或超过Codex、OpenCode和OpenClaw等代表性智能体脚手架。进一步分析表明，固定策略或仅进行局部演化的上下文方案难以应对长程信息压力，而ContextEvo能根据不同环境的信息需求自适应调整。 | 将智能体演化的对象从经验与技能扩展到上下文管理策略，为长程任务提供新的优化维度。 可通过重建关键决策点的模型可见上下文，对信息遗漏、冗余累积和过时证据干扰进行故障归因。 启示智能体脚手架应根据任务环境动态学习信息保留、组织与淘汰策略，而非依赖固定上下文规则。 可作为评估长程智能体时分析上下文压力、轨迹失效和脚手架适应能力的方法基础。 | 标题：Beyond Skill Evolution: Self-Evolving Context Management Policies for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34649 摘要：Harness evolution improves LLM agents by learning from execution trajectories, but existing experience- and skill-based methods are less effective on long-horizon tasks. As interactions grow, useful evidence can be buried by redundant or outdated context, making context management itself a key bottleneck. We introduce ContextEvo, a framework that learns a context policy from long-horizon trajectories. ContextEvo reconstructs the model-visible context at key decision points, identifies context-related failures, and applies targeted policy updates. Starting from the open-source Pi-agent harness, ContextEvo improves performance across three long-horizon task benchmarks, achieving results comparable to or better than several prominent agent harnesses, including Codex, OpenCode, and OpenClaw. A | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34649
title: ContextEvo：面向长程智能体脚手架的自进化上下文策略

content: Nereus：面向大模型后训练的自适应并行运行时 | Nereus 通过成本感知的在线 TP/PP 并行调整与分布式状态复用，在资源和负载动态变化时优化大模型强化学习后训练的执行效率。 | 子主题：系统优化 | arXiv | Nereus 是面向大模型强化学习后训练的成本感知运行时，可随资源可用性、序列长度、显存压力和阶段瓶颈变化动态调整执行计划。其低开销控制器选择显存可行的全局计划，并利用基于当前作业校准的成本模型判断性能收益是否足以覆盖切换开销。系统以 Elastic Model Unit 表示各模型阶段副本的分布式状态，再通过全局转换图协调状态变换及跨模型、跨阶段的 GPU 迁移。实验中，在线 TP/PP 调整将平均单步延迟降低 27.7%，六次转换仅占千步运行总时间的 0.079%；8B PPO 吞吐量较 OpenRLHF 提升 2.14～7.27 倍，较 Verl 提升 1.10～1.47 倍。 | 为动态 GPU 集群上的强化学习后训练提供低开销、自适应的并行策略，避免固定 TP/PP 布局随负载变化而失效。 展示如何将迁移成本纳入在线调度决策，防止频繁重配置带来的收益倒挂。 Elastic Model Unit 与全局转换图可为分布式训练状态复用、GPU 迁移编排和弹性运行时设计提供参考。 结果表明，大规模后训练系统不仅需要数据并行扩缩容，还应联合优化张量并行与流水线并行布局。 | 标题：Nereus: Adaptive Parallelism for LLM Post-Training 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34645 摘要：Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for large language models (LLMs) coordinates multiple models across generation, inference, and training on GPU clusters. Several factors may change during a run, including resource availability, sequence length, memory pressure, and stage bottlenecks. As a consequence, an execution plan that was initially suitable can then become slow or even infeasible over time. However, adapting a job whose models share GPUs entails significant challenges: deciding whether a new plan is worth the transition cost, reusing the job's distributed state, and coordinating GPU transfers across models and stages. Nereus targets these challenges as a cost-aware runtime that adapts RL post-training jobs into efficient execution plans. Its low-overhead controller selects a | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34645
title: Nereus：面向大模型后训练的自适应并行运行时

content: MechReasoner：定性物理机械推理模拟器与评测基准 | MechReasoner 以基于汇流理论的定性物理模拟器生成可审计评测，揭示 GPT-5.5 的准确率会随机械推理复杂度上升而显著下降。 | 子主题：评测基准 | arXiv | MechReasoner 将机械式定性模拟器与推理基准结合，用于检验模型回答是否真正符合结构、因果与状态转移约束。基准包含 1,120 个确定性生成的样本，覆盖 18 类机械机制和六个任务族，并考察歧义保留、量化主张、情节图转移证据、修复及轨迹支持判断。每种机制均经过结构与拓扑转换检查，并使用定量模拟进行行为验证。实验中，GPT-5.5 的准确率从最低复杂度 B1 的 76.1% 降至最高复杂度 B4 的 38.0%，且控制提示及答案长度后负相关仍然存在。 | 为机械推理与定性物理推理提供结构化、可复现且可审计的模型评测方案。 通过模拟器许可的状态、约束和推导轨迹，区分语言流畅性与真实的机制遵循能力。 可用于研究模型在复杂度提升时的推理失效模式，并支持基于证据轨迹的可靠性诊断。 展示了以形式化模拟器确定性生成高质量科学推理基准的可行路径。 | 标题：MechReasoner: A Simulator and Benchmark for Mechanistic Reasoning in Qualitative Physics 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34636 摘要：This work introduces MechReasoner, a mechanistic qualitative simulator grounded in confluence-based qualitative physics, together with a benchmark for mechanistic inference. Current large language models (LLMs) generate fluent mechanistic descriptions that do not reliably follow from underlying structural and causal constraints. The benchmark tests whether answers preserve simulator-licensed ambiguity, quantified claims, episode-graph transition evidence, repairs, and trace-support judgments. Its 1,120 items are generated deterministically from admissible interpretation sets, component states, scenario restrictions, confluence constraints, and derivation steps across 18 catalog mechanisms and six task families. Each mechanism undergoes converter checks of structure and topology and behavio | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34636
title: MechReasoner：定性物理机械推理模拟器与评测基准

content: GenMem：面向自进化脚手架的生成式符号记忆 | GenMem以稳定的符号标识符生成替代原始记忆内容检索，在保持地址不变的同时支持智能体长期记忆的持续检索、复用与演化。 | 子主题：长期记忆 | arXiv | GenMem将智能体记忆管理重新表述为生成式符号寻址，以应对可复用经验稀疏、层次化且高度冗余的问题。其核心 Symbolic Identifier（SID）是多级离散词元元组，使用不足一百个离散符号对百万级稀疏记忆空间进行因子化寻址。记忆智能体生成稳定的 SID，而 MemEvolver 可在固定地址下重写记忆载荷，从而兼顾持续演化与寻址接口不变性。系统在多智能体脚手架中结合 MemRetriever 与 MemEvolver，并通过 GRPO、稠密过程奖励和结果奖励进行双通道优化，覆盖 ALFWorld、WebShop、多跳问答、医疗推理和深度研究等任务。 | 为长期运行智能体提供地址稳定、内容可持续修订的记忆架构。 将大规模记忆检索转化为紧凑符号空间中的生成问题，降低稀疏冗余经验的管理难度。 展示如何利用过程奖励与结果奖励缓解记忆生命周期中监督稀疏、反馈延迟的问题。 可作为自进化智能体脚手架中经验保留、技能复用和记忆更新模块的设计参考。 | 标题：GenMem: Generative Symbolic Memory for Self-Evolving Harness 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34633 摘要：Long-term memory supports the self-evolution of LLM agents by retaining experience and skills across tasks and enabling their retrieval, reuse, and revision in subsequent long-horizon decision-making. Yet existing memory management approaches remain limited to discriminative retrieval and to address the sparse, hierarchical, and highly redundant structure of reusable experience: only a small, task-dependent subset of trajectories and memories warrants retention, retrieval, or revision. Learning these operations is further complicated by sparse, delayed, and indirect task-level feedback, with weak supervision across the memory lifecycle. Moreover, continual memory evolution introduces an architectural tension as addressing invariance: stored experience is perpetually revised, yet the addres | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34633
title: GenMem：面向自进化脚手架的生成式符号记忆

content: PMOPD：基于参数更新子空间保护的多教师在策略蒸馏 | PMOPD通过任务排序、循环训练和参数更新子空间投影抑制多教师在策略蒸馏中的跨任务干扰，实现代码、推理与数学能力的均衡提升。 | 子主题：在策略蒸馏 | arXiv | 多教师在策略蒸馏需要将多种专门能力整合进共享参数，但容易出现提升一个领域却损害其他领域的“能力跷跷板”现象。研究发现，不同任务产生的参数更新会迅速集中到各自的低维子空间，为识别和控制跨任务干扰提供了几何依据。PMOPD利用各任务的累积参数位移构建子空间记忆，并投影梯度与优化器更新，以移除干扰受保护任务方向的分量。该方法还引入轻量级冲突探针指导任务排序，并通过循环策略兼顾子空间估计和任务及时重访；在Qwen2.5-7B和Llama-3.1-8B上的代码、推理、数学任务平均分分别提高2.54和2.09分。 | 为多教师蒸馏中的能力冲突提供可解释的参数更新几何分析框架。 可通过子空间保护减少灾难性干扰，在共享模型中更均衡地融合多领域能力。 任务冲突探针、排序和循环机制可用于优化多任务后训练的调度策略。 表明几何感知优化能够作为可迁移组件应用于不同基础模型的能力整合。 | 标题：PMOPD: Task Ordering, Cycling, and Parameter-Update Subspace Protection in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34605 摘要：Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) has emerged as a popular post-training paradigm for integrating specialized capabilities in frontier language models. Existing OPD research has primarily focused on optimizing single-task distillation through objective design, distillation scope, and teacher signal construction, whereas MOPD must aggregate multiple capabilities in shared parameters and address the resulting capability seesaw, in which improving one domain suppresses capabilities acquired from another. Inspired by the distinctive update geometry of OPD, we find that parameter updates from different tasks rapidly concentrate in their respective low-dimensional subspaces during MOPD, providing a direct geometric basis for identifying and controlling cross-task interference. We there | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34605
title: PMOPD：基于参数更新子空间保护的多教师在策略蒸馏

content: 修复后的智能体经验能否迁移至相关任务 | 研究通过3300次运行比较失败经历修复前后的跨任务迁移效果，发现修复经验的价值与复用经验的价值并不等同，评估记忆更新需同时引入旧版本和独立执行基线。 | 子主题：经验学习 | arXiv | 研究在100组 ThinkingBox 任务对和100组 APEX 任务对上开展3300次运行，将同一失败源任务修复前后的经验迁移到固定目标任务，并与独立执行比较。ThinkingBox 中 Full、Skill 和 Hybrid 修复分别带来44、29和32个百分点的增益，修复后表现也分别比独立执行高25、22和18个百分点，但任务族层面的统计证据较弱。Full 相对 Skill 多出的15个百分点修复差距中，有12个百分点源于修复前表现更差，而非修复后的记忆质量更高；其46次向上转变中也有22次只是恢复既有基线成功。APEX 的两种设置均未证明稳定的总体修复收益，且更短的经验交接虽然减少输入量，却会增加调用次数。结果表明，判断一次修复是否真正更新了可复用记忆，必须同时比较修复前版本和从零开始执行的参照结果。 | 为智能体长期记忆和经验库更新提供更严格的评估设计，避免把基线恢复误判为新能力获得。 提醒研究者分别测量“修复经历是否改善”与“改善后的经历是否值得复用”，两者不能由单一成功率差值替代。 可用于设计经验迁移实验的双参照框架：同时保留修复前历史和独立执行基线。 表明工作流级经验中可复用的约束可能促进迁移，而源任务特有的局部选择和惯例冲突可能削弱迁移效果。 | 标题：After the Fix: How Corrected Agent Histories Transfer to Related Tasks 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34603 摘要：Does repairing an episode make its experience a better memory for the next task? We transfer the same failed source before and after accepted repair to a fixed target, alongside independent execution. Our 3,300 runs cover 100 ThinkingBox pairs and the same 100 APEX pairs with and without source-state inheritance, under eleven conditions. ThinkingBox's Full/Skill/Hybrid correction gains are 44/29/32 percentage points, with corrected performance 25/22/18 points above independence; inference weakens at the task-family level. Yet 12 of Full's 15-point larger correction gap over Skill come from worse uncorrected performance, not better corrected memory. Moreover, 22 of Full's 46 upward transitions restore observed baseline success. Neither APEX regime establishes comparable aggregate correction | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34603
title: 修复后的智能体经验能否迁移至相关任务

content: AgentWare：自动化边云智能体应用全生命周期 | AgentWare 提供覆盖环境置备、分布式部署、可观测性与自动评估的 AgenticOps 框架，以降低异构边云基础设施上智能体应用的运维和实验成本。 | 子主题：智能体框架 | arXiv | AgentWare 面向异构 Edge-to-Cloud 基础设施，自动准备执行环境，并将用户定义的智能体实现转换为分布式应用。框架支持跨边缘与云端部署智能体组件，统一收集执行轨迹、基础设施遥测数据和评估指标。它通过 LLM-as-a-Judge 工作流执行语义评估，并生成涵盖正确性、性能、资源利用率及能耗的可复现报告。作者以真实边云环境中的分布式图书助手为案例，表明该框架能够显著减少部署、插桩和分析所需的人工工作。 | 为分布式智能体应用提供从开发实现到部署、监控和评估的一体化工程流水线。 支持在不同硬件、模型和部署配置之间开展可复现的系统实验与性能比较。 将执行轨迹、资源消耗、能耗和任务正确性统一纳入评估，有助于优化边云组件放置与模型选型。 AgenticOps 思路可用于建设面向生产环境的智能体持续交付、可观测性和验收体系。 | 标题：AgentWare: Automating the Lifecycle of Agentic Applications across the Edge-to-Cloud Continuum 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34586 摘要：Deploying LLM-enabled agentic applications across the Edge-to-Cloud continuum remains challenging due to hardware heterogeneity, deployment complexity, limited observability, and the lack of systematic evaluation methods. Existing solutions address agent development, observability, or benchmarking separately, offering limited support for the full lifecycle of distributed agentic applications. This paper presents AgentWare, an AgenticOps framework that automates the provisioning, deployment, observability, and evaluation of agentic applications across Edge-to-Cloud infrastructures. AgentWare introduces an end-to-end lifecycle pipeline that automatically prepares heterogeneous execution environments, transforms user-defined agent implementations into distributed applications, deploys agent c | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34586
title: AgentWare：自动化边云智能体应用全生命周期

content: Nudgeability：推理模型盲从置信信号，却无法追踪自身能力 | 研究提出 Nudgeability 评测，发现推理模型的工具委派决策会显著受置信或怀疑措辞影响，但这种响应与模型真实解题能力仅有很弱的对应关系。 | 子主题：置信度评估 | arXiv | 研究在相同推理轨迹的固定位置插入表达“自信”或“怀疑”的第一人称句子，再观察模型选择直接回答还是调用工具，以测量反思信号对委派行为的因果影响。作者将这种行为响应称为 Nudgeability，并以敏感性和针对性两个维度衡量：前者描述信号改变委派率的幅度，后者考察变化是否符合模型的真实能力。对 Qwen、Gemma、GLM 三个家族的九个中小型开放权重推理模型进行测试后，置信到怀疑条件下的委派率中位变化达到 20.6 个百分点，大型服务模型则达到 53～70 个百分点。然而，被诱导改变的决策中仅有中位数 42% 得到正确针对，相比随机选择基线只提升约 2 个百分点，说明模型会跟随置信语言，却不能可靠判断自身是否胜任。 | 为工具增强推理模型提供无需后训练的自我反思与委派行为评测方法。 提醒开发者不要将模型对置信措辞的敏感反应误认为可靠的元认知或能力校准。 可将敏感性与针对性分开优化，避免模型只是增加工具调用，却没有把工具预算用于真正困难的问题。 置信语言构成强控制面，也可能被提示注入或错误自我报告操纵，因此部署时应结合外部验证器、能力预测器或任务级校准机制。 | 标题：Nudgeability: Reasoning Models Follow Confidence Signals Without Tracking Their Own Competence 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34572 摘要：Reasoning language models that can call tools must decide during inference whether to answer unaided or delegate. Any self-reflection mechanism for this must answer three questions: where the reflective signal comes from (verbal reports, output distributions, hidden states, a separate predictor), how it is presented to the model (numerical prediction, confidence token, prompt injection), and whether it changes the model's subsequent action. We isolate the third question. At a fixed point in otherwise identical reasoning trajectories, we insert a single first-person sentence expressing either confidence or doubt; the model then continues reasoning and chooses whether to answer directly or call a tool. Comparing these counterfactual continuations measures the causal effect of the reflective | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34572
title: Nudgeability：推理模型盲从置信信号，却无法追踪自身能力

content: FlowState：以执行状态作为长程 LLM 智能体记忆 | FlowState 通过持久化语义化执行状态并按需访问历史证据，在降低上下文成本的同时提升长程智能体任务的成功率。 | 子主题：长期记忆 | arXiv | FlowState 将执行状态视为可跨请求保留和重访的记忆，以统一当前决策与历史信息复用。系统保存带有语义类型的状态节点、节点关系及原始工具观测引用，将持久化存储与按需访问解耦。增量状态更新（ISU）根据新输入和反馈维护当前状态，渐进式状态访问（PSA）则在推理过程中按需揭示历史状态及支撑证据。相较使用相同 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的全上下文基线，FlowState 在 MemoryArena 和 τ³-Bench 上分别提升 4.55 和 13.95 个百分点，同时将总词元消耗降低 43.2% 和 40.6%。 | 为长程智能体提供一种介于完整历史保留与有损摘要之间的结构化记忆方案。 通过保存原始工具观测引用，使智能体能够在后续信息到来时重新审视历史决策并追溯证据。 ISU 与 PSA 的组合可用于降低长任务中的上下文长度、推理成本和信息遗漏风险。 该方法提示智能体记忆系统应将“持久保留什么”与“何时读取什么”分开设计。 | 标题：FlowState: Execution State as Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34565 摘要：Long-horizon tasks require LLM agents to continually draw on information from earlier interactions. However, retaining the full history increases context costs, while compressing it risks losing details needed later, and the relevance of historical information often becomes apparent as the task progresses. To address these challenges, we propose FlowState, which treats execution state as memory that can be retained and revisited across requests, unifying current decision-making with the reuse of historical information. FlowState preserves semantically typed state nodes, their relations, and references to raw tool observations, separating persistent retention from on-demand access. Within a single execution loop, Incremental State Update (ISU) maintains the current state based on new inputs | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34565
title: FlowState：以执行状态作为长程 LLM 智能体记忆

content: ReaLVR：以视觉证据约束潜空间视觉推理 | ReaLVR通过在模型自由运行的潜在轨迹中引入视觉证据监督，缓解潜在词元对关键图像变化不敏感的证据信用分配缺口，并将潜空间视觉推理扩展至235B模型。 | 子主题：视觉推理 | arXiv | 作者发现，依赖最终答案奖励进行GRPO训练时，潜在词元对足以改变正确答案的图像扰动响应较弱，形成“潜在证据—信用缺口”。ReaLVR对比正确答案与模型生成的错误答案，以判断潜在轨迹中需要加强监督的位置，同时对比相关与错配的视觉证据，明确应保留的信息。该方法在三个模型家族上稳定优于所评测的潜空间视觉推理基线，并在Qwen2.5-VL-7B的五任务平均成绩上达到63.7%。实验还首次展示了潜空间视觉推理可扩展至235B前沿模型，并带来更强的问题敏感性、视觉区域对齐和关键潜在词元依赖。 | 表明仅使用最终答案奖励不足以监督不可观测的潜在推理过程，需要显式解决视觉证据保留与跨潜在词元的信用分配。 提供一种无需将中间推理完全语言化、直接监督模型自由运行潜在轨迹的方法。 为分析潜在词元是否真正依赖视觉证据提供图像扰动、区域对齐和固定上下文依赖等诊断思路。 证明潜空间视觉推理训练能够扩展到235B规模，为降低显式思维链开销的多模态推理系统提供参考。 | 标题：Rethinking Latent Visual Reasoning: Grounding Latent Reasoning in Visual Evidence 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34563 摘要：Latent visual reasoning (LVR) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perform intermediate computation in continuous latent tokens rather than expressing every reasoning step in words. However, unlike textual CoT, latent reasoning is not directly observable, making it difficult to supervise what latent tokens learn. In this work, we first conduct a thorough analysis of latent-token behavior and identify a latent evidence-credit gap: latent tokens respond only weakly to image perturbations that alter the correct answer. We hypothesize that this issue stems from the lack of explicit supervision during GRPO training. These findings suggest that a final-answer reward provides too little guidance on what visual evidence to preserve or how credit should be assigned across latent toke | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34563
title: ReaLVR：以视觉证据约束潜空间视觉推理

content: 单层 MeMo 是随机化 Hamming 核分类器 | 研究从理论上将单层 MeMo 的理想检索规则刻画为基于位置 Hamming 核的多分类器，并分析随机编码引入的误差及其性能权衡。 | 子主题：机制发现 | arXiv | 研究证明，单层 MeMo 的理想检索规则等价于一个基于位置 Hamming 核的多分类器。MeMo 使用高斯随机码表示序列特征和输出标签，因此实际得分可视为对理想分类器的双重随机化草图。作者在输入与输出码本相互独立的条件下，分别界定上下文草图和输出解码产生的误差，并给出恢复理想预测的基于间隔的保证。受控模拟验证了理论趋势；在受限的 WikiText-2 下一词元预测任务中，MeMo 展现出准确率、内存与吞吐量之间的实用权衡，尤其适合利用 GPU 并行矩阵运算。 | 为理解 MeMo 的关联记忆机制提供核方法视角，将其语言建模行为还原为可分析的分类过程。 误差界可用于指导随机码维度、上下文长度和数据规模等参数选择。 基于间隔的恢复条件为评估随机压缩是否保持理想预测提供理论依据。 结果表明，单层 MeMo 可作为重视内存占用与 GPU 吞吐量场景中的轻量级下一词元预测方案。 | 标题：Single-Layer MeMo as a Randomized Hamming-Kernel Classifier 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34562 摘要：MeMo (Zanzotto et al., 2025) is a recent language-model architecture that stores associations between token contexts and next tokens in a correlation matrix memory. In this work, we study its single-layer form and show that its ideal retrieval rule is a multiclass classifier based on the positional Hamming kernel. The MeMo architecture represents both the sequence features and the output labels with Gaussian random codes. Its score is therefore a doubly randomized sketch of the ideal classifier. Under independent input and output codebooks, we bound the errors introduced by context sketching and output decoding, characterize their dependence on model and data parameters, and give a margin-based guarantee for recovering the ideal prediction. Controlled simulations support the trends predict | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34562
title: 单层 MeMo 是随机化 Hamming 核分类器

content: SkillRubric：多模态智能体的技能指导与评估规则协同演化 | SkillRubric 将面向智能体的技能指导与面向评估器的规则对齐，并通过交替协同演化提供细粒度过程奖励，提升多模态智能体的长程规划与工具使用能力。 | 子主题：技能演化 | arXiv | SkillRubric 将每项可复用技能表示为相互对齐的两部分：面向执行者的操作指导，以及面向评估器的评价规则。多模态验证器依据截图和工具输出检查技能目标，并将完成奖励与进度奖励归因到对应的执行轮次，从而缓解稀疏结果奖励对中间决策监督不足的问题。该方法采用交替协同演化机制：在冻结策略时通过成对轨迹验证指导修订，并在固定指导时离线更新评估规则。多个多模态智能体基准上的实验显示，该方法能稳定提升性能，演化后的技能也比旧版本更有助于规划和工具使用。 | 为长程多模态智能体提供与操作流程一致的细粒度过程监督。 将技能知识同时用于行动指导和结果评估，降低人工构建大规模评价规则的成本。 通过冻结变量后的交替验证减少指导与评估规则共同更新造成的反馈漂移。 可用于改进工具调用、轨迹信用分配及基于技能库的智能体训练。 | 标题：SkillRubric: Co-Evolving Actor Guidance and Evaluator Rubrics for Multimodal Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34557 摘要：Recent work incorporates reusable skills distilled from past interactions into multimodal agent training, providing procedural guidance for long-horizon planning and tool use. However, policy optimization in these methods remains driven primarily by sparse outcome rewards, providing little supervision for intermediate decisions. Rubric-based rewards address this limitation through explicit intermediate criteria, but reliable rubrics are difficult to construct at scale and often disconnected from the procedure followed by the actor. We observe that a well-structured skill naturally specifies both how to act and what successful execution should achieve. Based on this insight, we introduce SkillRubric, which represents each skill through aligned actor-facing guidance and an evaluator-facing r | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34557
title: SkillRubric：多模态智能体的技能指导与评估规则协同演化

content: SGG-ReflAct：子目标引导反思提升长程推理可靠性 | SGG-ReflAct将规划器生成的中间子目标纳入逐步反思，并通过结构化计划探索减少智能体在长程任务中的目标漂移与幻觉动作。 | 子主题：长程任务执行 | arXiv | SGG-ReflAct针对ReflAct仅围绕最终目标反思、忽略中间子目标的问题，使用单路径LLM规划器生成子目标并将其融入反思过程。扩展版本BeamSGG-ReflAct采用基于束搜索的LLM规划器，以探索多个结构化计划。在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和Jericho上的实验表明，该方法几乎在所有设置中都优于ReflAct，其中使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct时，前两个环境的最高成功率分别提升14.9和8.0个百分点。分析显示，该方法能减少幻觉动作，并在具有严格程序顺序的任务上获得最大收益；但束搜索实验也说明，明确计划中的必要操作比单纯扩大计划搜索更重要。 | 为长程智能体提供一种易于集成的子目标引导反思骨干，降低执行过程中的目标漂移。 表明中间子目标可作为校准内部信念和检测阶段性错误的结构化依据。 提示计划质量比单纯增加搜索宽度更关键，应明确建模任务所需操作及其执行顺序。 可用于改进具身环境、交互式游戏及其他程序化多步任务中的智能体可靠性。 | 标题：SGG-ReflAct: Sub-Goal Guided ReflAct with Structured Planning for Reliable Long-Horizon Reasoning 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34548 摘要：Recent advances in reasoning backbones have empowered large language model (LLM)agentstotackle complex, multi-step tasks. However, as reasoning horizons grow, inconsistent internal beliefs induce intermediate errors that cause agents to drift from their goals. This limitation also persists in REFLACT, which reflects only on the end-goal at each step without explicitly considering intermediate sub goals. To address this problem, we propose SGG-ReflAct (Sub-Goal Guided Re flAct), a reasoning backbone that integrates sub-goals generated through a single path LLM planner into the reflection process. We further extend this framework to BeamSGG-ReflAct, which replaces the single-path planner with a beam search based LLM planner for structured plan exploration. We run experiments on ALF World, Sc | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34548
title: SGG-ReflAct：子目标引导反思提升长程推理可靠性

content: MemDream：面向自探测记忆演化的离线梦境框架 | MemDream通过多智能体离线梦境周期主动探测、诊断并修复记忆图，在真实查询暴露故障前持续演化大模型智能体的长期记忆。 | 子主题：长期记忆 | arXiv | MemDream针对现有智能体记忆系统只能在真实查询失败后被动修复的问题，引入周期性的离线“梦境”阶段。Dreamer、Analyst和Consolidator三个专用智能体协作生成探测、诊断记忆缺陷，并对记忆图执行修复。框架使用Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）训练策略，以学习能够带来持久检索改进的修复操作，同时通过软衰减机制实现可逆遗忘。在LoCoMo上，MemDream将答案F1提升4.5个百分点；在MemoryAgentBench上，其总体得分比最强的反应式演化基线高9.1个百分点。 | 将记忆维护从故障后的被动修复转变为交互前的主动诊断，可降低长程任务中的真实失败成本。 展示了多智能体分工与强化学习策略结合进行记忆图持续演化的可行路径。 软衰减提供了可逆遗忘机制，可在清理低价值记忆的同时减少不可恢复的信息损失。 可用于构建具备长期个性化、主动维护和持续改进能力的智能体记忆系统。 | 标题：Remember Before You're Asked: MemDream for Self-Probing Memory Evolution 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34545 摘要：Memory is essential for enabling LLM-based agents to maintain coherent, personalized behavior over long-horizon interactions. However, existing memory systems share a fundamental limitation: they never proactively test their own memory, repairing it only after real queries expose weaknesses. This reactive paradigm means every retrieval failure corresponds to a real interaction in which the cost has already been paid. We propose MemDream, a framework that enables self-probing memory evolution for LLM agents. Our framework periodically enters offline dream cycles where three specialized agents (Dreamer, Analyst, Consolidator) collaboratively probe, diagnose, and repair the memory graph before failures occur. A policy trained via Group Relative Policy Optimization learns which repair operatio | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34545
title: MemDream：面向自探测记忆演化的离线梦境框架

content: SciARP：多轮科学推理智能体的扰动鲁棒性评测 | SciARP 通过对多轮科学问题求解过程施加科学上合理的扰动，揭示当前科学智能体存在隐蔽、延迟传播且难以恢复的可靠性缺陷。 | 子主题：科研评测 | arXiv | SciARP 将 620 个科学问题转换为由 3—13 轮相互依赖任务组成的评测样本，并设计了覆盖问题理解、证据处理、推理和结论形成的 13 类扰动。基准在匹配设置下分别运行干净版本与扰动版本，生成成对的真实执行轨迹，同时评估任务成功率和过程可靠性。对四个模型家族的八个 LLM 进行实验后发现，智能体即使信息或推理已不可靠，仍可能继续推进任务。更强的干净任务性能不一定带来更高鲁棒性，扰动影响还可能潜伏数轮后才显现，并沿下游依赖持续传播。 | 为科学智能体提供面向多轮交互全过程的扰动鲁棒性评测框架。 提醒开发者不要仅用最终任务成功率衡量可靠性，应同步审计证据处理、推理过程和错误传播轨迹。 可用于定位不同扰动类型的失效模式，并研究早期检测、执行恢复和过程验证机制。 表明基础能力提升不等于鲁棒性提升，模型选型与训练应单独纳入抗扰动指标。 | 标题：The Marathon of Scientific Reasoning: Robustness of Scientific Agents to Perturbations in Multi-Turn Interactions 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34537 摘要：Large language model (LLM)-based scientific agents are increasingly used for scientific problem solving, yet their robustness to imperfections arising during multi-turn interactions remains poorly understood. We introduce \textsc{SciARP} (\textbf{Sci}entific \textbf{A}gent \textbf{R}obustness to \textbf{P}erturbations), a benchmark for evaluating scientific agents under scientifically plausible perturbations throughout multi-turn problem solving. \textsc{SciARP} transforms 620 scientific problems into interdependent tasks of 3--13 turns and defines 13 perturbation types spanning problem understanding, evidence processing, reasoning, and conclusion formation. Clean and perturbed versions of each task are independently executed under matched settings, producing paired live trajectories for e | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34537
title: SciARP：多轮科学推理智能体的扰动鲁棒性评测

content: PairPref：评测记忆增强助手何时应采用用户偏好 | PairPref 通过仅改变情境的成对样本评测模型能否正确判断记忆中的用户偏好何时适用，结果显示现有模型普遍存在不加区分地套用偏好的问题。 | 子主题：记忆能力评测 | arXiv | PairPref 包含 1,227 组配对样本，覆盖 45 种用户偏好和八类情境；每组仅改变情境，偏好、请求及四个候选回复均保持不变。 基准设置选择与自由生成两条赛道：前者要求从固定回复中选出仅在适当情境下采用偏好的答案，后者要求模型自行决定是否采用偏好。 八个受测模型的选择赛道分数 Δ 多为 51～65 分，但自由生成中，成对回复均符合各自情境的比例仅为 3.6%～18.3%。 减少检索记忆、改变偏好呈现格式或采用更严格提示均未解决问题，模型仍倾向于在两种情境中一概套用用户偏好。 | 将记忆系统评测从“能否存储与检索偏好”扩展到“能否判断偏好的情境适用性”。 可用于诊断个性化助手中的偏好过度应用问题，避免记忆检索正确但响应决策错误。 提示记忆增强系统需要在检索之后增加情境匹配、适用性判断或偏好门控机制。 成对最小情境变化的设计有助于隔离检索相似度影响，可作为记忆决策可靠性的针对性测试方法。 | 标题：PairPref: When Should Memory Guide the Answer? A Benchmark for Contextual Preference Use 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34526 摘要：Memory-augmented assistants use retrieved preferences to guide their responses. A small change in the situation can change whether a preference is appropriate while barely affecting its retrieval similarity. Memory benchmarks typically test whether systems store and retrieve preferences, with less attention to when those preferences should apply. We introduce PairPref, a benchmark of contextual preference use. Each pair changes only the situation, keeping the preference, request, and four candidate replies fixed. The preference remains valid in both situations. In the selection track, models must choose the reply that applies the preference only where appropriate. In the free-generation track, they must decide when to apply it without seeing candidate replies. Both tracks use the same 1,22 | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34526
title: PairPref：评测记忆增强助手何时应采用用户偏好

content: EOPSA：高效在策略自蒸馏安全对齐 | EOPSA通过自适应 rollout 调度与选择性蒸馏，仅训练安全关键 token，在降低约50% rollout 计算量的同时改善安全合规性并保留推理能力。 | 子主题：在策略蒸馏 | arXiv | 论文指出，传统在策略自蒸馏安全对齐存在长 rollout 下教师纠正能力衰退，以及特权提示引发的风格差异稀释安全梯度两项瓶颈。EOPSA提出自适应 Rollout 调度，利用 Teacher Rescue Rate（TRR）动态限制生成长度，使训练保持在教师监督可靠的区间。其选择性蒸馏机制过滤安全中性 token，仅对安全决策关键的状态转移进行梯度更新。在最高32B参数的推理模型上，该方法减少约50%的 rollout 计算量，仅反向传播约2%的 token，并在安全合规和推理能力保持方面优于全 token 蒸馏基线。 | 为在策略安全蒸馏提供更高效的训练方案，减少无效 rollout 与反向传播开销。 表明安全对齐应优先识别监督可靠区间及安全关键 token，而非对完整响应进行均匀蒸馏。 TRR可作为动态控制生成长度和监测教师纠正有效性的训练指标。 有助于缓解安全对齐对基础推理能力的损害，适用于大规模推理模型后训练。 | 标题：EOPSA: Efficient On-Policy Self-Distilled Safety Alignment 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34519 摘要：On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for safety alignment, delivering dense, token-level supervision by distilling from a teacher conditioned on refusal-oriented privileged prompts. However, we reveal that this paradigm suffers from critical inefficiencies that degrade both training efficiency and general reasoning capabilities. Specifically, we diagnose two fundamental bottlenecks: (1) supervisory collapse over extended rollouts, where the teacher's corrective efficacy degrades precipitously as the student's generation prefix lengthens, injecting noisy gradients into late-stage tokens; and (2) gradient dilution from stylistic shifts, where the distillation objective is dominated by safety-irrelevant stylistic discrepancies induced by privileged prompting, | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34519
title: EOPSA：高效在策略自蒸馏安全对齐

content: SEAD：工具型智能体的状态化攻防框架 | SEAD将工具型智能体攻防建模为部分可观测的状态控制问题，并通过DART攻击搜索与SAGE执行前防御显著降低可执行攻击成功率。 | 子主题：状态安全 | arXiv | SEAD指出，工具调用会持续改变文件、权限和数据库记录等外部状态，因此表面正常的后续动作可能因隐藏状态而产生危害。攻击方法DART将恶意目标分解为局部合理的步骤，并利用真实工具执行反馈搜索有效攻击轨迹；防御方法SAGE则在执行前通过只读查询调查相关状态，再决定允许或阻止动作。作者还构建了包含受控初始状态、可回放工具环境和任务级可执行检查的数据集。在在线攻防评测中，SAGE将DART的可执行攻击成功率从48.0%降至4.0%，并表现出跨攻击方法和域外环境的泛化能力。 | 为工具型智能体安全提供以外部状态为核心的统一攻防建模视角。 说明仅审查当前指令或动作不足以判断风险，防御系统需要追踪并主动调查执行环境状态。 可借鉴SAGE的只读查询与执行前拦截机制，构建低副作用的智能体运行时安全层。 可利用其可回放环境和可执行检查方法，提升智能体攻击评测的真实性与可验证性。 | 标题：SEAD: A State-Based Perspective on Attack and Defense in Tool-Using Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34518 摘要：Language-model agents increasingly use tools to act on external systems. Earlier actions can alter files, permissions, database records, or other state, making a later routine-looking action harmful. Yet the visible interaction may not reveal the underlying state needed to assess that action. We formulate attack and defense as partially observed state control in SEAD, deriving their design requirements from this shared execution process. Because attackers supply instructions while the target chooses concrete actions, DART decomposes harmful goals into locally plausible steps and uses feedback from actual tool execution to guide trajectory search. The defender must decide before execution with incomplete state evidence. SAGE can therefore investigate relevant state through read-only queries | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34518 | https://github.com/EverywhereSafety/SEAD | https://github.com/EverywhereSafety/SEAD
title: SEAD：工具型智能体的状态化攻防框架

content: AI 加密货币交易：从回测到真实市场的性能差距 | 该研究构建覆盖历史回测、前瞻性模拟盘和实盘交易的统一基准，用于量化不同 AI 加密货币交易方法从回测到真实市场的性能落差。 | 子主题：评测基准 | arXiv | 研究提出一个面向加密货币市场的统一交易评测基准，涵盖机器学习、强化学习、LLM 和交易智能体等代表性方法。评测分为历史回测、基于交易所的前瞻性模拟盘和真实资金实盘交易三个阶段，逐步提高时间与执行环境的真实性。该协议纳入延迟、滑点、流动性约束和市场冲击等交易摩擦，用于定位策略性能从何时开始恶化。作者还提供支持三阶段评测的开源系统，以及持续更新基准结果的公共平台。 | 衡量历史回测收益能否泛化至未知的未来市场，避免仅凭离线结果判断交易策略有效性。 分阶段识别延迟、滑点、流动性和市场冲击对不同 AI 交易方法的影响。 为机器学习、强化学习、LLM 与交易智能体提供统一且更贴近真实市场的比较框架。 可作为金融智能体部署前的分层验收流程，从低成本回测逐步过渡到模拟盘和小额实盘。 | 标题：Can AI Make Money in Crypto? Measuring the Gap from Backtests to Real Markets 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34510 摘要：AI-based trading methods have rapidly evolved from machine learning and reinforcement learning to large language models (LLMs) and trading agents, yet their performance is still predominantly assessed through historical backtesting. Such evaluations provide limited evidence of whether a method can generalize to unseen future markets or whether its backtested performance can be sustained in realistic trading frictions (e.g., latency, slippage, liquidity constraints, and market impact). We present a unified benchmark that evaluates representative machine learning, reinforcement learning, LLM-based, and agent-based trading methods in cryptocurrency markets through three progressively more realistic stages: historical backtesting, prospective exchange-based paper trading, and real-money live t | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34510 | https://github.com/Starlien95/Awesome-TradingAI
title: AI 加密货币交易：从回测到真实市场的性能差距

content: Harness Learning：可泛化的测试时脚手架自适应 | 该研究将智能体脚手架的修改建模为可执行程序上的元学习，并训练提议模型利用执行反馈在测试时持续优化新任务的求解流程。 | 子主题：脚手架优化 | arXiv | 语言模型智能体由模型及其脚手架共同定义，后者负责组织模型调用、工具使用与信息流。论文提出 Harness Learning，由提议模型依据执行反馈修改求解模型的脚手架，以适配具体任务。该过程被表述为可执行程序上的元学习，其中脚手架修订对应梯度式适应中的权重更新。提议模型通过强化学习训练，以修订后脚手架的任务表现作为奖励；测试时则根据新任务上的连续执行反馈迭代改进脚手架。 | 为固定模型提供无需更新模型权重的测试时任务适应机制。 说明智能体能力优化可从模型参数扩展到可执行脚手架及信息流设计。 可用于自动改进工具调用、模型调用编排和任务求解流程。 为脚手架演化与元学习、强化学习的结合提供统一建模思路。 | 标题：Harness Learning Enables Generalizable Test-Time Adaptation 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35738 摘要：A language-model agent is jointly defined by its model and its harness, the executable program that organizes model calls, tool use, and information flow. Because different tasks call for different ways of organizing these operations, the harness needs to be adapted using feedback from the task at hand. We introduce harness learning, which trains a proposer model to revise a solver's harness using execution feedback. We formulate this process as meta-learning over executable programs, with harness revisions playing the role of weight updates in gradient-based adaptation. We train the proposer with reinforcement learning, using the task performance of revised harnesses as the reward. At test time, the proposer uses feedback from successive executions on a new task to refine the harness, wit | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35738
title: Harness Learning：可泛化的测试时脚手架自适应

content: PhoneCLI：将移动应用界面编译为可调用命令 | PhoneCLI 从应用外部探索并编译 GUI 导航路径，使移动智能体能够通过经过执行前验证的确定性命令替代重复、昂贵且脆弱的视觉操作循环。 | 子主题：工具调用 | arXiv | PhoneCLI 面向依赖截图、VLM 推理和动作输出循环的移动 GUI 智能体，旨在降低其导航延迟、调用成本与执行脆弱性。系统离线从应用外部进行探索，无需应用内部 API、运行时插桩或额外模型训练，并将屏幕、交互元素及导航边整理为带语义标注的地图。每个已发现的目标屏幕会被编译为一条确定性命令，其本质是可重复执行并抵达该屏幕的动作序列。在线阶段，智能体选择相应命令，在执行前进行验证，随后以确定性方式完成导航。 | 将高频、静态且重复的 GUI 导航从逐步 VLM 决策转化为可复用命令，可显著减少视觉模型调用和交互延迟。 为缺少公开 API 的移动应用提供一种黑盒式工具封装方案，有助于扩展移动智能体的可操作范围。 语义界面地图与执行前验证机制可提升导航的可预测性，并为失败恢复、轨迹审计和命令缓存提供基础。 该方法启示智能体系统将模型用于高层意图选择，而把稳定的底层操作交给经过验证的确定性执行器。 | 标题：PhoneCLI: From App Interfaces to Callable Commands for Mobile Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35671 摘要：Mobile GUI agents operate through a perception--action loop: at each step they screenshot the device, invoke a vision--language model (VLM), and emit an action. It is slow, costly, and brittle, yet most of what it does is navigation---and everyday navigation is static, ordered, and endlessly repeated. We present PhoneCLI, which compiles an app's GUI navigation into callable commands, without any app-internal API, runtime instrumentation, or model training. Offline, PhoneCLI explores a target app from the outside and distills its screens, interactive elements, and navigation edges into a semantically annotated map; each screen yields one deterministic command: a replay sequence that reaches it. Online, the agent selects a command, verifies it before execution, and then executes it determini | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35671
title: PhoneCLI：将移动应用界面编译为可调用命令

content: 谁在谁的左边？相对位置推理中的空间证据追踪与角色绑定 | 研究通过激活修补与定向干预，揭示视觉语言模型进行相对位置推理时从位置证据、查询对象角色到答案状态的分阶段表征过程。 | 子主题：视觉推理 | arXiv | 研究指出，较高的样本级准确率可能掩盖模型在对象交换位置或查询角色反转时的空间推理不一致性。作者在三种视觉语言模型及其语言模型骨干上，对视觉和文本输入进行激活修补分析。结果显示，相对位置推理呈现分阶段演化：早期层编码来源侧空间信息，中间层形成查询对象表征，后期层则逐步转化为答案状态。进一步的定向干预验证了这些阶段之间的因果联系，表明位置证据会沿内部计算路径传递并与查询角色绑定。 | 为诊断视觉语言模型是否真正理解相对空间关系提供机制层面的分析方法。 提醒评测设计不能只看总体准确率，还应加入位置交换、角色反转等一致性测试。 激活修补和定向干预可用于定位空间证据传递失败或角色绑定错误发生的具体网络层。 相关发现有助于提升视觉问答、具身导航和空间规划模型的可解释性与可靠性。 | 标题：Who Is Left of Whom? Tracing Spatial Evidence and Role Binding in Relative-Position Reasoning 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35486 摘要：High instance-level accuracy can mask inconsistencies in spatial reasoning when objects exchange positions or their roles are reversed in the query. The internal representations supporting relative-position reasoning remain poorly understood. We investigate two complementary components of this process: tracking object locations in the input and representing their query roles. Across three VLMs with visual or textual inputs and their language-model backbones, activation patching reveals a staged progression from early-layer source representations through intermediate-layer query-object representations to late-layer answer states. Targeted interventions further establish causal links along this progression: manipulating source-side representations shifts location information at query-object | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35486
title: 谁在谁的左边？相对位置推理中的空间证据追踪与角色绑定

content: COEVOLVE：通过证据迁移协同演化科学发现原则 | COEVOLVE 通过在并行原则演化分支间选择性迁移实验观测，在保持各分支原则后验独立的同时扩大科学假设探索范围。 | 子主题：协同演化 | arXiv | COEVOLVE 将协作式科学发现建模为多个并行原则演化分支之间的证据迁移，以缓解顺序探索覆盖有限、耗时较长的问题。系统使用协调核心管理并行分支，使各分支共享有价值的测量证据，同时保留彼此独立的原则后验。其关键机制包括基于信息价值的门控路由，以及经过上下文折扣的似然注入，从而控制证据传播及其影响强度。论文在六项科学发现任务上进行实验，但所给摘要未完整展示具体结果。 | 为自动化科学发现提供可并行扩展的假设与原则探索机制，提升有限时间内的探索广度。 通过信息价值门控减少低收益证据传播，帮助控制多分支协作的通信与推理成本。 分离共享测量证据与各分支原则后验，可降低分支过早趋同和多样性坍缩的风险。 可用于设计具备证据共享、独立推断和动态协调能力的科研智能体系统。 | 标题：Collaborative Principle Evolution via Evidence Transfer for Scientific Discovery 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35315 摘要：Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents promise to automate scientific discovery, yet exploring the vast hypothesis space remains costly. Existing principle-evolution methods accelerate this loop, but operate sequentially, which caps exploration breadth and wastes wall-clock time on challenging problems. To address this, we formulate collaborative scientific discovery as evidence transfer between parallel principle-evolution branches. We present COEVOLVE, which realizes this transfer through a coordination core over parallel branches. By integrating value-of-information-gated routing and context-discounted likelihood injection, COEVOLVE enables branches to collaborate through shared measurements while keeping their principle posteriors separate. Across six scientific-discovery tasks under | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35315
title: COEVOLVE：通过证据迁移协同演化科学发现原则

content: MemoReason：评估参数记忆对大模型上下文推理的影响 | MemoReason 通过将真实实体系统替换为同类型虚构实体，区分大模型的真实上下文推理能力、广义记忆偏差与参数化答案捷径。 | 子主题：记忆能力评测 | arXiv | 论文提出人工策展基准 MemoReason，用于检验大语言模型在事实推理任务中的表现是否依赖参数记忆。基准将原始任务与结构完全相同的虚构版本配对，把人物、公司、日期等真实实体替换为同类型虚构实体，同时尽量保持推理结构不变。研究区分两种机制：熟悉内容普遍提升表现的“记忆偏差”，以及模型跳过推理、直接回忆答案的“强参数捷径假设”。真实与虚构任务之间的性能差异可用于衡量参数知识对上下文推理评测的干扰。 | 为推理基准识别参数记忆、训练数据熟悉度等潜在混杂因素提供对照方法。 可通过真实—虚构配对设计，更准确地区分知识召回与结构化推理能力。 有助于审计现有推理成绩是否高估模型在陌生实体和新情境下的泛化能力。 可为构建抗污染、重构念效度的推理评测基准提供参考。 | 标题：MemoReason: Evaluating the Effect of Parametric Memory on Contextual Reasoning in LLMs 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35312 摘要：Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on reasoning benchmarks, but it remains unclear whether this reflects genuine contextual reasoning or reliance on facts memorized in their parameters. We investigate this by distinguishing two possibilities: a broad \textit{memorization bias}, where familiar content improves reasoning performance, and the \textit{Strong Parametric Shortcut Hypothesis}, where models skip reasoning entirely and recall stored answers. To test these effects, we introduce \textbf{MemoReason}, a human-curated benchmark that pairs factual reasoning tasks with structurally identical \fictitiousterm{} versions where real entities like people, companies, or dates are systematically replaced by \fictitiousterm{} ones of the same type. This \scorerevision{preserves task struct | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35312
title: MemoReason：评估参数记忆对大模型上下文推理的影响

content: 基于医疗本体与认知映射的免训练临床推理框架 | CKG Reasoner 通过医疗本体、认知映射和符号概率知识图谱，将患者观察映射为显式医学知识，实现无需模型训练且可审计的诊断候选排序与队列聚类。 | 子主题：神经符号人工智能 | arXiv | CKG Reasoner 为每个诊断候选构建证据特征节点，并结合患者—参考信息匹配、有限信息门控、知识加权证据累积、疾病相似度和决定性临床规则进行推理。框架采用缺失感知归一化与覆盖率审计，明确区分证据确实不存在和证据尚不可获得两种情况。诊断候选排序与队列级聚类相互分离，后者使用证据强度、相对幅度、方向相似性和证据完整性四个派生坐标执行与结局标签无关的 K-means 聚类。该方法不直接依赖原始预测变量或目标标签，强调显式知识、推理可解释性及证据完整性。 | 为临床决策支持提供一种无需标注数据训练、可直接利用医疗本体和知识图谱的诊断推理路线。 通过显式证据节点、临床规则和覆盖率审计增强诊断依据的可解释性与可追溯性。 缺失感知机制有助于避免将“未观测”错误解释为“阴性证据”，提高临床推理可靠性。 将个体诊断排序与队列聚类解耦，可支持患者分层、回顾性队列分析及跨机构验证。 | 标题：Training-Free Clinical Reasoning through Medical Ontologies and Cognitive Mapping: A Symbolic-Probabilistic Knowledge Graph Framework 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35298 摘要：Most clinical prediction systems learn patient-variable-outcome associations; we investigate a training-free diagnostic paradigm mapping patient observations to explicit medical knowledge. CKG Reasoner integrates candidate-specific Evidence Feature Nodes, patient-reference matching, a bounded Information Gate, knowledge-weighted evidence accumulation, disease similarity, and decisive clinical rules. Missing-aware normalization and coverage auditing distinguish absent from unavailable evidence. Candidate ranking is separate from outcome-label-independent K-means clustering, which uses four derived evidence coordinates (evidence strength, relative magnitude, directional similarity, and evidence completeness), not raw predictors or targets, to derive cohort-level assignments. Across six retro | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35298
title: 基于医疗本体与认知映射的免训练临床推理框架

content: GRASP：面向 LLM 个性化的评分准则感知在策略自蒸馏 | GRASP 将用户特定评分准则细化为生成过程中的监督信号，通过评分准则感知的在策略自蒸馏提升大语言模型个性化响应能力。 | 子主题：在策略蒸馏 | arXiv | 论文研究如何让大语言模型生成符合个体用户偏好与需求的回答，并以用户特定评分准则明确满意回答应覆盖的方面。现有方法通常仅用准则预测相关方面，或将方面覆盖情况压缩成单一的回答级强化学习奖励，监督粒度较粗。作者提出 GRASP，一种评分准则感知的在策略自蒸馏框架，旨在把准则中的细粒度要求更直接地转化为生成学习信号。该方法缩小了“规定个性化回答应包含什么”与“教会模型如何生成这些内容”之间的差距。 | 为个性化模型训练提供比单一回答级奖励更细粒度的监督方式。 展示如何把用户特定评分准则转化为在策略自蒸馏信号，改善偏好覆盖与生成行为之间的对齐。 可用于构建面向不同用户画像、任务需求或回答规范的个性化助手。 启示后续工作联合研究准则质量、细粒度信用分配与个性化效果之间的关系。 | 标题：Rubric-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Personalization 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35262 摘要：LLM personalization aims to generate responses aligned with individual users' preferences and needs. User-specific rubrics make these expectations explicit, providing direct supervision on what a satisfactory answer should cover. Existing rubric-guided approaches, however, exploit such guidance only at a coarse granularity, either by using rubrics to supervise the prediction of relevant aspects for subsequent generation or by reducing aspect coverage to a single response-level reward for reinforcement learning. This leaves a gap between specifying what a personalized answer should contain and teaching the model how to generate it. To bridge this gap, we propose GRASP, a rubric-aware on-policy self-distillation framework for LLM personalization that turns user-specific rubric aspects into f | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35262
title: GRASP：面向 LLM 个性化的评分准则感知在策略自蒸馏

content: Imprint Reader：从权重更新解读到行为干预 | Imprint Reader 通过 Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning 解读冻结权重更新的语义痕迹，并探索利用这种学习过程描述干预模型行为。 | 子主题：元认知 | arXiv | 论文提出 Imprint Reader，旨在将模型训练产生的参数级变化转化为明确的自然语言描述。其 Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning 方法将冻结的权重更新挂载到 Reader 上，并通过无需锚点的元查询读取其中蕴含的学习信息。训练过程加入无变化与随机扰动对照，以抑制模型依赖表面线索或生成缺乏依据的解释。该研究进一步将权重更新的语义读出连接到行为干预，为模型反思自身学习过程提供技术路径。 | 为直接审查模型从一次权重更新中学到了什么提供自然语言接口。 可用于分析训练数据、参数变化与模型行为之间的关联，增强训练过程的可解释性。 为具备学习反思能力的自我改进模型提供基础组件。 对权重更新审计、异常训练检测和定向行为修正具有潜在价值。 | 标题：Imprint Reader: From Weight-Update Readout to Behavioral Intervention 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35261 摘要：As language models take a growing role in AI development, a natural aspiration is for them to reflect on their own learning process, as humans do, and use that reflection to improve themselves. At the same time, these models have an advantage that human learners lack, since training leaves parameter-level traces that can, in principle, be inspected directly. However, current models cannot decode these traces into an explicit account of what they have learned. To this end, we introduce the \textit{Imprint Reader}, a model trained with \textit{Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning} (SaRT) to describe frozen weight updates. SMaRT mounts each update onto the Reader and uses an anchor-free meta-query to elicit a natural-language description, while no-change and random-perturbation controls discourage | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35261
title: Imprint Reader：从权重更新解读到行为干预

content: ASCT：反事实树注意力搜索实现智能体强化学习信用分配 | ASCT通过在智能体访问状态上搜索反事实动作树，将工作流终局效用转化为局部动作信用，从而改进PPO训练。 | 子主题：策略优化 | arXiv | ASCT面向智能体强化学习中终局效用难以归因到中间决策的问题，将训练阶段的多步搜索转化为局部动作信用。在智能体实际访问的状态上，辅助搜索树从可恢复的相同前缀出发，评估其他合法动作及其后续结果。得到的动作价值表以冻结智能体的动作概率为中心化基准，并用于对智能体采样轨迹执行PPO更新；部署时则只需保留智能体本身。该框架可采用均匀搜索、UCT和成本感知AgentUCT，并在HotpotQA智能体检索增强生成任务上优于基于整条轨迹回报的PPO。 | 为长程智能体任务提供比终局回报更细粒度的动作级信用分配信号。 利用同一可恢复前缀下的反事实分支比较，降低中间决策价值估计的歧义。 将搜索限制在训练阶段，避免辅助树搜索增加线上部署成本。 可结合成本感知搜索，在信用估计质量与训练计算开销之间进行权衡。 | 标题：ASCT: Attentive Search over Counterfactual Trees for Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35215 摘要：Terminal utility evaluates a complete agentic workflow, but learning requires credit for the decisions within it. We introduce Attentive Search over Counterfactual Trees (ASCT), a framework that turns training-time multi-step search into local action credit. At actor-visited states, an auxiliary tree evaluates alternative legal actions from the same recoverable prefix. Its action-value table is centered by the frozen actor's probabilities and supplies credit for PPO on actor-sampled trajectories. This protocol connects counterfactual evaluation to policy learning while deploying the actor alone. Uniform, UCT, and cost-aware AgentUCT instantiate the framework. On HotpotQA agentic retrieval-augmented generation, all three improve mean held-out utility over trajectory-return PPO and workflow- | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35215
title: ASCT：反事实树注意力搜索实现智能体强化学习信用分配

content: VSDD：用变分 Stackelberg 博弈学习离散扩散重写 | VSDD 将离散扩散训练建模为领导者—跟随者博弈，学习具备语义感知能力的前向扰动过程，使模型能够更有效地重写并纠正已生成词元。 | 子主题：扩散模型 | arXiv | 离散扩散模型可在生成过程中重新审视并纠正早期词元，但这种重写能力高度依赖前向扰动过程。掩码扩散通常在词元解除掩码后将其固定，而均匀扩散虽允许修改，却只采用均匀随机的词元替换。VSDD 不再使用固定扰动规则，而是基于去噪器的词元嵌入学习具有语义感知能力的马尔可夫扰动过程。该方法将训练构造成变分 Stackelberg 领导者—跟随者博弈，使扰动策略主动选择最有助于去噪器学习重写的替换。 | 为离散扩散模型提供可学习的前向扰动机制，减少固定掩码或均匀随机替换带来的训练局限。 展示博弈论方法在联合优化数据扰动策略与去噪模型方面的应用价值。 可启发面向文本修订、迭代解码和错误纠正的生成模型设计。 | 标题：Learning to Re-Draft: A Variational Stackelberg Game for Discrete Diffusion 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35166 摘要：Discrete diffusion models offer the ability to re-draft, revisiting and correcting earlier tokens throughout generation. This capability depends on the forward corruption process that defines what the denoiser learns to correct. Masked diffusion models fix tokens once they are unmasked, while uniform diffusion permits revisions but relies on uniformly random token substitutions. We instead learn which substitutions are most useful for training the denoiser to re-draft. We introduce Variational Stackelberg Discrete Diffusion (VSDD), a framework for learning a semantically aware corruption process. VSDD formulates training as a leader-follower game: the leader defines a Markovian corruption process parameterized by the denoiser's token embeddings, while the follower optimizes a variational d | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35166
title: VSDD：用变分 Stackelberg 博弈学习离散扩散重写

content: ConfLens：通过过早答案承诺检测捷径推理 | ConfLens 通过追踪大模型推理过程中对最终答案的置信度演化，以“过早置信”模式识别依赖捷径并事后合理化的非忠实推理。 | 子主题：置信度评估 | arXiv | 论文指出，语言模型输出的思维链不一定忠实反映其内部决策过程，模型可能先利用捷径确定答案，再生成连贯解释进行事后合理化。作者提出 ConfLens，在整个推理生成过程中持续追踪模型对最终答案的置信度变化，而非仅检查文本轨迹或最终结果。在三类捷径推理设置中，捷径样本呈现出共同的“过早置信”现象，即模型在充分展开推理前便对最终答案表现出较高置信度。该信号为检测表面合理但实际依赖捷径的推理过程提供了新的行为层诊断视角。 | 可用于构建不依赖思维链表面文本的捷径推理检测器，提高推理过程审计的可靠性。 将置信度随生成进程的动态变化纳入评估，有助于区分真实逐步推理与答案先行的事后合理化。 可作为过程监督、模型评判和安全审计的辅助信号，用于发现最终答案正确但推理机制不可信的样本。 启示评测设计应关注信念形成的时间结构，而不应只依据最终置信度或文本连贯性。 | 标题：When Confidence Rises Too Early: Detecting Shortcut Reasoning via Premature Answer Commitment 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35074 摘要：The reasoning trajectory of a Large Language Model (LLM) is often treated as a verbalized description of its internal reasoning. However, such trajectories can be unfaithful: a model may rely on shortcuts to reach an answer and then post-rationalize the decision with a seemingly coherent chain of thought. Detecting this shortcut reasoning is challenging because existing monitors and verifiers mainly inspect textual traces or final outcomes, rather than how the model's belief in its answer develops during generation. We introduce ConfLens, a framework that tracks the evolution of confidence in the final answer throughout reasoning. Across three shortcut reasoning settings, we observe a common pattern of premature confidence, where shortcut samples become highly confident in the final answer | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35074
title: ConfLens：通过过早答案承诺检测捷径推理

content: TIDE：通过信息性蒸馏与探索实现智能体强化学习的师生过渡 | TIDE通过动态调节教师蒸馏与奖励探索的相对作用，帮助小模型智能体在多轮长程强化学习中逐步摆脱教师约束并提升自主探索能力。 | 子主题：在策略蒸馏 | arXiv | 多轮智能体需要在长时间跨度内协调信息收集、动作执行与环境反馈，但GRPO所依赖的稀疏轨迹级奖励会限制小模型在训练早期的探索。 现有在策略蒸馏方法通常以固定比例混合教师指导和奖励优化，难以适应不同训练阶段及不同交互轮次的需求。 TIDE从全局训练进程和局部交互位置两个尺度调整师生关系：随着学生能力增强逐渐降低蒸馏约束，并利用师生分歧识别更具信息量的学习位置。 该方法旨在实现从教师引导到自主探索的平滑过渡，避免持续依赖教师阻碍学生超越教师能力。 | 为小模型长程智能体提供更有效的强化学习冷启动与探索机制。 说明教师蒸馏权重不应固定，而应随训练进度和交互状态动态变化。 可将师生分歧作为信息量信号，用于分配蒸馏监督和探索预算。 为构建能够最终超越教师的智能体训练流程提供参考。 | 标题：TIDE: Teacher-Student Transition via Informative Distillation and Exploration for Agentic RL 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35058 摘要：Effective multi-turn agents require interaction strategies that coordinate information gathering, actions, and feedback over long horizons. GRPO is a reinforcement learning algorithm used to train these agents, but sparse trajectory-level rewards limit early exploration in small models. Recent methods augment RL with on-policy distillation (OPD) from a stronger teacher. However, a fixed mixture assumes that teacher guidance and reward optimization should retain a constant relative role throughout training and across interaction turns. This assumption can fail at two scales. Globally, as training progresses, maintaining strong distillation pressure can constrain the model from moving beyond the teacher's capabilities. Locally, teacher--student disagreement identifies where the student depar | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35058
title: TIDE：通过信息性蒸馏与探索实现智能体强化学习的师生过渡

content: EvoCUE：面向自进化智能体的局部控制更新 | EvoCUE 从已完成的智能体执行中学习可复用的局部控制程序更新，使经验能够在长程工具调用流程的正确步骤精准生效。 | 子主题：脚手架演化 | arXiv | EvoCUE 将经验复用重新定义为局部控制问题，而不仅是全局提示、记忆或反思机制。在长程工具使用工作流中，同一经验可能纠正某个决策，却干扰其他步骤，因此需要限定其生效位置。该框架把智能体表示为显式状态机控制器，其中节点执行模型或工具调用，边定义控制流转。系统从已完成的执行证据中学习可复用的控制程序更新，并精确指定应添加什么内容以及在何处应用。 | 为自进化智能体提供细粒度、可定位的经验注入机制，减少全局经验带来的无关干扰。 将状态机控制器作为可编辑脚手架，为执行流程的定点修正和持续演化提供结构化接口。 启发长程工具调用智能体结合执行证据学习局部策略更新，而非仅依赖不断扩张的提示或记忆库。 | 标题：The Right Lesson at the Right Step: Deriving Control Updates for Self-Evolving Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34988 摘要：Self-evolving agents improve future behavior by reusing past experience, typically as global prompts, memories, or reflections. Yet these mechanisms rarely control where experience takes effect. In long tool-use workflows, the same lesson may correct one decision but distract another, making experience reuse a problem of localized control rather than memory alone. We introduce EvoCUE (Evolution through Control Updates from Evidence), a framework for learning reusable control-program updates from completed agent executions. EvoCUE represents the agent as an explicit state-machine controller, whose nodes perform model or tool calls and whose edges define where control passes next. This makes the workflow editable at precise locations, so each learned update can specify what to add, where it | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34988
title: EvoCUE：面向自进化智能体的局部控制更新

content: Teach to Learn：提示退火驱动 LLM 推理自我改进 | 该研究通过提示退火缓解 GRPO 中困难样本缺乏奖励对比及提示轨迹分布偏移的问题，使模型逐步学会在无提示条件下完成推理。 | 子主题：策略优化 | arXiv | GRPO 依赖同一问题多条 rollout 之间的可验证奖励差异，但困难问题可能产生全错轨迹，导致训练信号消失。已有方法利用答案证据构造辅助提示并重新求解失败问题，却将提示条件下生成的轨迹视作普通轨迹，而评测时通常没有这些提示。论文指出这会产生“提示奖励偏移”：恢复出的奖励对比可能让策略更新过度集中于提示轨迹，从而限制模型无提示推理能力的提升。为此，研究引入提示退火机制，逐步削弱训练阶段的提示依赖，将辅助求解获得的学习信号迁移到自主推理过程。 | 为 GRPO 在困难样本全部失败时恢复有效奖励对比和策略梯度。 揭示辅助提示轨迹与无提示评测条件之间的分布偏移风险。 提供从有提示学习逐步过渡到自主推理的训练思路，降低模型对外部解题线索的依赖。 可用于改进推理模型的强化学习课程设计与困难样本利用效率。 | 标题：Teach to Learn: Hint Annealing for Self-improving LLM Reasoning 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34975 摘要：Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves language-model reasoning by comparing verified rewards among multiple solution rollouts for each query. However, difficult training queries can yield only incorrect rollouts, leaving GRPO with no reward contrast or learning signal. Prior hint-based methods construct auxiliary hints from solution evidence and use them to re-solve failed queries, recovering learning signal. Yet the resulting trajectories are typically treated as ordinary solution trajectories despite being generated under an assisted condition unavailable at evaluation. We discover hinted reward shift: recovered reward contrast can concentrate policy updates on hinted trajectories, limiting improvement without hints. This also creates a trade-off: increasing hinted trajector | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34975
title: Teach to Learn：提示退火驱动 LLM 推理自我改进

content: ProofLoom：以证明义务驱动的随机优化理论自动形式化 | ProofLoom 利用开放证明义务驱动 LLM 智能体自动构建 Lean 模型与配套理论，并通过签名契约和独立评判机制防止模型修订弱化原始数学结论。 | 子主题：形式化证明 | arXiv | ProofLoom 面向研究级随机优化算法的自动形式化，可根据已发表算法、目标定理和原始证明，自主构建 Lean 中的算法模型及其支撑理论。系统以尚未解决的证明义务为反馈，持续生成或调整定义、接口、引理与证明计划。其签名契约记录模型修订所依赖的证据和待履行义务，以避免为了可证明性而悄然改变数学命题。独立 Judge 会拒绝缺乏依据的假设和被弱化的结论，Planner 则把论文中的论证展开为可验证的中间命题。 | 为复杂数学论文从自然语言证明到 Lean 形式化提供端到端自动化路径。 展示了以证明义务作为智能体开发反馈信号，可推动模型、理论接口与证明计划协同演化。 签名契约与独立评判机制可用于约束自动形式化过程中的命题漂移和隐含假设。 该方法可扩展到随机优化之外、同样依赖大量领域支撑理论的研究级数学成果。 | 标题：ProofLoom: Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction for Autoformalizing Research-Level Stochastic Optimization 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34960 摘要：Formalizing research-level stochastic optimization in Lean requires both an algorithm model and domain theory connecting foundational libraries to convergence proofs. Revising a model to restore provability can change the mathematical claim. We introduce ProofLoom, a fully automated LLM-agent system for Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction. Given a published algorithm, target theorem, and source proof, ProofLoom autonomously constructs the Lean model and supporting theory. Open proof obligations drive the development of definitions, interfaces, lemmas, and proof plans. Signature contracts record evidence and obligations for model revisions; an independent Judge rejects unsupported assumptions and weakened conclusions. Planner expands the published argument into intermediate claims, | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34960
title: ProofLoom：以证明义务驱动的随机优化理论自动形式化

content: 基于认知状态转移的主动对话策略优化 | 该研究联合设计认知用户模拟器 Cog-Sim 与认知状态转移驱动方法，通过显式建模多轮对话中的用户认知演化来优化主动对话策略。 | 子主题：策略优化 | arXiv | 研究面向主动对话智能体，使其在推进任务目标的同时依据用户反馈持续调整策略。现有用户模拟器通常未显式描述用户认知随对话轮次的演化，导致反馈缺乏跨轮一致性与状态依赖性。为此，作者设计认知用户模拟器 Cog-Sim，并以认知状态转移驱动交互式策略优化。该方法还关注同一高层策略对应的不同自然语言表达，避免仅使用策略标签而忽略庞大的话语实现空间。 | 为主动对话策略提供比静态数据模仿学习更具交互性和状态感知能力的训练途径。 显式追踪用户认知状态，有助于提高模拟反馈的跨轮一致性和长期任务推进能力。 将高层对话策略与具体话语实现结合，可更细粒度地评估和优化智能体动作。 可用于客服、教育辅导、健康咨询等需要持续影响或适应用户状态的多轮对话场景。 | 标题：Proactive Dialogue Policy Optimization via Cognitive-State Transition 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34948 摘要：Proactive dialogue requires agents to continually adapt their policies to user feedback while progressing toward task objectives over multiple turns. To move beyond imitation learning on static datasets, recent approaches use user simulators to collect interactive data for policy optimization. However, many simulators do not explicitly model the evolution of user cognition, limiting the consistency and state dependence of feedback across turns. Moreover, representing each action only by a high-level strategy label overlooks the large utterance space and cannot distinguish alternative realizations of the same strategy. To this end, we jointly design a $\textbf{Cog}$nitive User $\textbf{Sim}$ulator $\textbf{(Cog-Sim)}$ and $\textbf{C}$ognitive-$\textbf{S}$tate $\textbf{T}$ransition--Driven $ | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34948
title: 基于认知状态转移的主动对话策略优化

content: FTA：工具型语言模型故障后报告透明度评测 | FTA 通过固定工具失败观测与证据状态，独立评测工具型智能体在故障后是否虚报成功，以及能否提供有效恢复建议。 | 子主题：智能体评测 | arXiv | FTA 针对工具调用失败后智能体在缺乏证据时仍宣称任务成功的问题，构建了可直接审计的受控评测基准。该基准在生成前固定失败观测和所需证据状态，从而将故障报告能力与工具选择、恢复行为及环境动态解耦。FTA 包含 100 个任务，覆盖五类确定性失败轨迹、一个中性对照和四种用户压力条件。研究评测了六个模型、三种响应策略和 3,600 条人工标注回复，基线策略下的虚假成功率达到 22.8%，同时还考察了回复是否提供有用的恢复方案。 | 为工具型智能体提供可复现、可审计的故障后报告能力评测方法。 帮助区分“工具执行失败”与“模型对失败状态进行虚假陈述”两类风险。 可用于测试用户压力和响应策略对虚报成功率的影响，并指导故障披露策略设计。 提示智能体系统应将证据约束、失败确认和可操作恢复建议纳入验收与安全评估。 | 标题：Failure-Transparent Agents: Benchmarking Post-Failure Reporting in Tool-Using Language Models 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35732 摘要：Tool-using agents can fail twice: a required tool can fail, and the agent can then report success without the evidence needed to justify it. Existing benchmarks often entangle this reporting failure with tool selection, recovery, and environment dynamics. We introduce Failure-Transparent Agents (FTA), a controlled benchmark that fixes the failed observation and required evidence state before generation, making post-failure claims directly auditable. FTA contains 100 tasks with deterministic failure traces spanning five failure families, a neutral control, and four user-pressure conditions, and evaluates unsupported claims alongside useful recovery. Across six models, three response policies, and 3,600 human-annotated responses, false-success rates are 22.8% under the baseline policy, 9.3% | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35732
title: FTA：工具型语言模型故障后报告透明度评测

content: 基于项目反应理论的量规奖励 | 论文提出量规反应理论（RRT），通过项目反应理论建模量规标准对潜在质量的区分能力，并选择更有信息量的标准来生成标量奖励。 | 子主题：奖励建模 | arXiv | 对于没有唯一可自动核验答案的语言任务，量规可将响应质量拆分为多个可判定标准，但强化学习仍需把这些判定聚合为标量奖励。 常见的固定分值求和会让不同判定模式得到相同奖励，而且标准权重反映的是预设分值，而非其对当前策略样本的实际区分能力。 论文提出量规反应理论（Rubric Response Theory，RRT），在各标准都是同一潜在目标的单调指标时，对响应质量与标准信息量进行建模。 RRT还可选择更具判别力的量规标准，避免标准数量增加时评判请求数同步增长，从而降低奖励评估成本。 | 为开放式任务构建比固定量规加权求和更具辨别力的强化学习奖励。 可依据当前策略生成样本动态识别高信息量标准，改善奖励信号与训练分布的匹配。 通过标准选择减少评判模型调用，适用于量规较长或评判成本较高的后训练流程。 提示奖励设计应显式检验各标准是否共同测量同一潜在质量，以及是否满足单调性假设。 | 标题：Rubric Rewards from Item Response Theory 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35646 摘要：Many language tasks have no single answer that can be checked automatically. Rubrics provide criteria for judging responses to these tasks. For reinforcement learning, the resulting verdicts must be combined into a scalar reward. A common approach sums the points assigned to satisfied criteria. Distinct verdict patterns can thus receive the same reward, and the fixed points encode how much each criterion should count, not how strongly its verdict distinguishes the current rollouts. Beyond this aggregation problem, judging the full rubric needs more judge requests as the criterion count grows. To address these limitations, Rubric Response Theory (RRT) measures quality and selects criteria when rubric criteria are monotone indicators of a shared target. Rather than adding assigned points, RR | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35646
title: 基于项目反应理论的量规奖励

content: MechBench：评测 AI 科研智能体的机制发现能力 | MechBench 通过区分现象定律恢复与底层机制发现，评测 AI 科研智能体能否从观测数据和科学背景中识别真正生成现象的机制。 | 子主题：机制发现 | arXiv | MechBench 针对现有符号回归与科研智能体基准偏重现象定律恢复、较少检验机制发现的问题提出新评测。每项任务由结构化的机制模型定义，其中一组具有科学意义的关系共同导出可观测的现象定律。智能体只能获得观测数据与科学背景，需要进一步恢复生成这些现象的内部机制。基准采用“机制探针”查询无法仅凭现象定律推导的内部科学后果，从而区分表面规律拟合与真实机制理解。 | 为科研智能体提供比公式拟合更深入的机制发现评测框架。 可用于识别模型是否依赖现象层面的捷径，而非形成具有因果或结构意义的科学解释。 机制探针的设计思路可扩展到自动化科学研究系统的过程评估与证据审查。 有助于推动科研智能体从规律恢复迈向可验证、可解释的科学机制发现。 | 标题：MechBench: Can AI Scientific Agents Discover Mechanisms Beyond Phenomenal Laws? 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35515 摘要：Scientific discovery requires not only recovering mathematical laws that describe observable behavior, but also identifying the mechanisms that generate them. Existing benchmarks for symbolic regression and scientific agents primarily evaluate phenomenal-law recovery, leaving mechanism discovery largely untested. We introduce MechBench, a benchmark that explicitly separates these two capabilities. Each task is defined by a mechanistic model, a structured set of scientifically meaningful relations whose joint consequences entail an observable phenomenal law, while agents receive only observational data and scientific context. We evaluate mechanism recovery through mechanism probes, which query internal scientific consequences that cannot be inferred from the phenomenal law alone. To reduce | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35515
title: MechBench：评测 AI 科研智能体的机制发现能力

content: LSPD：面向高样本效率推理的最小二乘策略蒸馏 | 论文从强化学习视角解释在策略蒸馏，并提出结合乐观探索与离策略轨迹复用的 LSPD，以提高大模型推理蒸馏的样本效率。 | 子主题：在策略蒸馏 | arXiv | 论文建立了在策略蒸馏（OPD）的反向 KL 目标与 KL 正则化策略优化之间的联系。基于这一联系，作者提出最小二乘策略蒸馏（LSPD），将价值型强化学习中的乐观探索和离策略数据复用引入策略蒸馏。LSPD 通过探索维持策略多样性，并反复利用已收集轨迹来提升 rollout 效率。理论分析将其关联到乐观价值学习，并证明理想化形式在在线探索下可取得约 O(log K) 的遗憾界；实验结果显示其相较现有方法具有稳定优势。 | 为在策略蒸馏提供统一的强化学习解释，有助于借鉴成熟的策略优化与价值学习方法。 通过重复利用历史推理轨迹降低 rollout 和教师采样成本，提升推理模型训练的样本效率。 乐观探索可缓解蒸馏过程中的策略多样性下降，为探索能力与知识迁移之间的平衡提供新思路。 对设计具备理论遗憾保证的推理蒸馏算法具有参考价值。 | 标题：An RL View of OPD: Least Square Policy Distillation for Sample-Efficient LLM Reasoning 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35505 摘要：We study on-policy distillation (OPD) through the lens of reinforcement learning, establishing a connection between the reverse-KL objective in OPD and KL-regularized policy optimization. Building on this connection, we introduce Least-Square Policy Distillation (LSPD), an RL-inspired framework that brings optimistic exploration and off-policy data reuse from value-based RL into policy distillation. LSPD preserves policy diversity through exploration while improving rollout efficiency by repeatedly learning from previously collected trajectories. Our theoretical analysis connects LSPD to optimistic value-based learning and shows that its idealized formulation achieves a sharp $\tilde{\mathcal O}(\log K)$ regret bound under online exploration. Empirically, LSPD consistently outperforms exis | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35505
title: LSPD：面向高样本效率推理的最小二乘策略蒸馏

content: SRHarness：面向智能体符号回归的科学搜索框架 | SRHarness 通过可组合科学动作、持久化科学状态和搜索轨迹生命周期管理，为大语言模型驱动的智能体符号回归提供专用运行时框架。 | 子主题：智能体框架 | arXiv | SRHarness 面向智能体符号回归任务，强调科学搜索效果不仅取决于底层模型和搜索策略，也受到运行时基础设施的显著影响。框架提供可组合的科学动作，以统一接口处理原始变量、变换变量及候选表达式派生量。其持久化科学状态能够保留已经评估的假设，并向模型暴露紧凑的状态视图。轨迹生命周期管理机制则协调搜索的继续、分支、重启与终止，以支持长程假设探索。 | 为智能体科学发现系统设计领域专用 harness 提供可复用的架构范式。 说明持久化状态与轨迹管理是长程科学搜索性能的重要组成部分，而非单纯的工程实现细节。 可用于研究模型、搜索策略与运行时框架之间的协同优化，并提升符号回归过程的可控性与可复现性。 | 标题：SRHarness: A Harness for Agentic Symbolic Regression 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35501 摘要：Recent agentic symbolic regression approaches increasingly rely on large language models to analyze data, select scientific operations, and refine hypotheses over long search trajectories. In such systems, performance depends not only on the underlying model and search strategy, but also on the runtime infrastructure that supports scientific search. We introduce SRHarness, a domain-specific harness for agentic symbolic regression built around three mechanisms: composable scientific actions that provide a common interface over raw, transformed, and candidate-derived quantities; persistent scientific state that retains evaluated hypotheses and exposes compact model-facing views; and trajectory lifecycle management that coordinates continuation, branching, restart, and termination. On LLM-SRB | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35501
title: SRHarness：面向智能体符号回归的科学搜索框架

content: GraphHCA：长程 LLM 智能体的闭式事后信用分配 | GraphHCA 针对终局奖励稀疏的长程智能体任务，以无需辅助模型或额外推理的闭式方法实现事后信用分配。 | 子主题：信用分配 | arXiv | GraphHCA 面向基于群组的强化学习在长程 LLM 智能体任务中的步骤级信用分配问题。现有方法通常依据采样轨迹中动作之后发生的内容分配信用，未显式刻画动作与最终实现结果之间的回溯关系。传统事后信用分配（HCA）依赖事后策略概率与行为策略概率之比，但估计事后分布需要辅助模型或额外一次计算。GraphHCA 利用终局目标任务的确定性转移结构与贝叶斯规则，给出无需显式估计事后分布的模型无关实现，从而缓解稀疏终局奖励下的估计开销。 | 为长程智能体的稀疏奖励训练提供更直接的步骤级信用归因机制。 省去辅助事后模型或额外推理过程，有望降低强化学习训练的计算与工程成本。 可用于研究终局成功信号如何更准确地回传至关键动作，并改善长轨迹策略优化。 | 标题：GraphHCA: Closed-Form Hindsight Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon LLM Agents 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35084 摘要：Group-based reinforcement learning (RL) has advanced large language models (LLMs) and is increasingly extending to agentic tasks, where sparse terminal rewards make step-level credit assignment essential. Existing methods assign credit from what follows an action in sampled rollouts, but do not explicitly capture its retrospective relation to the realized outcome. Hindsight credit assignment (HCA) instead attributes credit through the ratio of hindsight to behavior-policy probabilities, but estimating the hindsight distribution requires an auxiliary model or an extra pass. To address this estimation bottleneck, we propose GraphHCA, a model-free realization of HCA that eliminates explicit hindsight-distribution estimation. For terminal-goal tasks with deterministic transitions, Bayes' rule | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35084
title: GraphHCA：长程 LLM 智能体的闭式事后信用分配

content: DTV：后训练强化学习中的动态轨迹估值 | DTV利用小批次梯度信息在线估计强化学习轨迹的效用，并过滤会损害训练的轨迹。 | 子主题：数据策展 | arXiv | 论文研究后训练强化学习中的轨迹估值问题，目标是在在线训练过程中识别并抑制有害轨迹。与具有固定训练集和验证集的分类任务不同，强化学习轨迹会动态生成且缺少显式验证信号，因此传统影响函数类数据估值方法难以直接应用。作者提出动态轨迹估值框架 DTV，仅根据梯度信息在小批次层面估计轨迹效用，并过滤对优化不利的轨迹。DTV直接作用于优化过程，可低开销接入现有强化学习训练流水线，并在多种实验设置下接受验证。 | 为强化学习 rollout 筛选提供无需额外验证集的在线数据策展机制。 可用于降低低质量或有害轨迹对策略更新的负面影响，提高后训练稳定性。 梯度层面的轨迹效用信号有望扩展到样本重加权、课程调度和经验回放优先级设计。 评估该方法时应关注过滤比例、额外计算成本及其对轨迹多样性的潜在影响。 | 标题：Not All Rollouts Are Worth Learning: On Trajectory Valuation for Post-Training Reinforcement Learning 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35072 摘要：We consider the problem of trajectory valuation in reinforcement learning: how to identify and mitigate detrimental trajectories during online training. Unlike classification, where data valuation relies on fixed training and validation sets, reinforcement learning involves dynamically generated trajectories without explicit validation signals, making conventional influence-based methods inapplicable. We propose Dynamic Trajectory Valuation (DTV), a simple and efficient framework that estimates trajectory utility at the mini-batch level and filters detrimental trajectories based solely on gradient information. By operating at the optimization level, DTV integrates seamlessly with existing reinforcement learning pipelines with minimal overhead. Extensive experiments across diverse settings, | https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35072
title: DTV：后训练强化学习中的动态轨迹估值

content: LLM 智能体工具模式偏差的测量与缓解 | 论文揭示功能等价的工具定义会显著改变 LLM 智能体行为，并提出可执行的模式变换框架来系统测量与缓解工具模式偏差。 | 子主题：智能体评测 | arXiv | 论文指出，工具模式只是智能体动作空间的一种接口表示，而非动作空间本身，真正掌握任务的智能体应在功能等价的模式下保持一致行为。研究将智能体因工具定义形式变化而产生的行为差异称为“模式偏差（schema bias）”。作者提出可执行的工具模式变换框架，使用九类算子重写原生模式，包括合并或拆分工具、改变单个工具的表达方式，以及将一个动作分散为多个相互依赖的调用。该框架在保持任务和底层可执行动作不变的条件下，可用于系统评估工具调用智能体对接口表示的敏感性。 | 为工具调用智能体提供一种控制底层动作不变、仅改变接口表示的稳健性评测方法。 提醒智能体开发者避免将固定工具模式上的高分等同于真实任务能力。 可利用模式变换开展数据增强或训练，使智能体学习跨工具定义的稳定动作语义。 有助于识别工具合并、拆分及多步依赖调用等接口设计引发的性能退化。 | 标题：Action-Space Shaping for LLM Agents: Measuring and Mitigating Tool-Schema Bias 来源：arXiv 链接：https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34971 摘要：Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on tool-use agentic tasks when given a fixed tool schema. Yet a tool schema is not the action space of an agent; it is merely one interface representation of it. The same executable action can be exposed through many different, functionally equivalent tool definitions, and an agent that has truly learned a task should behave consistently across them. We show that current agents often do not, a phenomenon we term schema bias.
